I wanted to reach out personally, one last time, before our February deadline.

I know I’ve said it before, but I can’t stress this enough: _OH-13 will be one of the most heavily targeted districts in the country this year._ The other side has already started to invest thousands of dollars into flipping our district red, and it’s just the beginning of what they will do to try to defend their majority and execute their dangerous agenda, right here at home.

**But the extremist Republican agenda hurts Northeast Ohioans, Peter.** It threatens our jobs, rolls back our freedoms, endangers our communities, and prioritizes politics over people. _So that’s exactly why I’ll never stop fighting to keep OH-13 blue._

But, in what elections experts are calling one of the most competitive districts in the country, I can’t do it alone. And when folks like you step up to help us hit our monthly goals it not only helps us to prepare for the fight ahead, but sends a message – _loud and clear_ – that we have what it takes to defend this seat.

We’re only a few hours away from our February deadline, so please: Can I count on you to pitch in before midnight? _Emilia_

body:
VOTE RYAN MACKENZIE APRIL 23rd | | | | |
---
Fellow American,
#TeamMackenzie was out in force this week - and the response from voters was off the charts positive! We are on the ground every day talking with voters across the entire Lehigh Valley, sharing our conservative message, and showing people why I am the best candidate to turn PA-7 RED in November!
Here are some recent highlights:
* **NewsNation TV interview about illegal immigration and my legislation to address it in PA**
* **Angela Ashbrook Endorsement - Upper Milford Township Supervisor**
* **Lehigh County Meet and Greet**
* **Pictures from around PA-7**

We have just 8 weeks until Election Day to connect with voters and we need your help! If you are interested in joining our grassroots team you can sign up here: [https://forms.gle/qTdGfWkhGnUnSNWD7](https://mackenzieforcongress.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=62252a4538e3fe848298033c5&id=0bb10e1c63&e=5ccada9200)
Thank you again to everyone who is working so hard to help us get America back on the right track!
All the Best,
-Ryan Mackenzie
|
---
**Ryan Mackenzie on NewsNation**
Check out my recent TV interview from _On Balance_ with Leland Vittert. I spoke about the importance of combating illegal immigration, the Biden administration’s continued failures, and my legislative plan to help address the issue here in PA. I will lead the fight in Congress just like I am doing here at home to crack down on illegal immigration.
Click the graphic below to check out my TV interview:
[](https://mackenzieforcongress.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=62252a4538e3fe848298033c5&id=1692c1f24c&e=5ccada9200)
|
---
**Another Local Leader Endorses Ryan Mackenzie**
I am very excited to be able to add Upper Milford Township Supervisor Angela Ashbrook to the growing list of trusted local leaders who are encouraging people in their local community to “vote Mackenzie.” Angela said “I know that Ryan will be a great asset for us in Washington D.C. and I am happy to support him.”
|
---
**Lehigh County Meet and Greet**
I can’t thank our volunteers enough for hosting a Meet and Greet with local voters. Grassroots events like this are one of my favorite ways to spread my America First message and talk about my proven conservative record. I enjoyed answering many thoughtful questions about my 4 Principles for America Plan, what I have done as a state representative, and how I will serve the people of PA-7 in Congress.
|
---
**PICTURES AROUND PA-7**
Here are pictures from just some of the events I was so lucky to attend across the 7th District this week.

body:
Hi, I know my team and I have reached out a few times, but I wanted to try one more time before our big February deadline at midnight.

The race for Congress in Michigan’s 8th District is considered by experts a pure tossup. If the election were held today, the GOP could flip this seat Red and bring Democrats one seat further from a majority in the House.

I am going to spend every day between now and Election Day working to make sure that doesn’t happen, but I can’t do it without you.

Unlike my GOP opponent who can write his campaign personal checks (seriously, he’s now spent $2.6 million trying to get to Congress!), I rely on members of our coalition to contribute what you can to help us communicate our Michigan Dream message.

Growing up, my older sisters were fearless. As a young immigrant from Ecuador, new to America and struggling to find a community here, I needed advocates and role models exactly like them. Through lessons and by example, they taught me to always stand up for myself no matter what, whether I was facing schoolyard bullies or the teacher who refused to call on me because of my accent.
My sisters and my mom have always been my fiercest advocates. **They showed me what it meant to work hard, how to fight for the future you deserve, and when to stand up and say _ya no más_ — enough is enough.**
I've carried their lessons with me my entire life, inspiring me to take on bullies in both the halls of my high school and the halls of Congress. And right now, Florida families have a bully as a senator.
Rick Scott only cares about three things: his interests, his far-right agenda, and his massive fortune. He's spent his time in the Senate attacking programs that help working families, pushing dangerous and out-of-touch policies, lying to voters, and promoting Trump's lies. I'm sick and tired of watching Rick Scott bully Florida families and push our state backward. **_Ya no más._ I'm running to show this bully that Floridians deserve strong leadership and a brighter future.**

clean_body: we're down to the wire | | | Friend, we're down to the wire here: My end-of-month deadline is at 11:59 p.m., and we're still pacing $41,619 short of my $400,000 goal. This is my biggest goal yet — and it's the shortest month of the year. I knew that hitting this goal wouldn't be easy. But I'm not afraid of a tough fight, and Florida deserves a senator who will never back down. Will you let me explain? = Growing up, my older sisters were fearless. As a young immigrant from Ecuador, new to America and struggling to find a community here, I needed advocates and role models exactly like them. Through lessons and by example, they taught me to always stand up for myself no matter what, whether I was facing schoolyard bullies or the teacher who refused to call on me because of my accent. My sisters and my mom have always been my fiercest advocates. They showed me what it meant to work hard, how to fight for the future you deserve, and when to stand up and say ya no más — enough is enough. I've carried their lessons with me my entire life, inspiring me to take on bullies in both the halls of my high school and the halls of Congress. And right now, Florida families have a bully as a senator. Rick Scott only cares about three things: his interests, his far-right agenda, and his massive fortune. He's spent his time in the Senate attacking programs that help working families, pushing dangerous and out-of-touch policies, lying to voters, and promoting Trump's lies. I'm sick and tired of watching Rick Scott bully Florida families and push our state backward. Ya no más. I'm running to show this bully that Floridians deserve strong leadership and a brighter future. But Rick Scott has a fortune of up to nearly a quarter of a billion dollars that he's using to bankroll his campaign. That's why I've set this huge end-of-month goal. And I'm counting on your help to hit it. = If you've saved payment information with ActBlue Express, your donation will go through immediately: | | | = | | = | | = | | = Thank you, Debbie | * | | | = Debbie Mucarsel-Powell is a Floridian, South American immigrant, mother, and former Congresswoman. But to the villainous forces in the Washington Swamp, to Crooked Joe and his accomplices, _that_ is the ultimate crime.
---
**In 2023, the Radical Democrats unlawfully ARRESTED the _leading_ 2024 presidential candidate (_yours truly_) four times, took a MUGSHOT of me, forced me off the campaign trail and into the courtroom for SHAM TRIALS, unlawfully REMOVED my name from the ballot, GAGGED and CENSORED me, are attempting to JAIL me for life as an innocent man, and are even seeking the _“corporate death penalty”_ against me and my family. **

You and I cannot let them get away with this. The top two vote getters on March 5th will advance to November. So, your support is absolutely critical to help me keep building the momentum needed to beat Adam Schiff and Katie Porter first in the primary and then again in November. **[That why I'm humbly asking you to rush and emergency $30 contribution to my campaign today.](http://links.thegopreport.com/u/click?_t=e3c9a4cac7f248a39c2a3d920479a441&_m=a0fbd31605d4495fad1b9dc6738f9bb4&_e=mR0mw4zYkpAA0Wp97fd67SPVnepTNEJZIsWPw58n_j5XxOAbDzWnOoqb5jjGZ7-4RZ1xE07b5jA-fHIiQ-g3-9q8TyDb3-rNp3NoDdQeMsZ2U5G2pxTZ6J2j1BSgb2XjPQr_Cv4ElrnqGjipX3po_L6PzekrMwu-o3bHyA-jW5SaN4IcdlYUlnBCJ1BvzNmaDS_5xkkfxK8clB8gPvB-pyaE-fqMW56zAClCF5OKPlZ_NFTcdXr-JrAdXnDq1FjM6Mn5pFU45TB5xsT6i8ueJgkjvY92rgOZYyK8cgc5T_79BxB5e5Vze4sH7t60RNGN1JYgbZWlk-C3fV19W1riCM_a3JXZrksMBBm9mt7FvQxMVxTLgWbPHi9rCZjvWvHhvOvgsds6MPY_Qn1MYOvL-A%3D%3D)** There is less than a week until the primary election. That's it. Then, after that, you and I will have just eight months to build a 58-county, grassroots campaign capable of defeating Adam Schiff - with his _ActBlue_ allies and the war chest he's assembled during the two decades he spent in Washington, DC. There's no time to lose. With every day that goes by, you and I are getting more and more reminders why it's so important we win this election. The reality is present-day America is starting to look a lot like 1970s America. You remember what it was like:
---
| |
* Not only were gas prices sky high, Carter's rationing meant we could only buy gas on even or odd days depending on our license plate numbers. Remember?

* Eleven Israeli athletes were slaughtered at the Olympic Village in Munich by terrorists. Remember?

* Fifty-two Americans were held hostage for 444 days by terrorists in Iran. Remember??

And now, as Yogi Berra used to say, **_"It's deja vu all over again."_** Joe Biden, Adam Schiff and the rest of the Democrats don't care one bit that Americans are having a hard time. I'd go even further to say they welcome the misery so they can keep folks down and dependent. You and I _must_ win this race. **[That's why I'm humbly asking you to rush your $30 donation to my campaign today to give me the boost I need to win in the primary.](http://links.thegopreport.com/u/click?_t=e3c9a4cac7f248a39c2a3d920479a441&_m=a0fbd31605d4495fad1b9dc6738f9bb4&_e=mR0mw4zYkpAA0Wp97fd67SPVnepTNEJZIsWPw58n_j5XxOAbDzWnOoqb5jjGZ7-4RZ1xE07b5jA-fHIiQ-g3-9q8TyDb3-rNp3NoDdQeMsZ2U5G2pxTZ6J2j1BSgb2XjPQr_Cv4ElrnqGjipX3po_L6PzekrMwu-o3bHyA-jW5SaN4IcdlYUlnBCJ1BvzNmaDS_5xkkfxK8clB8gPvB-pyaE-fqMW56zAClCF5OKPlZ2sCIDa9vSYEpm-gGSspVi6XpWjeqKlJFMMWtTd3bG4J5gJKsICevY8oVrffqxNDEDg7frTtPOZANPMux9iu9dPBfHa9w16nd5U8TpmMXkc_beqA3QnrPgF53UX2jl4nCMuA8_RXfbicxIeA7EqoaOQXT4St969RxYVhoh3H54vA%3D%3D)** Time is the most important factor. body:
Help us reach 5,000 comments to overcome corporate polluters.? Tell the EPA:
PROTECT COMMUNITIES FROM CHEMICAL DISASTERS
The EPA is now seeking public input on a new rule to require industrial facilities to disclose the hazardous chemical risks posed by their operations, take stronger actions to prevent accidents, and move quickly should an accident occur.

Corporate polluters have already killed this rule once, when Trump decided to allow these dangerous facilities to operate in secrecy. We cannot allow them to succeed again.

GOAL: 5,000 actions
TAKE ACTION https://links.messages.lcv.org/els/v2/G8bxcgq298Mw/QStSLytxVStEVUZXajV3ZUxtei9ldzJ6dXJGTGtjUEhnQXY1eEhYRTJndjM2QUZXUzR4TWJ2ZGpabXpTV2g0eGk4QjYyMFlUR3VJR0RBVStVcXlYMUVBelU4VGkzb2J2ZG1FSmJIZGM2M1k9S0/LzRXYnBQTkxrdk9VZ3haYi9YcGdUQ3d5T3MzTXhESG5HdS81Zmd5c29XZUp1d1VFeS9CU0R3Z3Nka0RpVU9BYm4va0UycW9tNkJBUWUwTWEwZzBRdnc9PQS2 ? ?
? Peter ? a critical new rule from Biden's EPA would finally require dangerous industrial facilities to disclose any hazardous chemicals they contain ? and take steps to prevent and mitigate harmful accidents.

This rule will especially protect people living closest to these facilities, which are overwhelmingly low-wealth communities and communities of color, as well as workers. Decades of environmental racism ensured these hazardous facilities were located in the neighborhoods with the least resources to fight back, meaning these frontline communities are disproportionately exposed to chemical accidents and harmful pollutants that have jeopardized their health.

Here's the problem: powerful interests, like the oil and gas industry and the chemical industry, are demanding the EPA once again abandon these important protections. Unless our movement speaks up right now, we may miss out on this opportunity to advance environmental justice and worker safety, and create healthier communities and workplaces.

Please TAKE ACTION right now to protect communities from chemical hazards. To beat the chemical industry, we need to urgently deliver 5,000 comments supporting the EPA's proposed rule. https://links.messages.lcv.org/els/v2/X6bzsV7GzpTb/QStSLytxVStEVUZXajV3ZUxtei9ldzJ6dXJGTGtjUEhnQXY1eEhYRTJndjM2QUZXUzR4TWJ2ZGpabXpTV2g0eGk4QjYyMFlUR3VJR0RBVStVcXlYMUVBelU4VGkzb2J2ZG1FSmJIZGM2M1k9S0/LzRXYnBQTkxrdk9VZ3haYi9YcGdUQ3d5T3MzTXhESG5HdS81Zmd5c29XZUp1d1VFeS9CU0R3Z3Nka0RpVU9BYm4va0UycW9tNkJBUWUwTWEwZzBRdnc9PQS2

We've already seen the dangers these facilities can pose. In 2013, an explosion of ammonium nitrate fertilizer killed 15 people and destroyed a school, nursing home, and many homes in the city of West, Texas. The Obama administration began a painstaking process to prevent similar disasters, culminating in enhanced protections for minimizing and managing chemical risks.

But after an aggressive campaign from the chemical industry and other corporate polluters, the Trump administration abandoned the rule, choosing to prioritize corporate profits over the health of vulnerable communities and workers.

Tell the EPA: PROTECT COMMUNITIES FROM CHEMICAL DISASTERS The EPA is now seeking public input on a new rule to require industrial facilities to disclose the hazardous chemical risks posed by their operations, take stronger actions to prevent accidents, and move quickly should an accident occur. Corporate polluters have already killed this rule once, when Trump decided to allow these dangerous facilities to operate in secrecy. We cannot allow them to succeed again. GOAL: 5,000 actions TAKE ACTION ? ? ? Peter ? a critical new rule from Biden's EPA would finally require dangerous industrial facilities to disclose any hazardous chemicals they contain ? and take steps to prevent and mitigate harmful accidents. This rule will especially protect people living closest to these facilities, which are overwhelmingly low-wealth communities and communities of color, as well as workers. Decades of environmental racism ensured these hazardous facilities were located in the neighborhoods with the least resources to fight back, meaning these frontline communities are disproportionately exposed to chemical accidents and harmful pollutants that have jeopardized their health. Here's the problem: powerful interests, like the oil and gas industry and the chemical industry, are demanding the EPA once again abandon these important protections. Unless our movement speaks up right now, we may miss out on this opportunity to advance environmental justice and worker safety, and create healthier communities and workplaces. Please TAKE ACTION right now to protect communities from chemical hazards. To beat the chemical industry, we need to urgently deliver 5,000 comments supporting the EPA's proposed rule. We've already seen the dangers these facilities can pose. In 2013, an explosion of ammonium nitrate fertilizer killed 15 people and destroyed a school, nursing home, and many homes in the city of West, Texas. The Obama administration began a painstaking process to prevent similar disasters, culminating in enhanced protections for minimizing and managing chemical risks. But after an aggressive campaign from the chemical industry and other corporate polluters, the Trump administration abandoned the rule, choosing to prioritize corporate profits over the health of vulnerable communities and workers. Under President Biden, the EPA can now reverse this dangerous decision and finally help protect people, especially environmental justice communities, from hazardous pollution and chemical disasters. Don't let corporate polluters undermine critical environment protections. TAKE ACTION now to help us deliver 5,000 comments supporting environmental justice and corporate accountability. Dear Peter,
If I were President of the United States when a Norfolk Southern train carrying hazardous chemicals derailed in East Palestine, Ohio, here's what would have happened:
Norfolk Southern would have come in here and bought this whole town, and moved this whole town to another place. They would have rebuilt the businesses and homes, committing the next 50 years to meticulously cleaning every molecule of dioxin from this area.
As for the government officials who deceived the public, intentionally searching for pollution where they knew it didn't exist to manipulate the residents of this town, my administration would have launched investigations through the Department of Justice.
Every individual involved, whether corporate executives or regulatory officials, would be held accountable, both civilly and criminally.
No one in this town ever asked for dioxin in their yards. A single molecule of dioxin can lead to cancer, severe birth defects, and fertility issues in both women and men.
If the executives of Norfolk Southern want dioxin in their yards, they should put it there themselves. But every molecule they put in East Palestine, they must take responsibility for its cleanup and restore the community.
As President of the United States, I will ensure that this happens.

body:
One thing hasn't changed: I'm still fighting to make a difference for working families.
| | |
---
To be honest, Peter – I never thought I'd get into politics.
But back in the '80s, when local officials wanted to cut my kids' preschool program, I drove out to our state capitol to fight to save it – and a male legislator told me I couldn't make a difference because I was "**just a mom in tennis shoes."**
Well, I laced up my tennis shoes, organized 13,000 parents, and we successfully saved the preschool program. A lot's changed since then, but one thing is the same:_I'm still fighting to make a difference for working families. _
**Now, I just need your help to keep it up.**

Experts at Politico say this election will be the "_map from hell_ " for Senate Democrats, and the GOP is already launching multimillion-dollar ad spends in our most competitive races.**But right now, we're still falling short of our $50,000 February goal.**
Luckily, today's Leap Day, so we've got one extra day to close the gap. **Fighting for solutions for working families will require Democrats to defend and expand our _fragile_ blue majority at the polls, so I'm relying on your urgent grassroots support by midnight tonight to make that happen.**

#
February is the shortest month of the year. For a grassroots campaign like ours, having one or two fewer days to fundraise impacts our numbers for the month overall.
Alexandria doesn’t curry favor with billionaires or host fancy fundraisers asking wealthy donors for big checks. We rely on thousands of people from NY-14 and beyond to ensure we have the resources to fight disinformation, organize across NY-14, and re-elect AOC to the House this year.
[That’s why today we’re reaching out to ask if you can contribute $1 before midnight tonight. Can you donate right now?](https://act.ocasiocortez.com/go/14659?c0=aoc-email-20240229-2.66IeCb&refcode=em20240229-5913-P_FND_RES_GND&t=1&akid=5913%2E2526796%2EfcP2Us)
We are 100% grassroots-funded. From Day 1, Alexandria has never taken a dollar of corporate PAC money or big checks from billionaires. Our average donation is about $16.
As we gear up for re-election, the donations we receive today directly impact our ability to grow this campaign. Alexandria gets constant attacks from MAGA Republicans. We know they’re going to spend millions of dollars trying to take her down. **Your support is crucial to keeping her in Congress fighting for all of us.**
We promise to never try to scare you into donating – and we know that not every supporter can give to every email we send.
[But if you can afford it today, will you contribute $1? Every single contribution will help us reach our $475,000 February fundraising goal.](https://act.ocasiocortez.com/go/14659?c0=aoc-email-20240229-2.66IeCb&refcode=em20240229-5913-P_FND_RES_GND&t=2&akid=5913%2E2526796%2EfcP2Us)
As always, thank you so much.
Team AOC

One of the things that deeply concerns me is the state of our press.

Without reliable newspapers fairly calling balls and strikes, anything can happen.

**It’s for this reason that the recent revival of the famed New York Sun is so vital.**

[**A Beacon of Hope: Dr. Ben Carson's Message of Optimism for America**](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
BY TORI GANAHL, [ROCKY MOUNTAIN VOICE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
| [ ](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
---
In the [newest episode](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) of _Unleashed with Heidi Ganahl_ , Dr. Ben Carson, renowned neurosurgeon, former Secretary of Housing and Urban Development, and steadfast advocate for American values, joined the conversation to set the record straight on his hope for the future of America. The discussion was nothing short of enlightening, touching on topics ranging from childhood struggles to the future of the nation. Dr. Carson’s journey from humble beginnings to national prominence serves as a beacon of hope and resilience for millions across the country.
| [ READ MORE ](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
---
[**Denver Democrat didn’t attend a Colorado House floor debate in person until 45 days into legislative session**](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
[COLORADO SUN](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
* State Rep. Elisabeth Epps, a Denver Democrat, attended her first in-person House floor session 45 days into Colorado's 120-day legislative session.

* Epps requested to participate remotely indefinitely due to an undisclosed "extended health condition" in mid-January, which was granted by House leaders.
She did not disclose her health condition when requesting remote participation and refused to answer questions about it when approached by reporters.

* Epps' absence from in-person sessions follows a previous incident where she left the House floor during a special session to join pro-Palestinian protesters, causing disruption and resulting in a formal reprimand from House Speaker Julie McCluskie.

* There has been ongoing tension between Epps and McCluskie, with Epps accusing McCluskie of "gatekeeping" on certain bills and alleging racist and retaliatory actions regarding her removal from the House Judiciary Committee.

| [ READ MORE ](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)

# Less Than THREE Hours To Hit Our End of Month Goal.
,

Three hours is the length of many epic movies - and it could be the bellwether for showing the strength of our campaign. I am working overtime today on many fronts to bring in what we need for victory.

Last night I reported we were $6450 short of our END OF MONTH finance report goal.

This next report due very soon could be the most crucial report of our race in this Primary. _It will possibly determine whether you have an America First tested and experienced Candidate to WIN for us in District Six_.

**I can report to you as of five minutes ago we have now closed the gap by $3000,_so we are now just $3450 short of our end of month goal_ to prepare for this next crucial FEC report.**

Thank you to all who are helping us reach this necessary funding to fight for you and reach another 100,000 voters.

But if you have not yet helped or can help one more time before MIDNIGHT TONIGHT, that will be a blessing.

With your help I can text President Trump and report a good fundraising number to win this race. Please help me do so.

I am the State Delegate who never backed down for you, but stood firm for freedom at a Dark Hour in our state and nation's history during the COVID lockdowns.

And you will remember that I am the sole Candidate who authored the Parental Rights Act to protect our kids from the state's overreach - we do NOT co-parent with the government.

**_WILL YOU REACH DOWN DEEP AND STAND WITH ME ONCE AGAIN TONIGHT WITH YOUR GENEROUS CONTRIBUTION?_** Thank you!

Freedom and Victory,

body:
Susan Wild and Ryan Mackenzie Are Cut from the Same Cloth |
---
| | [ ](https://dellickerforcongress.us20.list-manage.com/track/click?u=2bced6f51ed1caf3f5b731ec5&id=9ad952b42e&e=1090c5c412)
---
| Dear Friends and Neighbors,

It’s no secret that career politicians are tearing our country apart. They elevate crass ambition, vulgar discourse, and personal gain. They take words out of context and twist them to fit their own narrative. They’re inauthentic, ineffective, and out-of-touch with the voters they represent.

We have seen this in Susan Wild. She says one thing at home in the Lehigh Valley and votes the complete opposite in Washington, DC. She claims to be bi-partisan but supports Joe Biden 99% of the time.

Now we’re seeing this same behavior from my GOP primary opponent, Ryan Mackenzie. For months, Ryan has been launching personal attacks against me and I’ve largely ignored his silly routine. I’ve always focused on running a positive campaign that touts my own experience and relevant credentials. But recently, he’s been going after my family, my volunteers, and my supporters. It’s time to respond.
* Ryan tells GOP voters he’s “America First” and expresses his unfailing loyalty to Donald Trump. But Ryan’s campaign is buoyed by Americans for Prosperity – a Super PAC with no fundraising or spending limits that supports amnesty for illegal immigrants, opposes tariffs on China, and was working throughout the GOP primary to defeat Donald Trump. Career politicians will do anything to get elected.

* Ryan routinely attacks my military service and calls me nicknames that disparage our men and women in uniform. But while Ryan was safe and sound at New York University, I was fighting Al Qaida in the Middle East. And while he was enjoying life in Boston at the Harvard Republican Club, I was ducking into bunkers in Afghanistan. Career politicians don’t understand real sacrifice but have no problem impugning military veterans if they think they can score political points.

* Ryan touts his record in the state legislature as evidence of his conservative achievements. Yet, he voted to make Pennsylvania a sanctuary state for out-of-town abortion providers. And he was a leader in passing Act 77, the law that gave us no-excuse mail-in ballots. Act 77 has done more damage to Republican candidates than any other law in a generation, but Ryan said he would vote for it again. Career politicians can never admit when they’re wrong.

* Ryan Mackenzie has never served in the military and never held a private-sector job. He has been a legislator for 12 years and worked in politics his entire adult life. Yet he touts himself as “feared by the establishment.” Career politicians like Ryan **_are_** the establishment.

I’m disappointed that I had to write this note. I find no need to respond to Ryan’s juvenile provocations against me. But when he attacks my family, my volunteers, and my supporters, he’s also attacking you, the voters. I need to speak up.

The last thing we need in Washington is another career politician looking to further his own ambition at the expense of us taxpayers. You deserve better.

What we need is someone with real-world experience who will go to Washington, get the job done, and return home. That's what our Founders envisioned, and that's exactly what I will do.

**Keep America Free.**

_Kevin Dellicker is a Republican from Heidelberg Township, Lehigh County, running for U.S. House of Representatives in Pa.’s 7th District. He is a 28-year military veteran, technology company owner, husband and father. He’s not a career politician. He’s a proven leader with the experience and courage to Keep America Free. Learn more at[www.dellickerforcongress.com](https://dellickerforcongress.us20.list-manage.com/track/click?u=2bced6f51ed1caf3f5b731ec5&id=1542986143&e=1090c5c412)._

If you have the time to keep reading, I hope that you'll take a moment to celebrate our recent wins.
In 2023, we really got to work. I introduced legislation to create a national paid leave program — legislation that I first introduced 10 years ago and have continued to advocate for since then. You immediately rallied behind me, voicing your support for this long-overdue legislation. **And today, support for paid family leave is higher than ever before** — including 85% of all voters in battleground states! Thank you for making this possible.
I also**released my Strategic Plan on Aging to make sure that our seniors can retire with dignity and financial stability.** From expanding existing programs like Medicare to helping more seniors remain in their homes, these proposals would drastically improve the quality of life for millions of seniors. Thank you for supporting my work to make this happen.
I'm also incredibly grateful for the outpouring of support from this grassroots team after **I introduced a resolution to finally certify the Equal Rights Amendment.****** This amendment would establish protections against gender-based discrimination in our constitution, once and for all, giving us a legal basis to restore reproductive rights. Activists have been fighting for the ERA for 100 years, and it is truly an honor to carry forward their work today. Thank you for standing beside me in the fight for gender equity and reproductive freedom.
Lastly, I fought tirelessly to make sure that the National Defense Authorization Act included a pay increase for service members, investments to clean up toxic PFAS contamination and funding for hundreds of spots in my brand-new cyber security academy at over 400 schools. Thank you for helping me ensure that our veterans and service members get the benefits they deserve.

There have been so many other moments when you've stood beside me, and I am grateful for every single one of them. But our fight for progress is far from over. And now, Democrats are in the most difficult election year in recent memory.

name: KatiePorter.com
subject: Schiff is running two campaigns–one for a Republican and one for himself
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Katie Porter for Senate
body:
# [](https://act.katieporter.com/go/14558?t=1&akid=38493%2E3422442%2E0hPW2w)
Derek, Adam Schiff has spent more than $10 million *boosting* our Republican opponent. Let us explain:
In October, former baseball player Steve Garvey got into the race. Polls initially showed him in third, behind us and Adam Schiff.
**Then the Schiff campaign decided to go all in for Steve Garvey.** The campaign itself has spent more than $10 million to consolidate conservative support behind Garvey. Their super PAC has spent millions more, with ads from both airing on Fox News constantly.
Garvey has risen in the polls, despite not running a single TV ad of his own or taking any sort of real policy position in our debates. In polls, he’s now consistently tied with Katie or slightly ahead.
This cynical play to boost a Republican into the top two may work to further Schiff’s own career, but it threatens to box out qualified Democratic women (and leave CA without a woman Senator for the first time in over thirty years).
As reporters have said, “If Schiff succeeds in juicing Republican turnout for Garvey, it stands to reason that those Republicans will also vote Republican down the ballot. Garvey himself has no shot of winning**, but there may well be closer races in purple House and state legislative districts, school boards, and more that could be swung by a surge in Republican turnout that Schiff is spending millions to stoke.”**
This is a dangerous play that has national implications. Republicans hold the House majority by just a few seats, and several flippable districts are here in California. If our state has a competitive Democrat on Democrat contest in November, it will encourage Democratic voters to tune in and show up. But a Republican on Democrat race for Senate here in California threatens to depress Democratic turnout, as folks know this is a safe blue seat.
Career politicians shouldn’t get to manipulate the electorate and buy themselves a promotion.
There are just five days until the election, and we are doing everything we can to beat Republican Steve Garvey and make it into the general election, where we know Katie has a strong chance of winning. Many thanks,
Team Porter

Katie is running for the U.S. Senate because Californians deserve a warrior fighting for them in Washington. subject: What does “created equal” mean?
body:

http://paracom.paramountcommunication.com/p/oWyUawaihN

Hi
Friend,
One of
the reasons young people are so attracted to the idea of
socialism is the promised equality of outcomes.

They want
life to be fair for everyone, and for all to have wellness,
happiness, and financial security. But if the end goal of
socialism is "equality", that begs the question: what is
equality? Are equality and liberty consistent one with the other
or are they in conflict?

In this
25-page commentary, "Created Equal", legendary economist and
Hoover fellow Milton Friedman answers these and other questions
in great depth. You'll learn what Thomas Jefferson meant when he
wrote the words "created equal" in the Declaration of
Independence and how the meaning has changed through American
history. You'll see how Friedman brilliantly illustrates
differences between equality of opportunity and equality of
outcome.
With many
today striving to increase government power in the name of a
concept of "equality", Friedman's words still ring true for those
who believe that a society that puts freedom first will end up
with both greater freedom and greater equality.

follow this link to get your free copy of "Created Equal" now.

Thanks,

Greg

name: Hillsdale College via Restore Our Nation
subject: Survey on the Department of Justice
body:
Please particpate in this survey on the Department of Justice.

This sponsored message from Restore Our Nation is on behalf of Hillsdale College

[](http://post.spmailtechnol.com/f/a/yg1FpFqqCvOe1YqWesk-eg~~/AARclAA~~~) Dear Fellow American, Before you move on to your next email—I would appreciate it if you would take a few moments to participate in Hillsdale College's **National Survey on the Department of Justice.** The survey will only take a few moments of your time, and its subject affects your liberty and the very survival of the rule of law in America. **The current administration's weaponization of the Department of Justice is unprecedented in American history.** Instead of protecting your God-given constitutional rights, the administration uses the Department of Justice to attack its political opponents... ...as well as Christians, parents, and anyone who dares to stand up for our constitutional liberties. At the same time, with the help of the media it...
* Covers up a two-tiered justice system that violates your constitutional rights

* Hides the corruption of the ruling class

* Attacks those with traditional viewpoints

**That's why I'm asking you to take the Hillsdale College National Survey on the Department of Justice.** By completing this survey, you will help us more clearly understand the views of mainstream Americans like you on this critical issue. Your responses will help Hillsdale strengthen its nationwide educational outreach efforts on behalf of liberty—including the importance of the rule of law and checks and balances, which the American Founders saw as essential safeguards against corruption. Friend, you can complete the National Survey on the Department of Justice by using the link below: **[https://lp.hillsdale.edu/department-of-justice-survey/](http://post.spmailtechnol.com/f/a/yg1FpFqqCvOe1YqWesk-eg~~/AARclAA~~~)** The **Declaration of Independence** argues that **the purpose of just government is to secure our natural rights** and that **just government is founded on the consent of the governed.** Yet today's ruling class regularly disregards the will of the American people, and our rights—to the freedoms of speech, assembly, and religion, to due process, to gun ownership, and more—are under constant attack. **You and I know that liberty in America is under serious threat. But as I travel around the country, I tell the audiences I speak to how we are engaging in the fight against this threat.** A vital part of our efforts in this fight—in which Hillsdale College is a leader—is **reaching** and **teaching** millions of citizens, with the TRUTH about America's great heritage of liberty. We are heavily invested in our educational outreach efforts through our **Project to Defend Liberty Nationwide by Reaching and Teaching Millions.** These efforts include:
* **Teaching bright and principled students** —on our campuses in Hillsdale, Michigan, and Washington, D.C.—who receive a rigorous, **classical liberal arts education, including** a required course on the Constitution

* **Distributing _Imprimis_** , America's leading digest of liberty, which is mailed to more than 6.4 million homes and businesses ten times per year; previous issues include “The Politicization of the Department of Justice” by Harmeet K. Dhillon

* **Producing and promoting free online courses** for any citizen who wishes to learn, on topics such as the Constitution, American history, and free market economics

* **Providing a classical K-12 curriculum** with a solid grounding in American history, constitutional government, and economics to schools that educate thousands of students nationwide

After everything we've seen over the past few years, the need for Hillsdale's educational outreach efforts is undeniable. So please share your views by completing our **National Survey on the Department of Justice** and returning it to me as soon as possible. It will only take a few minutes of your time. Your completed survey will help us form the most effective strategy to **reach** and **teach** millions of Americans on behalf of liberty. As you might know, Hillsdale College is almost unique in American higher education in its refusal to accept EVEN ONE PENNY of government funding—not even indirectly in the form of federal or state student grants or loans. **This independence frees the College from burdensome and corrupting government regulations. But it also means that our work depends entirely on the generous support of private citizens, like you, who understand the importance of education to liberty.** If you agree that we are now seeing an unprecedented assault on the American way of life, I hope you will partner with Hillsdale College by making a generous tax-deductible gift today. You can easily do so after completing the attached **National Survey on the Department of Justice** , which you can access at this secure link: **[https://lp.hillsdale.edu/department-of-justice-survey/](http://post.spmailtechnol.com/f/a/yg1FpFqqCvOe1YqWesk-eg~~/AARclAA~~~)** Thank you for your time and attention. I look forward to receiving your completed survey, and I sincerely appreciate your support of Hillsdale's educational outreach efforts on behalf of liberty. Warm regards, Larry P. Arnn President, Hillsdale College Pursuing Truth and Defending Liberty Since 1844 |

## Presidential Politics Visits Texas Border
A federal judge [blocked a contested Texas law](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxskLtu6zAQBb9G6mgslw9ZBYvbuPNtUwpLcmUzoCSDWtvJ3wdKnfLgNDPzcZ2uVGpZb_9p4SDzNlGS8uLJKK3QTrbPYWZGNj0HPcBowAyj7-_BjgOe2fgYdZwtonEOdMSBHTjtXepLQEALBrQG5xFPlGYXk8_nHAGIdGeBc5GtnT63ssqd5_q9vbid0rb0NdxFHntn_nV46fBCj5Xf-3Edo0lJlTu8CH_RrpZya7SKotZ4l12l7dlEtechpkxMmfOoPUKKefRn7waXiHxMlBBM30J-vEutZfdDZ-G2UKm_DPJXkJ8AAAD__7w8YSg) allowing the state to arrest illegal immigrants, just ahead of politically charged visits to the Texas border by President Biden and Donald Trump Thursday. The judge said he believed the Texas law would be found unconstitutional because it conflicted with federal authority, and he temporarily halted the state from enforcing it while the case continues in the courts. Meanwhile, President Biden [traveled to Brownsville](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxs0LFyhCAQgOGngY4bBEQpKNLYXdqUzgrLuQmKg-Sce_tMUqf-Z_7i-7jPd6BM--MdNvQtlRlCoyfOWnRCmdnw6BOiQs3Rd4N0WurBWb56l2TnEiTA5JxMQRs7BqOdHsdgh6g4eSWVkVp2neytUjcIqV-CjWNcpATomJEYqZV6-yy0txVTfpUn1lsoG89-be04mX5jamJqaiuulPNvY2pay4Y7XidTU4DtAHrsTE3GuHG0vehFgy-EC16naPV7O8RCEXexlBqxilbpYGri1cfjopzptAMz8rEB_f15-w_iJwAA__9IWV9l) and called on Republicans to pass a border security bill that came attached to aid for Ukraine and Israel. [Trump went to Eagle Pass](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxsj7Fu8yAURp8Gb1iXC4FkYPgXb_nXjhY2l5gKQwQkbt--cudun_Qd6eh83Oe7iynmx3-3k-2hzG7t8U2z5IKjmtXgbSBCkgNZYeAmQZqbHjYbMBAiGVDOX5V2WguDRoXghb_cIAzRIqACCULARSOObg2XZdX-6hcA5wRTQD72UsfPEnPfKKTv8qY6rmUfkt16fzYm_zGcGE7HcYzr0jId7fwZTudkOC3RU-a9vvYn7_TlGm_l1TeqmS-leqqc3pT7iQ7V-ucRU4pNG6bgsbuYfm39r_SfAAAA__-hA1wz), where Texas has put up barbed wire, and blamed Biden for the immigration crisis, saying the U.S. _" is being overrun by Biden migrant crime."_
## Millennials in Line to be Richest Generation Yet
Millennials, born between 1981 and 1996, will inherit an estimated [$90 trillion in assets](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxs0D2OrDAQBODTmMyoafMzBA5eQjYv3RAZ0-BeGXtkWoPm9is23qykTyqV6us5Px1HTvt_d5CVLc_OC79pNrrR2M5ttdqNCMlUZJsBRgNmGPsq2KEfcOy86RbawNPDtSuazveNfxg0Biq2CNiCgaaBrkesnd-6xffrY10AnGtUC7Sy5FJ_Z04SaIuf_KZS-3xU0QaR16nMP4WTwum6rtqnxd-ocLqrFU6Adx5vJxclaCkunRsVfXCMlBK7eGrJeiGfD9KFfaBT9E6JihPOSXPSgU_J5VMHOWJV7Pq6OEY--0G1sB-O4-8i-euenwAAAP__LsFnNg) over the next 20 years and become the "richest generation in history," according to a new wealth report by global consultancy Knight Frank. The generational shift in wealth will come in the form of property and other equity-rich assets passed down from members of the silent generation, 1928-1945, and baby boomers, 1946-1964. The report, to be released next week, says Millennials will still face a [complex future](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxskDGPnDAUhH-N6R4yhjNHQZGLRLdpU6Jn-4G9MfbKfrto8-sjUl87881IM79v6w1DDGn_hQfNvOUVLYcXrT10oIZ1aNy8ESnqG5q7UU697MdJN37uybnRUmf0ZCdlRm0kbUZrnOznZkk2YVZSDbKXXSc_tFIt2u3DWO0-nZESsRODJBc4l_aeQ2JPW3znF5XW5qOJs2d-VNH_EGoRajnPsz1qujyhFkrwrEItR070FmophJEqI9MlhhgppYCxAhYCNPnJwBkM2XwQsCcowXqqDDslKsghJwgJfKicyxvYY_pTr8gkgUuI8QJOwsgeuGCqGxVAa3NxIe0XmOiEQo9cWKgFC3x9dXf9829qyuwe59VQ9SgGuR8Y4v-F_N3d_wIAAP__xO2HYg) with a difficult housing market, continuing inflation, and being sandwiched between paying for adult children and aging parents.
## Wendy's Retreats from Surge Pricing Plan
Hammered on social media after announcing a plan to test ["dynamic pricing"](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxskLGO6yAQAL_G7ohgwcYUFK9Jl9deaS2wOJwItoDEyt-fcvWVo2lG83Vbb5hyKtt_fJDtcV_R9_SiVTLBQK1qDDYSAcmRrNDcSC61mce7FUYvoGARKkSvESeDmk_OCQc-mLiMyQIHxSUXgk8zwAV9nJyfwxIc54hiUJxC6nu9fO-p9DvF_N5fVC9-f4zZ3ns_2iD_DXAd4IpHobN91AdqTz7TANeTSng31p51I3bU5FPZ2NNRZZVax2fF0hsLMxi3BCThpZ4CkVBzJBNocS6SFmO14ThTzqnNelB8e2DKvxn9ryc_AQAA___F62Ot) of its menu items in 2025, Wendy's now says it won't "implement that practice." CEO Kirk Tanner had said Wendy's would invest [$20 million in digital menu boards](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxs0L2OqzAQhuGrMd0gYxNICoqTgi6nXWkb5J8xOIIxsk0s7n6VFFtt-7zTzPf1mB7Kr57m_2rDIbswKZP9CycJDYh2ais7OESBssKh6flNctnfumoZ8NJyrlvemZszujN95-xV9lKjNIIbWflBcNFyyZuGXzohamXcRZvOXq3mXKmGtRytzyHWz-ApL-jWM7ww1iZs1TosOe-JyX9MjEyMpZR6S_RuTIxIcCQmxi0QnkyMJmy7Io9vK0j2hARJnQl8hhIIMhwJIR1xRtijN55mcCGCfktMoFzGCIooHPSJ9iS1efN7XBaVIUFeEKx3DiOSQdCYCyJ9WDAxqgj3e_Ps47eu4mD34tfVp65nLZ835dfPZ_mvmX8CAAD__zp8guY) to update prices in real time without defining how the dynamic pricing model would work. But companies who use it generally charge more when demand is highest -- like lunchtime. A company spokesperson said Tanner's statements were "misconstrued" without giving specifics. Criticism of the plan came from consumers and politicians, who accused the fast-food chain of ["corporate greed"](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxs0LHO2yAUxfGnwRsWYAL2wNAM3lKpU0frBi42KQYLSKy8fZXM33p-y9H_7225QYghrb9hR9N8XsC28MJloJwKucjOGY8ocOjQcM2mgQ16Ut1mFGitR-WExpHzaZKj0mCV5iNMyMdLF4xgQrKBcc4uSogerL_crXKjuzMGwIlk6ELLpX_kkNqGPr7zC0tv895Fs7V2VDL8ImImYj7Ps99r-hgRMyb6rETMe074JmK2eT8gBfxsJyb3rvQO9l-l2Xtan2VFepRgQ1op-IblqxHqRsQMhV6v_CEh_-mKcccZYgxVaSLZukOI3zvtpzb_AwAA__8qTGX0) and "price gouging."

Please particpate in this survey on the Department of Justice.

This sponsored message from Freedom Nation Today is on behalf of Hillsdale College

[](https://links.freedomnationtoday.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=87e45e06fd044209aed899513c3e3149&_e=-aWizAq7uRJlUs1UrVTdwn_FnN3xeVZJs0TBkWwg5ub4c47fR84IMNhRTzo6EhvwkH-FSWZky_Vz2dtjXeLmxqVflj4wg1lda6nwm4Mdd3B6TADzVPUL5Z7ME_3Xambgngg89ifkP_ZCj4ASAE-YFdWPDnSrqYsZ20sGxCivi7-mcZkvaySdECrn4gsjOWWIQUEGR_vXapzAsSnNhwacSzslaoJkvxBMDOlHlMzu91YvhVGP2THURZspVcoSeRXrdnuuvxCRIpvgQ-fTUTi7HmPiGWyhctgDLy0sSEdsuLevhGlCbtnx6gtWmKBFCjmGeaQWRgwcB9QeU8UZvi3GFr1UCsC_kVA4tLGqm-g1h7N_JBvZvj4j-_oBGJ1U3idUiCSpfYLTePp4p_c0Kc1gSQ%3D%3D) Dear Fellow American, Before you move on to your next email—I would appreciate it if you would take a few moments to participate in Hillsdale College's **National Survey on the Department of Justice.** The survey will only take a few moments of your time, and its subject affects your liberty and the very survival of the rule of law in America. **The current administration's weaponization of the Department of Justice is unprecedented in American history.** Instead of protecting your God-given constitutional rights, the administration uses the Department of Justice to attack its political opponents... ...as well as Christians, parents, and anyone who dares to stand up for our constitutional liberties. At the same time, with the help of the media it...
* Covers up a two-tiered justice system that violates your constitutional rights

* Hides the corruption of the ruling class

* Attacks those with traditional viewpoints

**That's why I'm asking you to take the Hillsdale College National Survey on the Department of Justice.** By completing this survey, you will help us more clearly understand the views of mainstream Americans like you on this critical issue. Your responses will help Hillsdale strengthen its nationwide educational outreach efforts on behalf of liberty—including the importance of the rule of law and checks and balances, which the American Founders saw as essential safeguards against corruption. Friend, you can complete the National Survey on the Department of Justice by using the link below: **[https://lp.hillsdale.edu/department-of-justice-survey/](https://links.freedomnationtoday.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=87e45e06fd044209aed899513c3e3149&_e=-aWizAq7uRJlUs1UrVTdwn_FnN3xeVZJs0TBkWwg5ub4c47fR84IMNhRTzo6EhvwkH-FSWZky_Vz2dtjXeLmxqVflj4wg1lda6nwm4Mdd3B6TADzVPUL5Z7ME_3Xambgngg89ifkP_ZCj4ASAE-YFdWPDnSrqYsZ20sGxCivi7-mcZkvaySdECrn4gsjOWWIQUEGR_vXapzAsSnNhwacSzslaoJkvxBMDOlHlMzu91YvhVGP2THURZspVcoSeRXrjVM2WZZ1nKfjAkpjlQbZxt57L3iKZIBBzi68AjpTPaZo2F1n00zuGdRRdylpcNVPXZjgPU8zeZxC9Iet9OWBnkEPJQoIDg_TdkCq9tCixz6S0brq4sgLH9eSxptNkNREIpA_oROkMo-ZBIjmfE_VVA%3D%3D)** The **Declaration of Independence** argues that **the purpose of just government is to secure our natural rights** and that **just government is founded on the consent of the governed.** Yet today's ruling class regularly disregards the will of the American people, and our rights—to the freedoms of speech, assembly, and religion, to due process, to gun ownership, and more—are under constant attack. **You and I know that liberty in America is under serious threat. But as I travel around the country, I tell the audiences I speak to how we are engaging in the fight against this threat.** A vital part of our efforts in this fight—in which Hillsdale College is a leader—is **reaching** and **teaching** millions of citizens, with the TRUTH about America's great heritage of liberty. We are heavily invested in our educational outreach efforts through our **Project to Defend Liberty Nationwide by Reaching and Teaching Millions.** These efforts include:
* **Teaching bright and principled students** —on our campuses in Hillsdale, Michigan, and Washington, D.C.—who receive a rigorous, **classical liberal arts education, including** a required course on the Constitution

* **Distributing _Imprimis_** , America's leading digest of liberty, which is mailed to more than 6.4 million homes and businesses ten times per year; previous issues include “The Politicization of the Department of Justice” by Harmeet K. Dhillon

* **Producing and promoting free online courses** for any citizen who wishes to learn, on topics such as the Constitution, American history, and free market economics

* **Providing a classical K-12 curriculum** with a solid grounding in American history, constitutional government, and economics to schools that educate thousands of students nationwide

After everything we've seen over the past few years, the need for Hillsdale's educational outreach efforts is undeniable. So please share your views by completing our **National Survey on the Department of Justice** and returning it to me as soon as possible. It will only take a few minutes of your time. Your completed survey will help us form the most effective strategy to **reach** and **teach** millions of Americans on behalf of liberty. As you might know, Hillsdale College is almost unique in American higher education in its refusal to accept EVEN ONE PENNY of government funding—not even indirectly in the form of federal or state student grants or loans. **This independence frees the College from burdensome and corrupting government regulations. But it also means that our work depends entirely on the generous support of private citizens, like you, who understand the importance of education to liberty.** If you agree that we are now seeing an unprecedented assault on the American way of life, I hope you will partner with Hillsdale College by making a generous tax-deductible gift today. You can easily do so after completing the attached **National Survey on the Department of Justice** , which you can access at this secure link: **[https://lp.hillsdale.edu/department-of-justice-survey/](https://links.freedomnationtoday.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=87e45e06fd044209aed899513c3e3149&_e=-aWizAq7uRJlUs1UrVTdwn_FnN3xeVZJs0TBkWwg5ub4c47fR84IMNhRTzo6EhvwkH-FSWZky_Vz2dtjXeLmxqVflj4wg1lda6nwm4Mdd3B6TADzVPUL5Z7ME_3Xambgngg89ifkP_ZCj4ASAE-YFdWPDnSrqYsZ20sGxCivi7-mcZkvaySdECrn4gsjOWWIQUEGR_vXapzAsSnNhwacSzslaoJkvxBMDOlHlMzu91YvhVGP2THURZspVcoSeRXrsReoa0NIsgPwDXoKrxyfxiXq8dNyd6S8N_TKUPRwsIgk0K2fp7pKVGzQSzi-jjHD3VXBFclyyHUR1FlEBK9Ccn3FZtlNR57XVrXTrhD0LXOKTm1Yy2taLozTVR1K5lVC9vZmOcapUqEl8petVXYOZw%3D%3D)** Thank you for your time and attention. I look forward to receiving your completed survey, and I sincerely appreciate your support of Hillsdale's educational outreach efforts on behalf of liberty. Warm regards, Larry P. subject: Survey on the Department of Justice
body:
Please particpate in this survey on the Department of Justice.

This sponsored message from Conservatives Give is on behalf of Hillsdale College

[](https://links.conservativesgive.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=05c8feb4986a4f238043471416a08ad1&_e=lRo2ibZUvhLFC6qsRram4uDYSN6PTVhBVVWuPilF0VigtWSwDeFYg6nvn-hM7XqkcGCtz3_zaGOJ-dizswi2P67DC4kln3fDYisTvKroDoAUKVRAsNzIxh2h-iE8tNm7HLL1A6qYPq4EDWchJu7ALdccHnLLU-Fp7965ofjk2LJBaOuFEmmo4Nm-c_5xzUkr1mZl2kMDw3xlyvbUC8GG5A7A7mwDnfE4g_SUm_-GzymqcudlTJ3CWYReKmproKyhx4TxhpUDbTtNhUhzZyI9BvYoB9PKfVYKPXmq19tUQlDa0VoptLa5UZ-JBN2S_ZMXotmNvo28NYd5_ltSv2F5mnYnGYIM4142IHrTqbMHztACFlp0ZlA01zYSlHFrZynMkCw2EqZJnInKq_OEI6fE-Q%3D%3D) Dear Fellow American, Before you move on to your next email—I would appreciate it if you would take a few moments to participate in Hillsdale College's **National Survey on the Department of Justice.** The survey will only take a few moments of your time, and its subject affects your liberty and the very survival of the rule of law in America. **The current administration's weaponization of the Department of Justice is unprecedented in American history.** Instead of protecting your God-given constitutional rights, the administration uses the Department of Justice to attack its political opponents... ...as well as Christians, parents, and anyone who dares to stand up for our constitutional liberties. At the same time, with the help of the media it...
* Covers up a two-tiered justice system that violates your constitutional rights

* Hides the corruption of the ruling class

* Attacks those with traditional viewpoints

**That's why I'm asking you to take the Hillsdale College National Survey on the Department of Justice.** By completing this survey, you will help us more clearly understand the views of mainstream Americans like you on this critical issue. Your responses will help Hillsdale strengthen its nationwide educational outreach efforts on behalf of liberty—including the importance of the rule of law and checks and balances, which the American Founders saw as essential safeguards against corruption. Friend, you can complete the National Survey on the Department of Justice by using the link below: **[https://lp.hillsdale.edu/department-of-justice-survey/](https://links.conservativesgive.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=05c8feb4986a4f238043471416a08ad1&_e=lRo2ibZUvhLFC6qsRram4uDYSN6PTVhBVVWuPilF0VigtWSwDeFYg6nvn-hM7XqkcGCtz3_zaGOJ-dizswi2P67DC4kln3fDYisTvKroDoAUKVRAsNzIxh2h-iE8tNm7HLL1A6qYPq4EDWchJu7ALdccHnLLU-Fp7965ofjk2LJBaOuFEmmo4Nm-c_5xzUkr1mZl2kMDw3xlyvbUC8GG5A7A7mwDnfE4g_SUm_-GzymqcudlTJ3CWYReKmproKyhDjVE5NGfSpzP5xBJbWsR3SehiPYLqAzWKREISGWtpvXdKxkXMdKvFzAHAnbglJgzgVMj9SJFL6VSr-I23k8MHBcw0yX0lpjoLv03wWBXbT8X5xg-1AUD5u87JpZKZNSUrNIoh8OgHGkRfu8rbTZ28Q%3D%3D)** The **Declaration of Independence** argues that **the purpose of just government is to secure our natural rights** and that **just government is founded on the consent of the governed.** Yet today's ruling class regularly disregards the will of the American people, and our rights—to the freedoms of speech, assembly, and religion, to due process, to gun ownership, and more—are under constant attack. **You and I know that liberty in America is under serious threat. But as I travel around the country, I tell the audiences I speak to how we are engaging in the fight against this threat.** A vital part of our efforts in this fight—in which Hillsdale College is a leader—is **reaching** and **teaching** millions of citizens, with the TRUTH about America's great heritage of liberty. We are heavily invested in our educational outreach efforts through our **Project to Defend Liberty Nationwide by Reaching and Teaching Millions.** These efforts include:
* **Teaching bright and principled students** —on our campuses in Hillsdale, Michigan, and Washington, D.C.—who receive a rigorous, **classical liberal arts education, including** a required course on the Constitution

* **Distributing _Imprimis_** , America's leading digest of liberty, which is mailed to more than 6.4 million homes and businesses ten times per year; previous issues include “The Politicization of the Department of Justice” by Harmeet K. Dhillon

* **Producing and promoting free online courses** for any citizen who wishes to learn, on topics such as the Constitution, American history, and free market economics

* **Providing a classical K-12 curriculum** with a solid grounding in American history, constitutional government, and economics to schools that educate thousands of students nationwide

After everything we've seen over the past few years, the need for Hillsdale's educational outreach efforts is undeniable. So please share your views by completing our **National Survey on the Department of Justice** and returning it to me as soon as possible. It will only take a few minutes of your time. Your completed survey will help us form the most effective strategy to **reach** and **teach** millions of Americans on behalf of liberty. As you might know, Hillsdale College is almost unique in American higher education in its refusal to accept EVEN ONE PENNY of government funding—not even indirectly in the form of federal or state student grants or loans. **This independence frees the College from burdensome and corrupting government regulations. But it also means that our work depends entirely on the generous support of private citizens, like you, who understand the importance of education to liberty.** If you agree that we are now seeing an unprecedented assault on the American way of life, I hope you will partner with Hillsdale College by making a generous tax-deductible gift today. You can easily do so after completing the attached **National Survey on the Department of Justice** , which you can access at this secure link: **[https://lp.hillsdale.edu/department-of-justice-survey/](https://links.conservativesgive.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=05c8feb4986a4f238043471416a08ad1&_e=lRo2ibZUvhLFC6qsRram4uDYSN6PTVhBVVWuPilF0VigtWSwDeFYg6nvn-hM7XqkcGCtz3_zaGOJ-dizswi2P67DC4kln3fDYisTvKroDoAUKVRAsNzIxh2h-iE8tNm7HLL1A6qYPq4EDWchJu7ALdccHnLLU-Fp7965ofjk2LJBaOuFEmmo4Nm-c_5xzUkr1mZl2kMDw3xlyvbUC8GG5A7A7mwDnfE4g_SUm_-GzymqcudlTJ3CWYReKmproKyhTXGW25uv650rqTkLXGzSvoJJNJfL8ur19N1utnJtbbr4yJKnuAm3vAcmWGWdAUfu-eZJBTHf2rVUTpP7bSr8qU9UqVjaI9UAzzZnFdG3x1s3RhECNXZpgps-KBbQX03KEbqJzXU9simxG4GbKFjpEA%3D%3D)** Thank you for your time and attention. I look forward to receiving your completed survey, and I sincerely appreciate your support of Hillsdale's educational outreach efforts on behalf of liberty. Warm regards, Larry P. Arnn President, Hillsdale College Pursuing Truth and Defending Liberty Since 1844 |

| | | You're getting this message because you’ve supported good causes and Democratic candidates. We need your support to continue fighting for our democracy. We love having you in our network, but if you no longer wish to hear from us, you can[ unsubscribe here](https://default.salsalabs.org/Tb81a07be-3272-4703-aceb-3bd8cd6e7cfc/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9) _._

| | | | | Peter, Here’s a simple fact: Supreme Court justices are the only federal judges who aren’t required to follow a binding ethical code. You read that right. Our highest court is held to the lowest ethical standards. And we just saw the consequences of these low standards: Justice Neil Gorsuch failed to recuse himself from major cases that could dismantle environmental and health regulations – which would make millions of dollars for his close friend, oil baron Philip Anschutz. [1] And unfortunately, Peter, this is just the latest in a long list of ethical violations from Justices Clarence Thomas, Samuel Alito, and Neil Gorsuch – from private trips with billionaire donors to undisclosed tuition and real estate deals. [2] We must demand better from our highest court. **[Tell Congress: Pass the Supreme Court Ethics, Recusal, and Transparency Act and create a REAL, enforceable code of conduct to hold SCOTUS accountable.](https://default.salsalabs.org/T9a600ed7-e0d9-43a3-b3e7-72c2907ca8bd/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9)**

---
| Justice Gorsuch has a major, clear cut conflict of interest in these cases. He and Anschutz have had a close personal and financial relationship for decades – Anschutz has hosted Gorsuch for luxury trips and events, and he even lobbied the Bush administration to nominate Gorsuch for his first appointment as a federal judge. [3] But that didn’t stop Gorsuch from participating in these cases, which could loosen regulations for oil and gas companies, including the Anschutz Exploration Corporation, and lead to major profits for Anschutz. [1] Peter, this is yet another example of why we can’t trust Supreme Court justices to hold themselves accountable. Last year, Chief Justice Roberts implemented a weak, non-binding “code of conduct” after a series of high-profile scandals. Some justices have followed it and recused themselves when necessary, but others have failed to do so despite glaring conflicts of interest. [4] The truth is, the only way to ensure ALL justices follow the same common-sense ethical standards is with strong, binding congressional action. [Congress must act now to END Supreme Court corruption and conflicts of interest. Will you join us in demanding a real Supreme Court code of conduct today?](https://default.salsalabs.org/T581ee123-b121-4605-9928-07e34963bde5/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9)

** It's Time to Qualify!!
------------------------------------------------------------

How time flies! In the blink of an eye, we are less than a week away from candidate qualifications here in Georgia. This is an exciting time for the campaign as we get one step closer to flipping the 7th Congressional District and taking back the United States House of Representatives.

If you are unfamiliar with the process, Candidate Qualification Week is the official timeframe when candidates submit the required paperwork and pay the associated fees to have their name on the ballot. This year Qualification is March 4 - March 8. The process is the same for every level of government, with only the location to register and the amount of the fee being different. For federal candidates in Georgia, this is a trip to the Gold Dome in Atlanta with a check for $5,220.
Donate Now (http://secure.actblue.com/donate/christianforga6?utm_source=Christian+For+Congress&utm_campaign=054d45267a-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2024_02_29_07_30_COPY_01&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-6541429b2e-%5BLIST_EMAIL_ID%5D)

**
------------------------------------------------------------

Our race has not been considered worthy of national attention because it is not seen as a winnable contest by the political establishment. I believe it is incredibly important. This is the third congressional district for me in 6 years because Georgia’s Republican controlled government has done its best to change districts to keep themselves in power. At the federal level, Georgia Republicans continue to tow the party line, speaking against future-forward investments while welcoming the new jobs and technological advances the largest infrastructure bill in our history has brought to north Georgia.

This is a challenging time for the Christian for Congress team. We have traveled across north Georgia to listen to voters to understand what is important to you. I have held weekly online meetings to keep you up on what is happening in your government. Despite the massive support in meeting rooms and digital spaces, we are behind. As we approach end-of-month fundraising goals, facing the biggest expense of the race thus far, my monetary support does not meet my online and in-person support. That means that, once again, if those of us who live in the 7th District want the representation, we deserve it will be up to us to take action. So today, we are setting a fundraising goal of $5,000 through this weekend to give us the opportunity to make a strong showing during qualification and allow the campaign to come out swinging in what is sure to be a heated primary season.

Congressional campaigns can cost hundreds of thousands, if not millions, of dollars to run. Fortunately, the Christian for Congress team has perfected ways to run on way less than that -- so I am not asking you for that much money. I do, however, need your help with the little steps along the way. Consider the following giving recommendations:
* The cost of a coffee run
* $20.24
* One dollar for every year of your life

These small amounts make a big difference. If everyone on my email list donates $10, I will reach my $5,000 goal. So please, give what you can keeping in mind two things: the maximum individual donation this cycle is $3,300, and every little bit helps.

Obviously, qualification is critical. Without candidates on the ballot, north Georgians will be deprived of voices that stand for them. The gerrymanderers will have won. We can't let this happen, but, sadly we have already seen this scenario playing out across our state. In both the 11th and 9th Congressional Districts, Democrats have lost great candidates -- Antonio Daza and Mike Ford, respectively -- primarily because of a lack of funding.

Like most grassroots organizations I am blessed to have an overwhelming number of volunteers ready to make phone calls, knock on doors, and do the day-to-day grunt work of campaigning. Dozens of truly talented individuals are generously donating their skills and knowledge to help me build my team in the early stages of this contest. The only ingredient that is missing from the equation is money.

This is a tough question for me. I do not like asking for money. But despite what the media thinks, I believe the 7th Congressional District is important. This is a big mountain to climb and it is going to take all of us to reach the top. As my team continues to build our coalition and make your voices heard across the state and the nation, I can't begin to describe how honored and humbled I am that y'all have allowed me to be your candidate and nominee. It is truly an experience that I will never forget, and I believe it will only be topped by the feelings that will come when you elect me as a United States Representative for the 7th Congressional District of Georgia.

Let’s give them a real race. Help me speak up for you.

Crossover Day at State Capitol
Thursday, Feb 29 - The last day a bill can clear its originating chamber and move to the other chamber for consideration. A bill introduced in the Senate must pass the Senate by the end of Thursday to be considered in the House and vice versa.

Republican Budget Fight
Friday, Mar 1 - Once again, Congressional Republicans are pushing us to the brink of a government shutdown. Anticipate a heated argument and then the passage of another continuing resolution as the GOP continues to fail at problem solving.

Presidential Primary Voting
Early voting for the Presidential Primary continues through March 8, with Saturday voting available this weekend on March 2. The election will be held March 12.

Coffee & Conversations
Saturday, Mar 2 - Meet and greet with residents of Cherokee County.

Candidate Qualification at the Georgia Dome
Monday, Mar 4 - Friday, Mar 8 - Official registration period candidates at all levels in Georgia. Multiple appearances through the week.

7th District Happy Hour
Thursday, March 7 - Meet and greet with residents of the newly drawn 7th Congressional Distrct

I have some exciting news to share with you: the Hawaii Office of Elections has confirmed that we have collected the required signatures to establish the “We The People” party in Hawaii, _with more than three times the required number of signatures submitted._
The “We The People” party will nominate me as its Presidential Candidate.
When I declared my independence from the two-party Washington establishment and announced my campaign for President, I knew it would be an all-out fight.
I knew the Democrat and Republican establishments would stop at nothing to try and block my campaign every step of the way.
_And I knew I couldn’t do any of this without friends like you. Thank you!_
As you know, I’m facing the biggest challenge to my campaign – I must get my name on the ballot in all 50 states and the District of Columbia, a process that will cost nearly $20 million.

name: Lena Moffitt, Evergreen
subject: BREAKING: More work ahead on power plant rules
body:
An update on the standards you fought for
| |
---
| | | [ ](https://actnow.evergreenaction.com/s/2373076/87SdQ4wZ)
---
|
---
| Hi friend,
Across the country, we're winning the fight to build a clean energy future. And our fight isn’t over.

Yesterday, **the Environmental Protection Agency (EPA) shared that it will issue a new rule for existing gas plants** , delaying this portion of the climate pollution standards for the power sector, which you might remember from [our big campaign last year](https://actnow.evergreenaction.com/s/2373077/87SdQ4wZ). EPA is expected to finalize the rules limiting pollution from coal and _new_ gas plants by April. If they do, it will be a major, if incomplete, victory that would not have been possible without your efforts.

As you know, **these rules represent a critical opportunity to cut climate pollution and clean up the power sector—one of the single largest drivers of the climate crisis.** While this isn't the outcome we wanted, we always knew this would be a long, challenging fight. So we're in this until we've not only eliminated pollution from the power sector—but the entire economy. And we'll continue to count on your advocacy and support.

Last year, **you helped us submit nearly 100,000 comments calling on EPA to regulate climate pollution from all coal and gas power plants** , and this announcement takes us one step closer. But we still have more work to do to ensure the Biden administration cuts pollution from existing gas plants, as well, in the next round of rulemaking.

As we look at the road ahead and the two starkly different paths our country could take this year, we need your help, more than ever, to stand up for a just, healthy, and livable future. Thank you for all you've done to get us here and we look forward to continuing the work together.

In solidarity, |
---
| | | [ ](https://actnow.evergreenaction.com/s/2373078/87SdQ4wZ)
---
### Lena Moffitt
Executive Director
Evergreen Collaborative

FOR IMMEDIATE RELEASE
March 1, 2024

MEDIA CONTACT
Robert Vane
robert@veteranstrategies.com
Suzanne Crouch’s New Broadcast Ad Makes it Clear: She’ll Help Hoosiers who are Fighting Addiction and Punish Murderous Drug Dealers

Crouch pledges to lead where President Biden has failed; treat drug dealers like the murderers they are.
https://vimeo.com/918183427?share=copy&utm_source=Suzanne+Crouch+for+Indiana&utm_campaign=a4fb997fb7-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2024_02_27_01_45_COPY_02&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-98e79e3d9f-%5BLIST_EMAIL_ID%5D
Indianapolis, IND — Conservative candidate for governor Suzanne Crouch launched a new broadcast television advertisement today in which she pledges support for people combating addiction and punishment for drug dealers who are poisoning and murdering Hoosiers.

Crouch’s spot, “A Time for Strength (https://vimeo.com/918183427?share=copy&utm_source=Suzanne+Crouch+for+Indiana&utm_campaign=a4fb997fb7-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2024_02_27_01_45_COPY_02&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-98e79e3d9f-%5BLIST_EMAIL_ID%5D) ”, highlights her personal story of family members who have struggled with addiction and the importance of getting treatment.

“Indiana’s economy cannot reach its full potential if our workers are suffering from mental health and addiction issues,” said Crouch. “As governor I will enhance the state’s mental health services and partner with our terrific non-profits to help some of our most vulnerable citizens.”

According to several sources, more than 480,000 Americans have been killed by fentanyl—a higher death toll for the United States than World War II.

“If President Biden and his Democrat cronies don’t care to end the drug trade at America’s southern border, I will,” said Crouch. “Drug dealers are ruining lives in Indiana, and they should pay for it with their own.”

“It’s clear Evansville and Indiana are a crossroads for fentanyl and drug trafficking coming from the southern border,” said former Vanderburgh County Sheriff Dave Wedding. “Suzanne Crouch is my choice for governor because she supports law enforcement and will make stopping the assault on our southern border and punishing drug dealers a top priority.”

Since its launch in December 2022, the Crouch for Governor campaign has received public pledges of support from more than 100 grassroots leaders—including more than 20 past or
present county sheriffs.

She is the only candidate in the race for governor who has committed to eliminating Indiana’s individual income tax. As a result of Suzanne’s plan, the average Hoosier would save $2,000 in state taxes.

You can learn more about “Axe the Tax” here (https://crouchforindiana.com/axe-the-tax/?utm_source=Suzanne+Crouch+for+Indiana&utm_campaign=a4fb997fb7-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2024_02_27_01_45_COPY_02&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-98e79e3d9f-%5BLIST_EMAIL_ID%5D) .

###

To learn more about how Suzanne is the only conservative Republican fighting China, proposing an elimination of Indiana’s individual income tax, and casting the key votes to protect our most vulnerable Hoosiers, please visit her web site at www.crouchforindiana.com.
