subject: Survey on the Department of Justice
body:
Please particpate in this survey on the Department of Justice.

This sponsored message from Defending the Constitution is on behalf of Hillsdale College

[](https://links.defend-the-constitution.org/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=62af32c7ef414720ab1031c2a79a2a30&_e=NYetq3GBLpkuTptFi7PA0Bnwg6CiysT1ZknIHHddsgWWNFN6GA2v_1Sv95SUwC9-rtMbD8Ft41kTo_YWlvgYTCVCoftmPruY44hdX9Ymu4vJQJyu_tS2Ismu6V1lkg5guSY2lN8xUiPgDXT4pGm0hiSovaxJjaRBsh0DoQox1OeLi26yxc4kqSPJ9tFiIMNVSxqlhcW2WlEH9prOWnuKBUa08xxbGzllYcnBcxuizNxF2duc4t-sSsljAa9TlCszLH5HRXKIgBlQiFaHU2cEdOTT7rQR2TK-q9W-jK2hmAGZ-e0_kGCpZFdxeQiaGHlrXZYprN92qYkvtwPDekCh2FaOO5naKBvhG5NBB1Le0yPsN1w3XVccu-R85-yrCJ3YSl9UEQeCq92QeKUsPwYapg%3D%3D) Dear Fellow American, Before you move on to your next email—I would appreciate it if you would take a few moments to participate in Hillsdale College's **National Survey on the Department of Justice.** The survey will only take a few moments of your time, and its subject affects your liberty and the very survival of the rule of law in America. **The current administration's weaponization of the Department of Justice is unprecedented in American history.** Instead of protecting your God-given constitutional rights, the administration uses the Department of Justice to attack its political opponents... ...as well as Christians, parents, and anyone who dares to stand up for our constitutional liberties. At the same time, with the help of the media it...
* Covers up a two-tiered justice system that violates your constitutional rights

* Hides the corruption of the ruling class

* Attacks those with traditional viewpoints

**That's why I'm asking you to take the Hillsdale College National Survey on the Department of Justice.** By completing this survey, you will help us more clearly understand the views of mainstream Americans like you on this critical issue. Your responses will help Hillsdale strengthen its nationwide educational outreach efforts on behalf of liberty—including the importance of the rule of law and checks and balances, which the American Founders saw as essential safeguards against corruption. Friend, you can complete the National Survey on the Department of Justice by using the link below: **[https://lp.hillsdale.edu/department-of-justice-survey/](https://links.defend-the-constitution.org/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=62af32c7ef414720ab1031c2a79a2a30&_e=NYetq3GBLpkuTptFi7PA0Bnwg6CiysT1ZknIHHddsgWWNFN6GA2v_1Sv95SUwC9-rtMbD8Ft41kTo_YWlvgYTCVCoftmPruY44hdX9Ymu4vJQJyu_tS2Ismu6V1lkg5guSY2lN8xUiPgDXT4pGm0hiSovaxJjaRBsh0DoQox1OeLi26yxc4kqSPJ9tFiIMNVSxqlhcW2WlEH9prOWnuKBUa08xxbGzllYcnBcxuizNxF2duc4t-sSsljAa9TlCszXkhh3fAhCNvk_oGZvSGhgSDRaJzvKrOY8zuDnO880uB-gfZrlzQQ2IKOqRWEAwlMDswofqOlj4xebf0pfVbfcSi0fZwzI1E3yMyz_Bg-yLCLDB316J4WSCro23JRhN2ZaHNw0JN6tDKCrGt8hFgPfA%3D%3D)** The **Declaration of Independence** argues that **the purpose of just government is to secure our natural rights** and that **just government is founded on the consent of the governed.** Yet today's ruling class regularly disregards the will of the American people, and our rights—to the freedoms of speech, assembly, and religion, to due process, to gun ownership, and more—are under constant attack. **You and I know that liberty in America is under serious threat. But as I travel around the country, I tell the audiences I speak to how we are engaging in the fight against this threat.** A vital part of our efforts in this fight—in which Hillsdale College is a leader—is **reaching** and **teaching** millions of citizens, with the TRUTH about America's great heritage of liberty. We are heavily invested in our educational outreach efforts through our **Project to Defend Liberty Nationwide by Reaching and Teaching Millions.** These efforts include:
* **Teaching bright and principled students** —on our campuses in Hillsdale, Michigan, and Washington, D.C.—who receive a rigorous, **classical liberal arts education, including** a required course on the Constitution

* **Distributing _Imprimis_** , America's leading digest of liberty, which is mailed to more than 6.4 million homes and businesses ten times per year; previous issues include “The Politicization of the Department of Justice” by Harmeet K. Dhillon

* **Producing and promoting free online courses** for any citizen who wishes to learn, on topics such as the Constitution, American history, and free market economics

* **Providing a classical K-12 curriculum** with a solid grounding in American history, constitutional government, and economics to schools that educate thousands of students nationwide

After everything we've seen over the past few years, the need for Hillsdale's educational outreach efforts is undeniable. So please share your views by completing our **National Survey on the Department of Justice** and returning it to me as soon as possible. It will only take a few minutes of your time. Your completed survey will help us form the most effective strategy to **reach** and **teach** millions of Americans on behalf of liberty. As you might know, Hillsdale College is almost unique in American higher education in its refusal to accept EVEN ONE PENNY of government funding—not even indirectly in the form of federal or state student grants or loans. **This independence frees the College from burdensome and corrupting government regulations. But it also means that our work depends entirely on the generous support of private citizens, like you, who understand the importance of education to liberty.** If you agree that we are now seeing an unprecedented assault on the American way of life, I hope you will partner with Hillsdale College by making a generous tax-deductible gift today. You can easily do so after completing the attached **National Survey on the Department of Justice** , which you can access at this secure link: **[https://lp.hillsdale.edu/department-of-justice-survey/](https://links.defend-the-constitution.org/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=62af32c7ef414720ab1031c2a79a2a30&_e=NYetq3GBLpkuTptFi7PA0Bnwg6CiysT1ZknIHHddsgWWNFN6GA2v_1Sv95SUwC9-rtMbD8Ft41kTo_YWlvgYTCVCoftmPruY44hdX9Ymu4vJQJyu_tS2Ismu6V1lkg5guSY2lN8xUiPgDXT4pGm0hiSovaxJjaRBsh0DoQox1OeLi26yxc4kqSPJ9tFiIMNVSxqlhcW2WlEH9prOWnuKBUa08xxbGzllYcnBcxuizNxF2duc4t-sSsljAa9TlCszXiqlMEkO7g_PDIElHe2W3bQsHhVnlxC-r5I7TdNw59zNBBgF1R6H1Pp8zC0r5E-sIYreGaZ1u7Vno_hdqL9E1pVtAzUpuBMCpWRjXBd9Uv51d6LkMBSI7kmgG6dCTMz5hTg8bRRUkHid0yg-WVCYjQ%3D%3D)** Thank you for your time and attention. I look forward to receiving your completed survey, and I sincerely appreciate your support of Hillsdale's educational outreach efforts on behalf of liberty. Warm regards, Larry P. Arnn President, Hillsdale College Pursuing Truth and Defending Liberty Since 1844 |

This sponsored message from Defending the Constitution is on behalf of Hillsdale College Dear Fellow American, Before you move on to your next email—I would appreciate it if you would take a few moments to participate in Hillsdale College's National Survey on the Department of Justice. The survey will only take a few moments of your time, and its subject affects your liberty and the very survival of the rule of law in America. The current administration's weaponization of the Department of Justice is unprecedented in American history. Instead of protecting your God-given constitutional rights, the administration uses the Department of Justice to attack its political opponents... ...as well as Christians, parents, and anyone who dares to stand up for our constitutional liberties. At the same time, with the help of the media it... Covers up a two-tiered justice system that violates your constitutional rights Hides the corruption of the ruling class Attacks those with traditional viewpoints That's why I'm asking you to take the Hillsdale College National Survey on the Department of Justice. By completing this survey, you will help us more clearly understand the views of mainstream Americans like you on this critical issue. Your responses will help Hillsdale strengthen its nationwide educational outreach efforts on behalf of liberty—including the importance of the rule of law and checks and balances, which the American Founders saw as essential safeguards against corruption. Friend, you can complete the National Survey on the Department of Justice by using the link below: The Declaration of Independence argues that the purpose of just government is to secure our natural rights and that just government is founded on the consent of the governed. Yet today's ruling class regularly disregards the will of the American people, and our rights—to the freedoms of speech, assembly, and religion, to due process, to gun ownership, and more—are under constant attack. You and I know that liberty in America is under serious threat. But as I travel around the country, I tell the audiences I speak to how we are engaging in the fight against this threat. A vital part of our efforts in this fight—in which Hillsdale College is a leader—is reaching and teaching millions of citizens, with the TRUTH about America's great heritage of liberty. We are heavily invested in our educational outreach efforts through our Project to Defend Liberty Nationwide by Reaching and Teaching Millions. These efforts include: Teaching bright and principled students —on our campuses in Hillsdale, Michigan, and Washington, D.C.—who receive a rigorous, classical liberal arts education, including a required course on the Constitution Distributing Imprimis , America's leading digest of liberty, which is mailed to more than 6.4 million homes and businesses ten times per year; previous issues include “The Politicization of the Department of Justice” by Harmeet K. Dhillon Producing and promoting free online courses for any citizen who wishes to learn, on topics such as the Constitution, American history, and free market economics Providing a classical K-12 curriculum with a solid grounding in American history, constitutional government, and economics to schools that educate thousands of students nationwide After everything we've seen over the past few years, the need for Hillsdale's educational outreach efforts is undeniable. So please share your views by completing our National Survey on the Department of Justice and returning it to me as soon as possible. It will only take a few minutes of your time. Your completed survey will help us form the most effective strategy to reach and teach millions of Americans on behalf of liberty. As you might know, Hillsdale College is almost unique in American higher education in its refusal to accept EVEN ONE PENNY of government funding—not even indirectly in the form of federal or state student grants or loans. This independence frees the College from burdensome and corrupting government regulations. But it also means that our work depends entirely on the generous support of private citizens, like you, who understand the importance of education to liberty. If you agree that we are now seeing an unprecedented assault on the American way of life, I hope you will partner with Hillsdale College by making a generous tax-deductible gift today. You can easily do so after completing the attached National Survey on the Department of Justice , which you can access at this secure link: ** Thank you for your time and attention. I look forward to receiving your completed survey, and I sincerely appreciate your support of Hillsdale's educational outreach efforts on behalf of liberty. Warm regards, Larry P. **Legislative Update**
In the February 2024 Congressional Legislative Update, several significant bills were passed. H.R. 7463 was approved to extend continuing appropriations until March 8, albeit with Luttrell voting against it. Notably, H.R. 7102, focusing on Native American entrepreneurial opportunities, received overwhelming support with Luttrell voting affirmatively. Additionally, H.R. 4984, concerning the revitalization of RFK Memorial Stadium, and H.R. 6544, promoting atomic energy advancement, both passed comfortably, each garnering a 'yes' vote from Luttrell. Strengthening international relations, H.R. 5375, aimed at bolstering the Quad Dialogue, received widespread approval, including from Luttrell. In a significant shift, H.R. 7176 transferred governmental oversight of domestic LNG from the Department of Energy to the Federal Energy Regulatory Commission, passing narrowly with Luttrell's support. Resolutions condemning sexual violence by Hamas in the Israeli War (H.Res. 966) and impeachment efforts against Mayorkas (H.Res. 863) passed, the latter on a razor-thin margin with Luttrell voting affirmatively. Despite mixed results, H.R. 485, focused on healthcare coverage, passed, with Luttrell in favor. H.R. 7217, aiming for Israel's security supplemental appropriations, failed to meet the required threshold for passage, despite Luttrell's support.

name: Congresswoman Katherine Clark
subject: Women’s History is Massachusetts History
disclaimer_text: Paid for by the Massachusetts Democratic State Committee
body:
[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/NGP/NGP31/1/93809/images/Logo.png]
Friends–
Our Commonwealth has been indelibly shaped over the centuries by the contributions of women. From First Lady Abigail Adams to abolitionist Philis Wheatley, to TV icon Mindy Kaling to our first female Governor, Maura Healey, it is no exaggeration to say that women’s history is Massachusetts history.
Today, as your House Democratic Whip and a proud member of Massachusetts’ congressional delegation, I am honored every day to serve the people of this state alongside women whose intelligence, capability, and fortitude never ceases to inspire me – among them Congresswomen Lori Trahan and Ayanna Pressley and Senator Elizabeth Warren. Throughout my career, I have been inspired by the fearless leadership of Speaker Emerita Nancy Pelosi, whose tenure in House leadership was a masterclass in courageousness, confidence, and poise. Together, Democratic women are working to shape the dialogue of our nation and advance our values.
But it was barely a century ago that women did not have the right to vote in this state or any state — despite all the ways they had already shaped our politics. Even after the ratification of the 19th Amendment, women of color had to fight for decades further to be granted their own universal suffrage. [https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/NGP/NGP31/1/93809/images/Whip%20Clark%20Headshot%20%28Short%29.jpeg]
Recent events have forced us to recognize that even the rights we as women hold most dear are not guaranteed. The Trump Supreme Court’s reversal of our long-held reproductive freedom was one of the most shameful days in our recent history. Now, we must fight back. We must elect leaders who will enshrine abortion access into our nation’s constitution, who believe women should make their own health care decisions, and who will stand up for every person’s liberty — no matter their age, race, sexuality, or religion. Leaders who know that our diversity is our strength.
Today, and every day, I am proud to be a Democratic woman from Massachusetts, to stand with a party that knows women are an essential part of our nation’s past and future, and to call a state home that has been so profoundly shaped by women’s history.
With gratitude and an eye toward the future,
Whip Katherine Clark

Friend, when I look at this photo of my mom, I think about how much she sacrificed to give my family our American dream.
[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/80073371/458317287/1820369458?amounts=5,25,50,100&refcode=jtk879-fr-nd&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNDYvMS8xMDc1MjUiLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiZTM2MzJiN2MtZDdkNy1lZTExLTg1ZjktMDAyMjQ4MjIzNzk0IiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=QC0sEixTIllMu7xE0TTfX8LqE6EHlfSbgTcdcthXgh0=)
**When I was 14, my mom made the courageous decision to leave our home in Ecuador and bring my sisters and me to America.** She wanted so badly to give us an incredible education, access to affordable, high-quality health care, and a better life. And she was willing to do anything to make that happen.
When we first arrived in America, my family lived in a small one room apartment. My mom worked hard to pay the bills in those early days, working double shifts as a home health aide, taking English classes at night, and still making time to be an incredible, supportive mom.
I eventually started working at a local doughnut shop in the mornings before school began to help make ends meet. But she never once let our financial difficulties get in the way of my education. She brought us to America to get a chance at a better future, and that started with a strong education.
Because of my mom's sacrifices, her bravery, her support, and her unyielding hope, I was able to graduate high school and college, find a career giving back to my community, and eventually become the first South American immigrant ever elected to Congress. Today, I'm my mom's primary caretaker, and I'm so grateful that I can live with her and give her the care and comfort she deserves after doing so much for my family.
**But there are so many other moms out there who are still struggling to pay the bills, give their kids a shot at a better life, and win their American dream. And every day, that dream is looking further and further out of reach.**

**That's why I'm running for Senate: to give those families the leg up they need.** I'll fight tirelessly to make housing more affordable, increase access to high-quality health care, give more kids the chance to get a college degree, and so much more.

body:
[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/NGP/NGP10/1/81515/images/Newsletter%20Header.jpeg]
Dear Neighbors,
We’re in the last weeks of this legislative session and things are definitely moving fast. Our team is working hard right now to get our Tennessee Waste Reduction and Recycling Act [https://www.reimaginepackagingtennessee.org] over the finish line. This is legislation that was passed in five states that would significantly reduce packaging in our waste-stream. Tennessee ranks 48th in the country for recycling [https://www.ball.com/sustainability/real-circularity/50-states-of-recycling] and our landfills are at capacity. This would make a huge difference in litter and landfill remediation.
As a music business veteran it was great to have my friends in the industry up on the Hill supporting our ELVIS ACT to protect artists from AI.
[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/NGP/NGP10/1/81515/images/IMG_2516.jpg]
This week and next week we will also be running our gun-control legislation. We present bills every year to get guns off of the streets, out of the hands of children, and to make Tennessee safer. Responsible gun owners support our legislation to make Tennessee safer while respecting their rights.
Fiscal accountability continues to be a problem- both with contracts and fund reserves and the amount that we’re spending on litigation and the voucher program. I serve on the Fiscal Review Committee and will continue to work with my team to investigate and illuminate malfeasance.
We’ve pushed hard for passenger rail and now that our TACIR study [https://www.tn.gov/content/dam/tn/tacir/2023publications/2023_PassengerRail.pdf] is complete we are finally starting the process of identifying routes to connect Tennessee to the eastern network. I’ve been meeting regularly with the Tennessee Department of Transportation to monitor progress.
We’re running defense on a lot of crazy legislation of course- bills to ban flags, to criminalize people who help women who leave our state to get abortions, and to make life even harder for our trans friends and families. It’s a presidential election year and so the partisan rhetoric is coming out in full force. I believe that the only way up is through and will continue to work with my colleagues across the aisle and to push back in a civil manner.
We have some town hall meetings coming up- I’d love to see you there. As always please don’t hesitate to reach out to me if I can be of assistance. My cell is 615.438.6338.
Warmly,
Heidi
In The News
Democratic lawmakers push bill to protect children from gun-related deaths [https://www.wkrn.com/news/tennessee-politics/democratic-lawmakers-push-bill-to-protect-children-from-gun-related-deaths/]
Lawmakers file multiple tax bills to help Tennesseans at the cash register [https://www.wjhl.com/news/regional/tennessee/lawmakers-file-multiple-tax-bills-to-help-tennesseans-at-the-cash-register/amp/]
Nashville organizations plan rally for coming weeks to rally lawmakers to address litter and waste [https://www.newschannel5.com/news/nashville-organizations-plan-rally-for-coming-weeks-to-rally-lawmakers-to-address-litter-and-waste]
It’s time to get the party started! Join us for our virtual Volunteer Kick Off meeting for Heidi’s 2024 re-election campaign. We’ll have campaign updates, community volunteer opportunities, and action items. Plus, Heidi will be joining us to share her vision and inspire us all for the exciting journey ahead. See you there! Senator Heidi Campbell and Representatives Vincent Dixie, Aftyn Behn, and Harold Love Jr will be giving updates on what’s going on at the Capitol and answering your questions. We’ll have constituent services available (WeGo, RealID, and more) and the East Nashtivists will be doing voter registration. Bring a friend- it’s going to be a great time!

Resources

Their weather information is helpful, nerdy, and easy to understand and follow, which is especially important in an emergency. Check out their Twitter feed [https://twitter.com/NashSevereWx?ref_src=twsrc^google|twcamp^serp|twgr^author] and website. [https://nashvillesevereweather.com/]
[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/NGP/NGP10/1/81515/images/Screenshot%202024-02-27%20at%205.34.45%E2%80%AFPM.png] Super Tuesday is March 5th, and many important local elections occur- it is not limited to the Presidential Primaries. Find your voting location here [https://maps.nashville.gov/pollingplacefinder/] . Make sure you get out and vote!
[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/NGP/NGP10/1/81515/images/Screenshot%202024-02-28%20at%201.25.49%E2%80%AFPM.png] Tennessee Tree Day is almost here! Reserve your native trees now through March 4th 2024. You will pick up your trees on March 15th or 16th, and plant them on Tree Day: March 16th. Sign up here [https://www.tectn.org/tennesseetreeday.html] .

# Army Combat Veteran Running for Congress in Nevada
---
LAS VEGAS (April 10, 2024)--Retired Army Colonel Mark Robertson is running for U.S. Congress in Nevada's First Congressional District. Robertson enlisted in the Army as a Private, then rose through the ranks to eventually retire as a Colonel. He was deployed to ten foreign countries, including Afghanistan, Iraq, Kuwait, and Syria combat zones.
Nevada's First Congressional District includes Boulder City, most of Henderson, and the parts of Las Vegas and Clark County east of Interstate 15. Robertson raised his family in this district and has strong ties to the community.
Robertson joined the Army at age 17, just after graduating high school. He completed basic training at Fort Jackson, SC. Many years later, Robertson returned to Ft. Jackson and commanded the same company to which he was assigned as a Private. His son would later join the Army and was assigned to the same training battalion.
Robertson and his son, Sergeant Steve Robertson, deployed to Iraq at the same time in 2010-2011. Robertson says, "It was an honor to serve with my son, but it was terrifying for my wife. She flew a flag with two blue stars outside our house for the year we were deployed." In recognition of his service in Iraq, Robertson received the Bronze Star.
Having served in the enlisted and officer ranks, Robertson is uniquely qualified to represent the Veterans in his district. He comes from a military family where both his parents served in the Navy. His dad was a Corpsman attached to the Marine Corps. Robertson understands the issues facing veterans. "I have a lot of respect and love for the men and women who sacrificed to serve our Nation," Robertson says.
When asked why he is running for Congress, Robertson said, "This is not something I ever thought I would do, but I don't like the direction of our country and want to help things get better." In addition to his 30 years of military service, Robertson owned a small business in Henderson. He has a degree in finance from BYU and an MBA. He taught finance at UNLV. "I know how the economy works and how to balance a budget," he said.
Robertson has experience in Washington, D.C. He served in the Pentagon, was on the faculty of the National Defense University, and was a delegate to the Global Coalition Against ISIS. His military awards include the Legion of Merit, Defense Meritorious Service Medal, Airborne Badge, and Good Conduct Medal.
People can learn more about Robertson at his campaign website, [www.RobertsonForCongress.com](https://r20.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001JEiLqee1g8m9nV_NHSnzc5AJSXVWOxi4axEbr1FOLOA0-T4CKJ48UxC0jr4jBCuoWMbe2IX-sJmSgVws6c-O33C3ksKM5YNXuVYZOqID3yQ8SjEQTFnSFQwgItK4Xz6WWre4Qp45NAAwrjWhlankW6VQOAGySFUI&c=ZQW28iClavrCnPB2yzz09jL0pM1Ir5JoRY0cVrUdOqzhz1syIinjZw==&ch=5zdVt6AO-cPdjsBo-qISpgkU62bxlc8r8R2bWYRg7W66oD4_wEISpQ==)

name: Hill Harper
subject: No more attacks on reproductive freedom. Period.
disclaimer_text: PAID FOR BY HILL HARPER FOR MICHIGAN
body:
No government should have ANY say in our decisions to start a family.
# [](https://act.hillharper.com/go/421?t=1&akid=1029%2E62735%2Eh3C0yQ)
**“Senate Republican Blocks Bill to Protect I.V.F. Treatment”**
\- _New York Times_ , 2/28
* * *
I want to make something very clear, Peter: **No government — federal, state, or local — should have _any_ say in when or how to start a family.**
That’s what makes the Alabama Supreme Court’s ruling on IVF treatment so cruel and heartbreaking. We’re talking about people who _just want to be parents_ , so much so that they are willing to undertake the often emotionally (and financially) taxing process of IVF treatment to make their dreams of parenthood a reality.
**As a father,** I can’t even imagine what the Alabamians who rely on this treatment are feeling in the wake of this disastrous ruling. I had the opportunity to make my own dreams of parenthood come true when I adopted my son, Pierce, which is why I’ll fight like hell to make sure Americans from Michigan to Alabama do, too.
**As an American,** I’m worried about what comes next in the GOP’s all-out assault on reproductive freedom and bodily autonomy. Abortion’s overwhelming popularity wasn’t enough to stop the GOP from banning it in red states, and now that Donald Trump has signaled support for a nationwide ban, our future is clear — unless we rise up to stop it.
**So as Michigan’s next Senator,** my promise to you is this: I will _always_ fight to defend our rights and freedoms, shield our communities from the GOP’s invasive agenda, and ensure that decisions about starting a family remain personal and private. **Right now, I need you to join me and call on the Senate to immediately pass federal protections for IVF treatment.**
**[Peter, I’m taking a stand for American families, and I hope you’ll join me and voice your support for this critical fertility treatment option. Please, sign my petition today and urge the Senate to protect IVF treatment _immediately._](https://act.hillharper.com/survey/em_HHR_PET_IVFPetition_030124/?source=em_HHR_PET_IVFPetition_030124&t=2&akid=1029%2E62735%2Eh3C0yQ)**

Thank you for your support,
Hill Harper
Democrat for U.S. Senate

# HAPPY WOMEN’S HISTORY MONTH!
Throughout history, women have been at the forefront of movements for equality, justice, and progress. From the suffragettes who fought tirelessly for the right to vote to the trailblazers who shattered glass ceilings in politics, business, science, and beyond, their courage and resilience have paved the way for a more inclusive and equitable society.
This Women's History Month, we celebrate the remarkable women who have inspired us and continue to inspire us every day. We honor the leaders, the activists, the caregivers, the innovators, and the change-makers who have left their mark on history and continue to make a difference in our lives.
As we reflect on the achievements of women past and present, we also recognize that there is still much work to be done to achieve true gender equality. **Joseph Alfonso is committed to advancing policies that promote gender equity, support women's rights, and create opportunities for women to thrive in every aspect of society.**
Thank you for your continued support. Together, we can build a brighter and more inclusive future for all.
Warm regards,Team Alfonso

name: Elissa Slotkin for Senate
subject: Can you please endorse Elissa Slotkin for Senate?
disclaimer_text: PAID FOR BY ELISSA SLOTKIN FOR MICHIGAN
body:
# [](https://act.elissaslotkin.org/go/188?t=1&akid=1129%2E135344%2EzHKfD6)

We’re writing to express our gratitude for your support throughout our February fundraising push this week – and for bearing with the onslaught of outreach from our team.
These messages can be a lot to wade through, but hopefully you believe these messages are a small price to pay for a Democratic Senate and White House to make progress on the issues you care about.
As you know, the Michigan Republican presidential primary happened a few days ago. But in the weeks before it happened, GOP candidates up and down the ballot used the attention and enthusiasm in the state to capture something called "voter IDs."
A "voter ID" is just a simple declaration of support from potential voters.
It is a campaign contacting a voter, and a voter saying "Yes, I support you," or "No, I am supporting someone else."
These replies are the foundation of any campaign, because it’s how we know where our supporter base exists and who we need to turn out in November.
Before the election, campaigns try to make sure their stated supporters vote. And at other times -- especially when a candidate needs it most -- they will turn to those supporters for help.
So today, we are doing the same. We are asking you to add your name as a "Personal Endorser" of Elissa Slotkin's campaign for Senate. It's a small and simple act, but it will speak volumes about the grassroots support for our campaign:
**[Can Elissa count on you to add your name as a Personal Endorser of her campaign for United States Senate in Michigan? If we're in this together, we'll keep this seat blue in November.](https://act.elissaslotkin.org/signup/endorse-elissa-mar24?source=em240301-1-15&refcode2=1129.135344.zHKfD6&akid=1129%2E135344%2EzHKfD6)**

It will mean a lot to know that Elissa can count on you in this race.
Team Slotkin

name: Harry Dunn
subject: hard email to write
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Seth Moulton for Congress
body:
https://secure.actblue.com/donate/m24-dunn [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/m24-dunn]
Hey there team,
I'll be straight with you, I've done a lot of tough things in my life. I played college football, tried to make it in the NFL and CFL. That was tough, mentally, physically, emotionally.
I served as a Capitol police officer for over 15 years, those were tough some days.
But the aftermath of the January 6 insurrection was one of the toughest things I've been through. My pain, my trauma, it didn't end on January 7.
Even after the violence of that day, I dealt with death threats. I dealt with people harassing me for speaking out. And when I decided to testify in front of Congress? It was one of the toughest things I've ever faced.
But I did testify, because it was my duty not just as an officer, but as an American. I made a big step the day I testified for the January 6 committee. I stepped in the direction of protecting our democracy.
And friend, I've never looked back.
I'm ready to protect our democracy as a Congressman, and I need you to join me. I wouldn’t ask if this fight wasn’t absolutely critical – will you split a donation between Seth Moulton and my campaign? It's going to be tough, but like I said, I'm no stranger to tough. Donate [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/m24-dunn]With love,
Harry 🖤

Friend,

It's John James here. I'm an Army veteran who served for eight years as a Ranger-qualified aviation officer. After serving my country, I worked in business, and I served my community and fellow veterans by focusing on transitioning veterans into civilian jobs.

This inspired me to run for office, and I now have the honor of serving in the House. My seat is one of those hard-fought and narrowly-won races, and it will be again this year.

Retired Navy SEAL Derrick Van Orden knows exactly what I mean when I say __hard-fought and narrowly-won races.__

# [Sign: Demand the Supreme Court rule on Trump’s immunity NOW, not in two months](https://default.salsalabs.org/Tdf71db81-5e1f-4f72-81c1-8662edca7673/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9)

---
| | | The Supreme Court will decide whether Trump has immunity from criminal prosecution for the crimes he committed while he was president. But they won't be hearing arguments until late April, which means we won't have a decision until probably the end of June. **[We can't afford to wait that long. Tell the Supreme Court to rule on Trump's immunity claim NOW, not months from now!](https://default.salsalabs.org/T9a3046c9-97c5-40de-8c05-db089aaaff8e/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9) ** This is an open-and-shut case! Trump's claim that he has full immunity for any crime committed is absurd and wildly dangerous. The Supreme Court's decision on this has massive implications. What could be more important that they need to delay this for two months?! Waiting this long would push Trump's Jan 6 trial further back, allowing the possibility for Trump to win the election and pardon himself. That's not a risk our country can afford to take. [**Sign your name to demand the Supreme Court decide on Trump's immunity NOW – don't delay this critically important decision! >>**](https://default.salsalabs.org/T5f3456e1-d749-40ad-808a-21d5524520d4/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9)

| Friend,
Are you fed up with the gridlock in Washington? Presidential campaigning, congressional dysfunction, and partisan bickering have consumed our day-to-day news and have discouraged many people from participating in our elections and our constitutional republic. I'm here to tell you that there is a different way forward. I am running for Congress to show that we can have honest and honorable public servants who are not going to DC to become career politicians. That is why I support term limits, why I'll put my district ahead of the special interests, and why I'll work every day to make Illinois' 11th District the best place in the country to live and raise a family and we can achieve this through conservative leadership.
To achieve this goal, we need to work together and stop electing the status quo in November. # **A Message from the Chairwoman**
---
| | ** _A Year of Action!_**
---
Friends, We had a wonderful and productive weekend with our bi-annual Congress of Counties event. It was amazing to see friendly faces from all over the State gather to build the party! We are proud to share that over 400 Republicans registered, there were 74 counties represented, and every congressional district was represented! Our team would like to thank all who could to join us for your participation and dedication to making it a special weekend. We can't wait to see you all and many more at our next event! We consider Congress of Counties an important kicking off of the 2024 election cycle. **The party building we accomplished last weekend was only the start!** That is why it is vital for those of you that could not join us to [reach out](http://ci.criticalimpact.com/go/1/f7f15e9875c39250df60ac364a9f256a/40313/7685462797d40dc43947229f28c3afba/dd6b5f2e8e2b5dc2c3d6b838967d376c/40313) and continue to access the training available to you. Our team has been hitting the road the last few months to help county parties add more tools to their toolbox, and we look forward to doing this throughout the rest of the year. It is important that Republicans at every level are prepared to **WIN** in November. 2024 must be a **YEAR OF ACTION.** We are here to help! Our team will assist your organization in topics ranging from data center training, grassroots training, county officer training, fundraising, communications, and many more areas that may be helpful to your county party organizations. Please do not hesitate to reach out and let us know if your organization would like training in an area of need! We are happy to help! Thank you for all that you do.
---
---
Chairwoman Anne F. Hathaway
---

# **Governor Eric Holcomb's Week in Review**
---
| |
# _Gov. Holcomb Speaks at the 34th Annual Lugar Series Luncheon_
---
---
| | [](http://ci.criticalimpact.com/go/1/f7f15e9875c39250df60ac364a9f256a/40313/7685462797d40dc43947229f28c3afba/a15b11e7a91e0cf5c3d6b838967d376c/40313)**Governor Eric Holcomb** [sat down](http://ci.criticalimpact.com/go/1/f7f15e9875c39250df60ac364a9f256a/40313/7685462797d40dc43947229f28c3afba/085a1bcc1db0d712c3d6b838967d376c/40313) with Indiana GOP Chairwoman Anne Hathaway to recognize the accomplishments of the 34th Class of Lugar Series graduates. **Gov. Holcomb** spoke about the amazing work the Lugar Series and their graduates do within their communities and other leadership roles. **What he’s saying** : "I was happy to speak at the 34th Annual Lugar Series Luncheon. This serves as an excellent opportunity for women looking to learn more about government and public service. My administration has benefited from the expertise of many Hoosier women from across the state." - **Gov. Holcomb** said in a [post on X](http://ci.criticalimpact.com/go/1/f7f15e9875c39250df60ac364a9f256a/40313/7685462797d40dc43947229f28c3afba/84bc06d07557e293c3d6b838967d376c/40313). **What else happened this week? Gov. Holcomb** [Hosted](http://ci.criticalimpact.com/go/1/f7f15e9875c39250df60ac364a9f256a/40313/7685462797d40dc43947229f28c3afba/94bf932d4cd47a92c3d6b838967d376c/40313) one of many events planned for the National Security Commission on Emerging Biotechnology.
* To stay up-to-date, follow **Gov. Holcomb** on [Facebook](http://ci.criticalimpact.com/go/1/f7f15e9875c39250df60ac364a9f256a/40313/7685462797d40dc43947229f28c3afba/a784ea5fdf42242ec3d6b838967d376c/40313) or [Twitter](http://ci.criticalimpact.com/go/1/f7f15e9875c39250df60ac364a9f256a/40313/7685462797d40dc43947229f28c3afba/2522252b02b4f427c3d6b838967d376c/40313).

# 👏 Hoosiers From Across the State Came Together for Our 2024 Congress of Counties 🎉

---
---
| | The 2024 elections are going to be the most important elections in recent memory. That is why it was so encouraging to see so many Republicans rally together for a weekend of training, networking, and party building. Republicans are coming together to win big in November! This year's Congress of Counties was a huge success, and Republicans have never been better prepared to secure victory and continue delivering successful Republican leadership for years to come! Thank you to everyone that made it out, we greatly appreciate your dedication! As the Chairwoman mentioned in her message, WE ARE AT YOUR SERVICE. Please [reach out anytime](http://ci.criticalimpact.com/go/1/f7f15e9875c39250df60ac364a9f256a/40313/7685462797d40dc43947229f28c3afba/043dd8b4bfd683e8c3d6b838967d376c/40313) for additional training. We want the Republican Party to continue growing and WINNING in 2024.
---
|

# ✍ Senate President Pro Tem Rodric Bray Wrote an Op-Ed Regarding the U.S. Southern Border
---
---
| | The U.S. - Mexico border has been top of mind for many of our leaders in government. While this issue has traditionally been addressed at the federal level, the incompetence of our current president has forced state leaders across the country to take a stand. While Indiana is not a border state, we are facing border state issues. Border security has become a national security issue. Senate President Pro Tem Rodric Bray [wrote an opinion editorial](http://ci.criticalimpact.com/go/1/f7f15e9875c39250df60ac364a9f256a/40313/7685462797d40dc43947229f28c3afba/f6b729d8776c5f3dc3d6b838967d376c/40313) on this topic, addressing what Hoosier leaders are doing to protect our communities, specifically from the influx of fentanyl. In his op-ed, Senator Bray says, "Indiana has worked too hard for too long fighting the opioid epidemic to see our efforts squandered by a lack of border security." Senator Bray shares the same concerns that Hoosiers across the state have about our southern border. Republican Hoosiers have been taking care of the job left undone by Democrats in D.C. Click below to Read Senator Bray's op-ed and see what Republicans are doing about it.

# 2024 Republican National Convention Internship Program
---
---
Applications are open for the 2024 Republican National Convention Internship Program! The Committee on Arrangements (“COA”) plans for and manages the Republican National Convention. See the one pager with more information above. To apply for the COA Internship Program, please submit the following:
1. [RNC Internship Application](http://ci.criticalimpact.com/go/1/f7f15e9875c39250df60ac364a9f256a/40313/7685462797d40dc43947229f28c3afba/b36ceaf5af509080c3d6b838967d376c/40313). Please include your Resume and Personal Statement with your submission on the application portal
2. Two Letters of Recommendation emailed to coainterns@gopconvention2024.com

To ensure a timely review of your application all materials are due by March 31, 2024. The COA Internship Program is a structured, full-time, unpaid internship, and positions are limited. The COA Internship Program begins Thursday, June 6, 2024 and concludes Sunday, July 21, 2024\. Hours of business are Monday – Friday, 8:30 a.m. – 5:30 p.m. (days and hours subject to change at the discretion of COA or intern supervisors).

body:
[1]Justice Democrats

Peter,

It’s been a busy first two months of 2024 with a lot going on in the
world. I know you’ve been getting a lot of emails (from us and others),
but I just wanted to take a moment to say thank you.

Thank you for standing with Justice Democrats, our bloc of diverse,
progressive, working-class candidates, and our fight for peace and
progress ahead of the consequential elections quickly approaching this
year.

Since the horrible events that took place on October 7th, 2023, Israel’s
military, led by right-wing Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu, has
continued its indiscriminate, all-out assault on Gaza. As of today, at
least 30,000 Palestinians have been killed, including more than 12,000
children, by violence or starvation — and that number is expected to
drastically increase as innocent civilians continue to face bombs,
snipers, and a lack of access to food, clean water, and medical aid.

Just yesterday, more than 100 civilians were killed and hundreds more
injured when Israeli military fired at a crowd of desperate, starving
people clamoring for food for themselves and their families. This is a
man-made famine, and it’s atrocious to see the Israeli military killing
innocent civilians simply trying to survive.

Our incumbents in the Squad had the political courage and moral clarity to
be the first to call for peace back in October, and they’ve been leading
the movement for a permanent ceasefire and the release of all hostages
since then. Though they were smeared by members of both parties and
continue to face millions of dollars in attacks from anti-Palestinian,
pro-war groups like AIPAC, it’s clearer every day that the Squad stood on
the right side of history: the ceasefire movement is currently stronger
than ever.

This week, we saw more than 100,000 voters in Michigan send an undeniable
message to President Joe Biden when they voted “uncommitted” in the
Democratic primary election. Grassroots organizers spearheaded this
campaign in a matter of three weeks and successfully secured 10 times
their goal of 10,000 uncommitted votes from Democrats of all backgrounds.
It goes to show that the Democratic Party establishment should not take a
single vote for granted, and we hope this is a wake-up call for the
President to stop funding Israel's genocide—because his voters are
demanding it.

New polling from Data for Progress also shows that not only do 2/3 of all
likely voters across parties and 77% of Democrats support a permanent
ceasefire, but an overwhelming majority of ALL voters support conditioning
military funding to Israel to ensure Palestinian lives and statehood are
protected. This isn’t a fringe issue: this is where the majority of the
American people across party lines stand, and our elected officials should
listen and act accordingly.

Our fight is far from over. And it’s not just about peace and human rights
abroad, but about justice and progress here in our communities too. If we
lose a single member of the Squad this year to AIPAC-funded primary
challengers, we lose a champion for Medicare for All, the Green New Deal,
student debt forgiveness, and so much more.

Let’s continue to build the pressure for peace through a permanent
ceasefire, end the U.S. complicity in this genocide, and keep true
representatives for the people fighting for us in Congress.

In solidarity,

Alexandra Rojas
Executive Director

New polling from Data for Progress also shows that not only do 2/3 of all likely voters across parties and 77% of Democrats support a permanent ceasefire, but an overwhelming majority of ALL voters support conditioning military funding to Israel to ensure Palestinian lives and statehood are protected. This isn’t a fringe issue: this is where the majority of the American people across party lines stand, and our elected officials should listen and act accordingly. Our fight is far from over. And it’s not just about peace and human rights abroad, but about justice and progress here in our communities too. If we lose a single member of the Squad this year to AIPAC-funded primary challengers, we lose a champion for Medicare for All, the Green New Deal, student debt forgiveness, and so much more. Let’s continue to build the pressure for peace through a permanent ceasefire, end the U.S. complicity in this genocide, and keep true representatives for the people fighting for us in Congress. In solidarity, Alexandra Rojas Executive Director Contribute to Justice Democrats:

Friend,

It's John James here. I'm an Army veteran who served for eight years as a Ranger-qualified aviation officer. After serving my country, I worked in business, and I served my community and fellow veterans by focusing on transitioning veterans into civilian jobs.

This inspired me to run for office, and I now have the honor of serving in the House. My seat is one of those hard-fought and narrowly-won races, and it will be again this year.

Retired Navy SEAL Derrick Van Orden knows exactly what I mean when I say __hard-fought and narrowly-won races.__

That's actually why I'm reaching out - **Derrick Van Orden and I are two veterans who could really use your help to make sure we hold our House Majority, so[we're teaming up in hopes that you'll split a donation between the two of us:](http://post.spmailtechnol.com/f/a/aXhvYW9od73_qvP61ELtDg~~/AARclAA~~~ "we’re teaming up in hopes that you’ll split a donation between the two of us:")**

I'm not a swamp-dwelling politician - I don't have support from mega-donors or Super PACs. I'm just like you - **a concerned American who loves this nation and will always do the right thing.**

[The Democrats are going at me with everything they've got, and I'll need all the help I can get to protect this seat. John

https://rokhanna.com [https://rokhanna.com]

Friend,

President Biden announced this month that his administration has canceled another $1.2 billion [https://www.washingtonpost.com/education/2024/02/21/biden-save-student-loan-forgiveness/] in federal student loan debt, bringing the total debt canceled during his presidency to $138 billion for over 3.9 million people – about 10% of people carrying student debt.

This is an incredible achievement, but we still have a long way to go. Federal student loan debt exceeds $1.6 trillion [https://educationdata.org/student-loan-debt-statistics] , making home ownership, family planning, and retirement out of reach for too many Americans. Student debt has grown more than 500 percent [https://www.cnn.com/2023/10/13/politics/american-student-loans-resume-debt-dg/index.html] over the past 20 years, making it the fastest-growing source of household debt.

Democrats cannot afford to stand by and watch this economic disaster unfold. We need to listen to young people and make education affordable and accessible for all. I’ve put forward a plan designed to do just that [https://themessenger.com/opinion/democrats-cant-be-complacent-student-debt-college-loans-interest-affordability] : forgiving student debt up to $50,000, stopping interest on student debt from accruing, and expanding debt relief programs. President Biden can use the authority granted by the Higher Education Act to enact this plan without Congressional signoff.

Tell President Biden: Adopt the Khanna Plan and cancel student loan debt up to $50,000. clean_body: [] Friend, President Biden announced this month that his administration has canceled another $1.2 billion [] in federal student loan debt, bringing the total debt canceled during his presidency to $138 billion for over 3.9 million people – about 10% of people carrying student debt. This is an incredible achievement, but we still have a long way to go. Federal student loan debt exceeds $1.6 trillion [] , making home ownership, family planning, and retirement out of reach for too many Americans. Student debt has grown more than 500 percent [] over the past 20 years, making it the fastest-growing source of household debt. Democrats cannot afford to stand by and watch this economic disaster unfold. We need to listen to young people and make education affordable and accessible for all. I’ve put forward a plan designed to do just that [] : forgiving student debt up to $50,000, stopping interest on student debt from accruing, and expanding debt relief programs. President Biden can use the authority granted by the Higher Education Act to enact this plan without Congressional signoff. Tell President Biden: Adopt the Khanna Plan and cancel student loan debt up to $50,000. [==] [] We must provide younger Americans with the opportunity to invest in their future – whether buying a home, starting a family, or starting a business. WEEK ENDING 3/1/24
---
---
| Friends, Only 6 more working days until the Virginia General Assembly adjourns sine die. Legislators are scrambling to get through all remaining bills, to include the 2 year budget.
Unfortunately, more gun control bills passed out of both houses this week and are heading to the Governor's desk.
Below is a comprehensive list of bills that have failed and bills that passed out of the Senate.
If you desire to get more information on one of the bills listed below just click the button below for each committee and the bill history and summary is listed.
The Virginia General Assembly will reconvene on April 17 for consideration of the Governor's amendments and vetoes.
Included in this weekly newsletter is a list of important dates for upcoming primaries and elections. Please mark your calendar.

# [#] I just got off the phone with our Finance Team: thanks to people like you, we met our February fundraising goal! I’m so grateful to each and every one of our supporters who have stood with our campaign to bring Jersey Values to Washington. We know that we’ve got a long road ahead to keep this seat blue in November, but I know I can count on our grassroots base to help us win this thing.

As you may have heard in the news, it’s been a busy time on Capitol Hill. I’m working to build bipartisan support to advance commonsense policies like I’ve always done. However, many of my extreme far-right colleagues don’t much feel like working together these days: maybe that’s why the ultra-right is lining up to fund the campaign to flip this seat red.

We count on you to help us keep pace with everything the far-right can throw at us: thank you for standing by my side in this fight for Jersey Values.

Best,

Josh

Hi Peter,

Like me, I’m sure you’re always glad to see the end of the month in the rearview mirror. It’s a stressful time for campaigns because the final days of each month are when we face a financial squeeze and need to ask for extra help from our grassroots supporters — **and I’m proud to say that you came through for us in February: we hit our fundraising goal.** 🎉

Your support is critical to keeping Rhode Island blue this November as we seek to flip the House. From action on common-sense gun safety legislation to protecting our environment, it’s all on the line this year: that’s why I’m so encouraged to have you on my team.

I’ll be in touch soon to share updates from the campaign trail as we build our movement to keep this seat in Democratic hands this November. Thank you again for your support — we truly couldn’t do this without you.

Best,

body:
I won’t stop speaking out.
# [](https://act.leaderswedeserve.com/go/852?refcode=em20240301-1&t=1&akid=431%2E587540%2EI6JYiZ)
Hi Peter, Zooey Zephyr here.
I’ve been a Montana state representative since winning my first election in 2022, and in that time I’ve experienced firsthand how far Republicans are willing to go to **silence young people who dare to hold them accountable for their harmful policies.** Our voices have power and we know this because if they didn’t, Republicans wouldn’t be fighting tooth and nail to stop us.
When Montana’s Republican governor signed a bill that outlawed gender-affirming care for young people, I took him and all of his MAGA GOP colleagues to task on the House floor for the real harm these hateful policies cause. Clearly what I said struck a nerve, because they voted to ban me from speaking on the House floor shortly thereafter. **Make no mistake: As far as MAGA Republicans are concerned, your rights stop where their authority begins—and that should worry us all.**
**But there is good news!** As Republicans continue to foment fear about everything from LGBTQ people to families using IVF, young people like me are standing up across the country and running for office in the hopes of building a better, more inclusive America.
**And this year in Montana, we have the opportunity to break the Republican supermajority that silenced me.**
But in order to make that a reality, we need to vote _out_ the Republicans running the show and vote to _bring_ in some fresh faces and ideas. And that’s why I’m so proud to be a part of Leaders We Deserve as a member of the advisory board.
Leaders We Deserve is gearing up to endorse and support state legislative candidates all over the country this year, and your grassroots support will be critical to helping **each and every one of them** win on Election Day.
Your support of my campaign can have a significant impact, especially in places like my home of Montana where contribution limits are very low. So even $5 can go a long way as many campaigns like mine don’t cost millions of dollars.
[**So Peter, if you want to help replace those standing in the way of progress with young leaders who share our priorities, will you split a $5 donation between my campaign and Leaders We Deserve today?**](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/lwd-em-20240301-1?amount=5&refcode=em20240301-431&refcode2=431_587540_I6JYiZ&akid=431%2E587540%2EI6JYiZ)

Thanks for being a part of this fight,
Zooey Zephyr

# ICYMI: Republican Donors Are Funding The Joanna Weiss Campaign

>From _Slate_ : ["What’s Happening to EMILY’s List?"](https://davemin.us7.list-manage.com/track/click?u=1b97cb6a343b55cba640c3404&id=e675843afa&e=7017cc100e)
_This election cycle, the group has waded into races in ways that threaten to help Republicans—and hurt Democrats._
\- Alexander Sammon
... Rep. Porter is now running for Senate; she [endorsed](https://davemin.us7.list-manage.com/track/click?u=1b97cb6a343b55cba640c3404&id=c5e1ce65a1&e=7017cc100e) Democratic state Sen. Dave Min as her successor in Orange County. But Baugh is back, and Republicans think it’s winnable: CA-47 is atop the National Republican Congressional Committee’s [target list](https://davemin.us7.list-manage.com/track/click?u=1b97cb6a343b55cba640c3404&id=e08cd92f2d&e=7017cc100e) for a blue-to-red flip, and they’re ready to deluge the race with cash. So it makes sense, too, that super PACs that are being funded by overwhelmingly Republican donors would be attracted to the race. The most prominent is called United Democracy Project PAC; it is one of the PACs affiliated with the American Israel Public Affairs Committee. So far, the group has been [funded overwhelmingly by billionaires](https://davemin.us7.list-manage.com/track/click?u=1b97cb6a343b55cba640c3404&id=2ddb48047b&e=7017cc100e) and multimillionaires who are prominent backers of Donald Trump, Rudy Giuliani, and Nikki Haley, and it has only spent in Democratic primaries to weaken Democrats or move the Democratic Party to the right. UDP has now spent [$4.5 million](https://davemin.us7.list-manage.com/track/click?u=1b97cb6a343b55cba640c3404&id=e9da61f1a3&e=7017cc100e) in the race attacking Min, the presumptive Democratic favorite, and boosting Joanna Weiss, his Democratic challenger. It’s the only race where UDP has spent substantially so far this cycle. The AIPAC-allied super PAC Democratic Majority for Israel is also spending in the race. (Though Min has [not called for a ceasefire](https://davemin.us7.list-manage.com/track/click?u=1b97cb6a343b55cba640c3404&id=02fc7672b1&e=7017cc100e) in the Israel-Hamas war, he has pushed for more accountability from Israel’s prime minister, Benjamin Netanyahu.)
[Read The Full Article Here](https://davemin.us7.list-manage.com/track/click?u=1b97cb6a343b55cba640c3404&id=b90c742e15&e=7017cc100e)
Here’s where it gets weird, though. Women Vote PAC, EMILY’s List’s super PAC, has also spent substantially in the race and is also boosting Weiss, to the disadvantage of Min. Weiss is a weaker candidate than Min, to put it charitably. She has never held elected office. She [doesn’t live in the district](https://davemin.us7.list-manage.com/track/click?u=1b97cb6a343b55cba640c3404&id=6a3aaf2df5&e=7017cc100e). Her financial disclosures show [basically zero income](https://davemin.us7.list-manage.com/track/click?u=1b97cb6a343b55cba640c3404&id=231dba0359&e=7017cc100e) over the past handful of years. Weiss is pro-choice, which is good, but, again, having never held elected office, she has a much shorter track record on pro-choice issues than Min, who sports a [100 percent rating](https://davemin.us7.list-manage.com/track/click?u=1b97cb6a343b55cba640c3404&id=59daee2d27&e=7017cc100e) from Planned Parenthood and who [co-authored](https://davemin.us7.list-manage.com/track/click?u=1b97cb6a343b55cba640c3404&id=7013125a33&e=7017cc100e) the state’s constitutional amendment that codified abortion and contraception access in 2022. It is the only race Women Vote PAC has spent in so far this year, to the tune of [$813,000](https://davemin.us7.list-manage.com/track/click?u=1b97cb6a343b55cba640c3404&id=34c0da15c4&e=7017cc100e). EMILY’s List [announced](https://davemin.us7.list-manage.com/track/click?u=1b97cb6a343b55cba640c3404&id=5f9dee7182&e=7017cc100e) it would spent at least $1 million on the race. But it might be more than mere coincidence that EMILY’s List favors the candidate supported by Republican billionaires. According to FEC filings, in the latter half of 2023, Women Vote PAC accepted a [$200,000 donation from UDP](https://davemin.us7.list-manage.com/track/click?u=1b97cb6a343b55cba640c3404&id=c8ce073056&e=7017cc100e) at the same time that UDP was raising millions of dollars from Bernie Marcus, Paul Singer, Bob Kraft, Jan Koum, and other Republican fundraisers, all of whom have donated extensively to extreme, anti-choice Republican politicians. That $200,000 donation made UDP one of the [five largest individual donors](https://davemin.us7.list-manage.com/track/click?u=1b97cb6a343b55cba640c3404&id=60ced253de&e=7017cc100e) to Women Vote PAC in all of 2023. Meanwhile, the PAC is using the EMILY’s List logo and slogan on the mailers it has sent out attacking Min. (Min got a [DUI](https://davemin.us7.list-manage.com/track/click?u=1b97cb6a343b55cba640c3404&id=bb917acd8c&e=7017cc100e) last year, which constitutes the bulk of the attack ads.)
[Read The Full Article Here](https://davemin.us7.list-manage.com/track/click?u=1b97cb6a343b55cba640c3404&id=97a513262c&e=7017cc100e)
... In a broad, pulled-back sense, it’s a little confusing that Republican megadonors would give money to Democrats in these races. But the specific gambit makes perfect sense if you look closely. Even if Min, who is [endorsed by the California Democratic Party](https://davemin.us7.list-manage.com/track/click?u=1b97cb6a343b55cba640c3404&id=d92ff8fffd&e=7017cc100e), finishes in the top two in California’s primary next week—the state holds “jungle primaries,” in which the top two vote-getters head to a runoff, regardless of party affiliation—he could be so wounded by the millions of dollars in attack ads that he’ll be far more vulnerable against the Republican, Baugh. On the other hand, if Weiss is able to beat out Min, the cost of dragging her across the finish line will be much harder for Democrats, given her minimal name recognition and track record. Either way, the seat becomes more likely to flip to Republican control. What’s more confusing is how a pro-choice Democratic group would land on, effectively, the same strategy...

---
Wow, what a month – February truly showcased the impact of our collective efforts at the Jane Fonda Climate PAC. I want to take this moment to celebrate our wins and set the stage for what's next: **Our Galentine's Day Grace and Frankie Reunion was a blast!** Not only did I get the chance to reunite with some of my dearest friends from the show, but with your help – we surpassed our ambitious fundraising goal, proving the power of our community to fight climate change. I also want to give a special thank you to the talented Marta Kauffman, the creative genius behind Grace and Frankie, for her incredible $25,000 match during the event! **I was thrilled to share Jane PAC’s first group of 2024 endorsements!** Here at Jane PAC, we don’t endorse hundreds of candidates. We pride ourselves on making strategic decisions in races where the climate fight is most tangible and where our candidates can benefit the most from this community’s help. Our chosen candidates from California and Oregon to Texas and Pennsylvania are leading the charge in our fight to free our government from the grip of fossil fuel interests. **As we build on this momentum, it's essential to recognize the upcoming California primary on March 5th.** This election is a pivotal moment in the climate fight, with our group of endorsed candidates ready to win and advance our mission. Their victories will be a testament to the power of our collective action and a step closer to enacting the bold policies our planet desperately needs. This is the power of your grassroots support! It's clear that when we come together, united by our mission to save the planet, there's no limit to what we can accomplish. I can’t thank you enough. And we're just getting started. Thank you again for your dedication and passion. name: Forward Party
subject: Voters Want More Choices
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Forward Party and not authorized by any candidate or candidate's committee
body:
It's time we gave them options.

| | [ ](https://home.forwardparty.com/r?u=8bN0s8S48ukOuMaWzZXwkQhKlv5I-M7NyCRBIqr07WA&e=61868e7acdd36ae0ddf3e39aa8429171&utm_source=forwardparty&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=a_fast_forward_25&n=1)
---
Friday, March 01, 2024 | Happy Friday, Peter -- Next week, we'll have the single largest day of voting in primary season, as Super Tuesday sees over a dozen states hosting their elections. This voting will include states large and small from across the country. However, the question isn't who will come out on top, as that's more or less a foregone conclusion. Rather, the question is how large their margin of victory will be. An interesting development through this primary season has been the _lack of enthusiasm_ independent voters are showing for both candidates. Trump hasn't managed to make many inroads with these voters, while Biden is seeing their enthusiasm for him wane compared to their support in 2020. Here at Forward, we're not surprised by this. An increasing majority of this country identifies as unaffiliated, independent, or third party, and yet we're treated as an afterthought. Our votes are taken for granted, with both sides assuming we'll break for them just because the other side is worse, not because of any outreach or concessions made to our priorities. The legacy parties like to imagine that independents are really Republicans or Democrats that just don't like labels. But we, the independents, know that that isn't the case. We have different views and different ways of thinking about problems. We are the majority, and it's time we started organizing around our priorities and approaches so that we can take our country back from the extremes. The 2020 election is important, and our choices in the presidential race are going to be limited to the options put forward by the legacy parties. Let's start building now so that's not the case next cycle. __
[**The Forward Party Is Making Waves In North Carolina**](https://home.forwardparty.com/r?u=Ad-pzZpZoRYVMb-dTcQz7gntqxNTXfO6eQzaWD0k6_D3TgVtVQ5_aj5BSzFOvxZpt4jhiUIxVvc7tqBOqe4lbDPumF2TQ4Vrhwxm_8ex3tY&e=61868e7acdd36ae0ddf3e39aa8429171&utm_source=forwardparty&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=a_fast_forward_25&n=2) | _The Assembly_ Last week, party co-founder Andrew Yang sat down with reporters from _The Assembly_ during his visit to North Carolina to talk all things Forward in the Tar Heel State. Read the article to see just what the plans are for the next couple years. [**The Utah Forward Party Is Running Strong - 6 Candidates Are Already On The Ballot In 2024**](https://www.forwardparty.com/media/2024/02/21/the-utah-forward-party-is-running-strong-6-candidates-are-already-on-the-ballot-in-2024/?e=61868e7acdd36ae0ddf3e39aa8429171&utm_source=forwardparty&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=a_fast_forward_25&n=3) | _Forward Party_ The Utah Forward Party earned party recognition only a couple months ago and they’re _already_ running a slate of candidates in 2024. From State Treasurer to State Senate to School Board, these Utahns are rolling up their sleeves and getting to work. Changing the country starts with elections at home. There are more than 500,000 elected offices in the U.S. and more than 70% of them go uncontested every year. Utah is building from the ground up. [**Forward Party Won't Run A Presidential Candidate - That Doesn't Mean It Won't Matter In 2024**](https://home.forwardparty.com/r?u=DAybff3M8LjaKISnf9bQIsol1sBB0TZlEFvM_erLURWfol8xl10wwzxnQqWrj8xeY2GcKBu_8UtUho1C9XfaimP4Cub0BpwMMf1JugLAW8cHIZ9xHvnd1qV_iI89WPnH&e=61868e7acdd36ae0ddf3e39aa8429171&utm_source=forwardparty&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=a_fast_forward_25&n=4) | _Deseret News_ Our very own founding Co-Chair Governor Christine Todd Whitman sat down with _Deseret News_ last week to talk about Forward Party’s plans for 2024. She got asked the question that many people in the mainstream media have been asking us - what are our plans for 2024 if we’re not running a presidential candidate? The answer is simple. There are more than 500,000 elected offices in the US, and nearly 70% of them are unopposed. Those offices perform critical tasks, like making sure our elections are secure and helping our local towns and cities run smoothly and efficiently. Forward is focused on putting smart and capable candidates in those seats, and research shows that it’ll have an upstream effect on the top of the ballot as well. Read more in the article. __

clean_body: It's time we gave them options. | | Friday, March 01, 2024 | Happy Friday, Peter -- Next week, we'll have the single largest day of voting in primary season, as Super Tuesday sees over a dozen states hosting their elections. This voting will include states large and small from across the country. However, the question isn't who will come out on top, as that's more or less a foregone conclusion. Rather, the question is how large their margin of victory will be. An interesting development through this primary season has been the lack of enthusiasm independent voters are showing for both candidates. Trump hasn't managed to make many inroads with these voters, while Biden is seeing their enthusiasm for him wane compared to their support in 2020. Here at Forward, we're not surprised by this. An increasing majority of this country identifies as unaffiliated, independent, or third party, and yet we're treated as an afterthought. Our votes are taken for granted, with both sides assuming we'll break for them just because the other side is worse, not because of any outreach or concessions made to our priorities. The legacy parties like to imagine that independents are really Republicans or Democrats that just don't like labels. But we, the independents, know that that isn't the case. We have different views and different ways of thinking about problems. We are the majority, and it's time we started organizing around our priorities and approaches so that we can take our country back from the extremes. The 2020 election is important, and our choices in the presidential race are going to be limited to the options put forward by the legacy parties. Let's start building now so that's not the case next cycle. | The Assembly Last week, party co-founder Andrew Yang sat down with reporters from The Assembly during his visit to North Carolina to talk all things Forward in the Tar Heel State. Read the article to see just what the plans are for the next couple years. | Forward Party The Utah Forward Party earned party recognition only a couple months ago and they’re already running a slate of candidates in 2024. From State Treasurer to State Senate to School Board, these Utahns are rolling up their sleeves and getting to work. Changing the country starts with elections at home. There are more than 500,000 elected offices in the U.S. and more than 70% of them go uncontested every year. Utah is building from the ground up. | Deseret News Our very own founding Co-Chair Governor Christine Todd Whitman sat down with Deseret News last week to talk about Forward Party’s plans for 2024. She got asked the question that many people in the mainstream media have been asking us - what are our plans for 2024 if we’re not running a presidential candidate? The answer is simple. There are more than 500,000 elected offices in the US, and nearly 70% of them are unopposed. Those offices perform critical tasks, like making sure our elections are secure and helping our local towns and cities run smoothly and efficiently. name: Lucas Kunce
subject: Thank you so much, Peter.
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Lucas Kunce for Missouri
body:
This week has been incredible.
#
Peter — this week has been incredible.
**On Tuesday, I went back to my hometown of Jefferson City to officially put my name on the ballot for Missouri’s U.S. Senate seat.** More than a hundred supporters from across the state came out to help us kick off our campaign that night, and I was honored to have each and every one of them standing with me.
[](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/44159?refcode=em20240301-4950&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1&akid=4950%2E614464%2EoiXRao)
**We spent the whole week holding Hawley’s feet to the fire on issues impacting so many Missourians** — first on his connections to the Alabama IVF ruling last week, his subsequent lies about supporting IVF and refusal to support efforts to protect it in our state, then about his support for Rick Scott as GOP Senate leader, who’s an active threat to Social Security and Medicare as we know it.
These are exactly the types of winning messages we’ll need to keep getting in front of Missouri voters every day between now and November 5.
[](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/44159?refcode=em20240301-4950&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=2&akid=4950%2E614464%2EoiXRao)
**And finally, last night we faced our February end-of-month fundraising deadline.** This was a short month, even with the extra day, and our flash goal of raising 1,500 individual donations in just 48 hours was aggressive. But I’m happy to report that we didn’t just hit it — we absolutely crushed it, raising well over 2,000 contributions with an average donation of just $25.90.
I’m so proud of everything we’ve accomplished together, Peter. Your support — whether you made a donation, shared one of our ads, or even just opened one of our emails — has helped us build the foundation for a powerful grassroots movement, one that can defeat Josh Hawley and take this Senate seat back for working people.
**All of this is to say: thank you.** I’m so humbled by the trust and support real people like you have put into our campaign from day one.
It’s going to take all of us, working together, to bring home a win in November — and I know this grassroots team has what it takes to make it happen.
Thank you again, for everything, Peter.
Now, let’s get back to work,
— Lucas Kunce

**_— A message from Team Kunce —_** This election is our one and only chance to defeat Josh Hawley and take Missouri’s U.S. Senate seat back for working people. **With multiple polls already showing Lucas and Hawley in a statistical tie, your first-time support right now could be what tips the scales in this neck-and-neck race.** **[Will you chip in $10, $25 or whatever works best for you today so we can continue building the momentum behind this grassroots movement and get Lucas’ message in front of Missouri voters? Supporting our campaign right now could be your chance to make a real difference in 2024.](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/44159?refcode=em20240301-4950&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=3&akid=4950%2E614464%2EoiXRao)** If you've stored your info with ActBlue Express, we'll process your contribution instantly: | [Contribute $10](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/44160?refcode=em20240301-4950&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amount=10&t=4&akid=4950%2E614464%2EoiXRao) [Contribute $25](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/44160?refcode=em20240301-4950&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amount=25&t=5&akid=4950%2E614464%2EoiXRao) [Give another amount](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/44159?refcode=em20240301-4950&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=6&akid=4950%2E614464%2EoiXRao)

name: Beto O'Rourke
subject: Seizing the immigration debate
disclaimer_text: PAID FOR BY POWERED BY PEOPLE
body:
[1]Powered By People

Donald Trump and President Biden both came to the Texas border yesterday,
reminding us what’s at stake in this upcoming election when it comes to
immigration.

Donald Trump used the opportunity to promise a new level of anti-immigrant
cruelty that would exceed that of his first four years in office. Family
separation, a Muslim ban, talk of immigrants “poisoning the blood of
America” — he made clear what we can expect from a second Trump
presidency.

On President Biden’s part, he came to call out the Republican Party for
stonewalling border security reforms and to make the case for why we can’t
afford another four years of Donald Trump on this issue. But there’s one
more thing he can do — and I hope that he will — which is to remind
Americans that immigration is one of the greatest opportunities that we
have as a country.

[ https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=Y9FyyYyix_k?source=ema20240301-239495 ][IMG]

[ https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=Y9FyyYyix_k?source=ema20240301-239495 ]WATCH

At a time when Republicans are defining themselves by how vicious and
cruel they can be to immigrants and asylum seekers, it’s my hope that we
can live up to our promise of being the pro-immigrant party. That we lead
with legislation and executive action that provides legal pathways for
people to come here to contribute to our economy, our communities, and our
success as a nation.

As we support President Biden and our Democratic lawmakers, we also have
an opportunity to push them to lead on this agenda. If we do this, I am
confident that we can give them the power they need to offer a clear
contrast between Republican cruelty and Democratic solutions, making them
stronger candidates in this election and vastly improving what is possible
for immigration policy in this country.

I hope you will join me in that effort.

Beto
