Friend,

I'm the product of an unplanned pregnancy.

Born to two teenage parents, every statistic and societal roadblock indicated that I was destined for a life of hardship.

But my parents didn't buy into any of that.

I may have been unplanned, but that did not mean I was unwanted.

Soon after me, three more kids came. And what began as a teenage love story quickly became a family of six. My dad went to work and did whatever he needed to do to make ends meet for our family. That meant putting his life on the line to serve his community in the local fire department.

All my life, I wanted to be like my dad, and there was nothing I dreamed of more than becoming a firefighter just like him.

But on a fateful day in September of 1984, all of that changed.

My dad and his battalion responded to a call that would change all of our lives forever.

By the grace of God my dad made it out of that building alive, but not unscathed. Eighty percent of his body was covered in burns.

From then on, the hardest working man that I knew would not be able to work as a fireman another day of his life. And as the oldest of four kids, it was up to me to step in and help fill the void in our young family.

We're all a product of our experiences, and that moment defined who I am.

My dream of becoming a firefighter like my dad was now discouraged, and I had effectively been launched into the role of a pseudo-parent to my younger siblings overnight.

**Being raised in a Christian household without a lot of means, we put our head down for two reasons:

1\. To pray to God
2\. To get to work**

So, at 12 years old, I picked myself up by my bootstraps and did just that -- got to work.

And to be quite honest, I haven't really picked my head back up since.

>From a young boy trying to help his parents make ends meet, to a law student, to a husband and father, and eventually to Speaker of the House, the only thing I have ever been focused on is getting the job done.

My wife might call me a workaholic, but in my mind, I am a man who is focused on the task at hand, and completing a mission.

**[Right now, my mission is to ensure that my kids have the same opportunity to make a life for themselves and achieve their goals like I did.](http://links.theusapatriots.com/u/click?_t=e3c9a4cac7f248a39c2a3d920479a441&_m=583dd566ac744d23bc27f526a4b2f63d&_e=hqLqxR84_fMxvq7BSE2UZd2SE1ly89O_0oXdO6WghbAJfPhg5uCyROjhVCDOUw5eLK8-mXwomO0Oat8OVq45hRlmIMjJt-E4f040i0DGJhI4Z_Vk_szdd1M60F0fCxSrTiaeMhRAZREUxPF8P0BZpvmQuDhswVAzDKr2x8KmWUGfJZoAt1STUPjq87_VYI7o1pFPc5PEoELltf8Og9VoNtTrc_YNHONBCHEy0-gEUODKatKxQAly-xdSHr1ipROEvnfinTO3idmqwSvkoRfLsdqhjwtPFX00H7gcDOKuvDC6gZBsHhgF8Ty6-HPkg-M4zG8QlzVyH6Q7K5MhwkijObIiaEorvryg-9Hu3VThGTvSaf-EM32jB1KKsoz8bKa7jqIg4KHhjVL19ayHQOFNFz2mQHh9H76ygLj8yfp4LryQA0yoHgRxMB0s2yP2Kzjuin8B68i_N4KJqxsUwoKZNt4wpbbMR1BNEMnnqb0k0tWNn7j5T5Q1D_RsrAUra-yfN4yvk47Ep5uf68Q-e40sHg%3D%3D "Right now, my mission is to ensure that my kids have the same opportunity to make a life for themselves and achieve their goals like I did. ")**

And that means being the kind of conservative, Christian leader in Washington, D.C. that my dad would be proud of.

That alone puts you at odds with the D.C. Establishment, by the way.

I'm not interested in the cocktail parties, or rubbing elbows with different special interest groups.

The Washington Elite and their allies in the mainstream media can cast judgment all they want. That doesn't bother me.

Because at the end of the day, I know that I serve an audience of one -- and that I am doing all that I can with the blessings given to me, and the faith entrusted to me, to glorify God.

**[So, now that you know just a little bit more about me, where I come from, and what keeps me going, I humbly ask if you are willing to stand alongside me in this fight?](http://links.theusapatriots.com/u/click?_t=e3c9a4cac7f248a39c2a3d920479a441&_m=583dd566ac744d23bc27f526a4b2f63d&_e=hqLqxR84_fMxvq7BSE2UZd2SE1ly89O_0oXdO6WghbAJfPhg5uCyROjhVCDOUw5eLK8-mXwomO0Oat8OVq45hRlmIMjJt-E4f040i0DGJhI4Z_Vk_szdd1M60F0fCxSrTiaeMhRAZREUxPF8P0BZpvmQuDhswVAzDKr2x8KmWUGfJZoAt1STUPjq87_VYI7o1pFPc5PEoELltf8Og9VoNtTrc_YNHONBCHEy0-gEUODKatKxQAly-xdSHr1ipROEvnfinTO3idmqwSvkoRfLsdqhjwtPFX00H7gcDOKuvDC6gZBsHhgF8Ty6-HPkg-M4zG8QlzVyH6Q7K5MhwkijObIiaEorvryg-9Hu3VThGTvSaf-EM32jB1KKsoz8bKa7KhT6BbYwdMzaDFsrR8CPb9TjfnuMxy9FnkIWVAwUmfNgWJ9TMnS6CRv1xDovsE8_Dhji3B00NYk3s6U1x2EkPK_wttT2zVfDJnvJZVsUCUUa_WOlZANGghluhCV6yYeCPpTvMoEBC7Viwgt5Z_c0TQ%3D%3D "So, now that you know just a little bit more about me, where I come from, and what keeps me going, I humbly ask if you are willing to stand alongside me in this fight? | SB 603 Priority Treatment Jailed Pregnant and Addicted Women Passes the House Appropriations Committee
---
|
---
| My bill SB 603, which will give incarcerated pregnant women preferential treatment for drug rehab programs, is headed to the House floor. I have visited the women's jail in Goochland County and I've heard reports around the district about the challenges faced by pregnant women in jail to attend drug rehab programs. Incarcerated pregnant women (those held in federal or state prisons, jails, or juvenile detention facilities) make up one of the most vulnerable segments of society, with higher rates of mental illness, drug addiction, and histories of trauma than incarcerated men. This bill will create a work group to find answers on how to help rehabilitate young and not so young women with the triple threat of being incarcerated, being pregnant, and being addicted.

| Naloxone Training
---
|
---
|
---
| Monday the 26th was Opioid Overdose and Naloxone Education (OONE) Day at the General Assembly. Revive! is the training program implemented by the Department of Behavioral Health and Developmental Services. It is important to know how to correctly administer naloxone for opioid overdose in critical life-saving instances. I had the privilege of participating in the official training and earning my certificate.
In 2018, I passed a bill (HB 1556) that required school nurses to keep naloxone (Brand names: Narcan, Evzio) in their clinics. This measure has helped nurses provide lifesaving interventions in numerous schools across the Commonwealth.

I am working hard with Governor Glenn Youngkin, Lieutenant Governor Winsome Sears, and fellow legislators to make Virginia the best place to live, work, and raise a family. There are so many threats to Virginia: skyrocketing costs, the mess in our schools, the fentanyl streaming across the border. Will the Democrats help us solve these problems? Session will be over March 9th, we have one week to go. Here is some of what is on my mind and what we have been up to: | SB 222 Cyber Security Passes Both Chambers | | My bill SB 222 on cyber security passed both chambers and is headed to the governors desk! With cyber security threats on the rise, it is imperative we take action to secure our Commonwealth's infrastructure and protect tax payer data. | == Dispatchers/ First Responders Passes Both Chambers! | == | My dispatchers bill (SB 630) passed the House and is now awaiting the Governor's signature. Thank you to all first responders for the incredible work you do in keeping our communities safe! == | SB 603 Priority Treatment Jailed Pregnant and Addicted Women Passes the House Appropriations Committee | | My bill SB 603, which will give incarcerated pregnant women preferential treatment for drug rehab programs, is headed to the House floor. I have visited the women's jail in Goochland County and I've heard reports around the district about the challenges faced by pregnant women in jail to attend drug rehab programs. Incarcerated pregnant women (those held in federal or state prisons, jails, or juvenile detention facilities) make up one of the most vulnerable segments of society, with higher rates of mental illness, drug addiction, and histories of trauma than incarcerated men. This bill will create a work group to find answers on how to help rehabilitate young and not so young women with the triple threat of being incarcerated, being pregnant, and being addicted. | CPAC 2024 | | | | | | | | | | | | | | | | | Many Visitors this Week: | | | | | | | | | | | | == My wife Tracy and her father Jack visited the Senate. == | == Robert E. Lee license plate bill == | == Vote no on raising the minimum wage == | | | | | | | | | | Three freedom Friday flag ties! | | | Naloxone Training | | | Monday the 26th was Opioid Overdose and Naloxone Education (OONE) Day at the General Assembly. Revive! is the training program implemented by the Department of Behavioral Health and Developmental Services. It is important to know how to correctly administer naloxone for opioid overdose in critical life-saving instances. I had the privilege of participating in the official training and earning my certificate. In 2018, I passed a bill (HB 1556) that required school nurses to keep naloxone (Brand names: Narcan, Evzio) in their clinics. This measure has helped nurses provide lifesaving interventions in numerous schools across the Commonwealth. | Pastor Visit | | | | ---|--- | Thomas Alvis, pastor of Mount Moriah Church in Powhatan County, came with church members to pray over me in my office. name: John Padora
subject: Celebrating women
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Padora for Colorado
body:
Happy Women’s History Month! As I write to you, I find myself reflecting on the incredible impact women have had on our country and the advancements they’ve made throughout our history in politics, art, culture – everywhere. We’ve made so much progress as a country in terms of gender equality... but there is a danger of backsliding.
__ | | | [](http://links.padoraforcongress.com/u/click?_t=1632d2fd715245289db23a5b99e588cb&_m=44e665ec71ff42ecad3e426b0f4ce655&_e=RYzgqTv2PgFCwyaA8sDfL1fKVPepT4S00l4fDMgXY0AQkleaRb_UL6trIJk9_On0CoSJcJQpGDUsUxKUiEAnisGE-FCW1tEf9GJQs9dAuWcRis_M-IQunbdXEDrpMNnATAUXrAvnFursA7xyeTd1MCFfdPsIfFKqwHeEJEU_w-oQFPyqpCJupBXjE4NZgdDDXX3OOLS0LZRa8-vIGRScZtQdttVo2v86RJCXiAM3nIGqvVLS_69bit102thegIaoLGy09XgZxrHcmOlvaZXy0vxECRPNuwCSEtRrKfRubVex8x_g6_YX2cb6XegqnkyXM9QCx-qgmkcX80sPgZixYG7VLT99-G72pguHNklVMeJV3vHD2HPVtweWmoVS7miRu5uSuS8MoOij2ymToQbFyw%3D%3D) Happy Women’s History Month! As I write to you, I find myself reflecting on the incredible impact women have had on our country and the advancements they’ve made throughout our history in politics, art, culture – everywhere. We’ve made so much progress as a country in terms of gender equality... but there is a danger of backsliding. The Supreme Court overturned _Roe v. Wade_ , making it impossible for millions of women across the country to access an abortion. Now, Alabama has ruled that dropping an IVF sample could mean a felony sentence, effectively shutting down IVF clinics in the state. And every day we hear more rumblings of what a Republican victory in 2024 could mean. National abortion bans, contraception bans, IVF bans, rolling back no-fault divorce laws. Basic rights and liberties are being denied to women simply for being women. Abortion rights and women's rights more generally are on the ballot this November. And throughout this month we need to think about the women who brought our country to this point and what we can do to uphold their legacies. I’ll be working every day to uphold their legacies and protect my daughter’s future by winning this race and voting to codify women's reproductive freedom in Washington. Thank you for your time,

| _Please see a special message from our sponsor. If you would like to unsubscribe, visit this[link](http://links.newsletter.conservativedirect.com/e/encryptedUnsubscribe?_r=5b1853ae48754bee8f471363fe4933a9&_s=e3c941695d6343b68d12ed1488cf4307&_t=MvYjQhro23d-n8BFWlmyTNXMrDPcAu24vobgfNojr2su6nmpq76u1qyE_gRirjFhEilaxKpne1yzkJhrbzj7UBJIHHdrnmE9ZoBJSmOBjVo%3D)_

[](http://links.newsletter.conservativedirect.com/u/click?_t=5b1853ae48754bee8f471363fe4933a9&_m=e3c941695d6343b68d12ed1488cf4307&_e=widrBhlLpVt5CM8yTD3yzxOCt6kup-L3Ui0vKub-RST_U7pqcWZ_pXFEViO6RrjGiiUlcRut9QxT187xw46vDR-5xW_cE7pWytVjbhpASQCBbg_tTcMr5bKETEU0e1NGM6-xDhHIRgOLReyLq2HCkoZ1Y9cGR-k6DTLW2XNkLUHlrWAHc74rTe6gwrn28KEy7nHosy9I5EHpLW4WebGOduftAasdc8w8jDFpcuLv-PutnbotqeI_x0Xd1HR_ZQFercqC3hGZEQ7YpsdobL-UK3Lf5RJeWImEAdftfMIkXReZ_hir0mfCme9yQpDq9TBX5el6XAwZsW2p4ZbvPzvRl70XAaxcEqLt9TE_VisZQQLrhiqU5KHx84Hi66RRGEq6BS3GbHhJQYOelup8Dd3jvg%3D%3D)

Dear Fellow American,

Before you move on to your next email--I would appreciate it if you would take a few moments to participate in Hillsdale College's **National Survey on the Department of Justice.**

The survey will only take a few moments of your time, and its subject affects your liberty and the very survival of the rule of law in America.

**The current administration 's weaponization of the Department of Justice is unprecedented in American history.**

Instead of protecting your God-given constitutional rights, the administration uses the Department of Justice to attack its political opponents...

...as well as Christians, parents, and anyone who dares to stand up for our constitutional liberties.

At the same time, with the help of the media it...

Covers up a two-tiered justice system that violates your constitutional rights
Hides the corruption of the ruling class
Attacks those with traditional viewpoints

**That 's why I'm asking you to take the Hillsdale College National Survey on the Department of Justice.**

By completing this survey, you will help us more clearly understand the views of mainstream Americans like you on this critical issue. Your responses will help Hillsdale strengthen its nationwide educational outreach efforts on behalf of liberty--including the importance of the rule of law and checks and balances, which the American Founders saw as essential safeguards against corruption.

Friend, you can complete the National Survey on the Department of Justice by using the link below:

**[https://lp.hillsdale.edu/department-of-justice-survey/](http://links.newsletter.conservativedirect.com/u/click?_t=5b1853ae48754bee8f471363fe4933a9&_m=e3c941695d6343b68d12ed1488cf4307&_e=widrBhlLpVt5CM8yTD3yzxOCt6kup-L3Ui0vKub-RST_U7pqcWZ_pXFEViO6RrjGiiUlcRut9QxT187xw46vDR-5xW_cE7pWytVjbhpASQCBbg_tTcMr5bKETEU0e1NGM6-xDhHIRgOLReyLq2HCkoZ1Y9cGR-k6DTLW2XNkLUHlrWAHc74rTe6gwrn28KEy7nHosy9I5EHpLW4WebGOduftAasdc8w8jDFpcuLv-PutnbotqeI_x0Xd1HR_ZQFej-UIirvSQllLlDK9RmcGUcxmtdmRvEIt8Z4p4MYi-p7UfAyW0mSTuwCnkxDOUlmr7r_nqfJ7c1eEMdT16Nmk4EZ0R_QZi58SCYpgyXAGp6wF6WL_NwagokjU0r2mU586eU11-mCRq2PYzMxQcL6SSw%3D%3D)**

The **Declaration of Independence** argues that **the purpose of just government is to secure our natural rights** and that **just government is founded on the consent of the governed.**

Yet today's ruling class regularly disregards the will of the American people, and our rights--to the freedoms of speech, assembly, and religion, to due process, to gun ownership, and more--are under constant attack.

**You and I know that liberty in America is under serious threat. But as I travel around the country, I tell the audiences I speak to how we are engaging in the fight against this threat.**

A vital part of our efforts in this fight--in which Hillsdale College is a leader--is **reaching** and **teaching** millions of citizens, with the TRUTH about America's great heritage of liberty.

We are heavily invested in our educational outreach efforts through our **Project to Defend Liberty Nationwide by Reaching and Teaching Millions.**

These efforts include:

**Teaching bright and principled students** --on our campuses in Hillsdale, Michigan, and Washington, D.C.--who receive a rigorous, **classical liberal arts education, including** a required course on the Constitution
**Distributing _Imprimis_** , America's leading digest of liberty, which is mailed to more than 6.4 million homes and businesses ten times per year; previous issues include "The Politicization of the Department of Justice" by Harmeet K. Dhillon
**Producing and promoting free online courses** for any citizen who wishes to learn, on topics such as the Constitution, American history, and free market economics
**Providing a classical K-12 curriculum** with a solid grounding in American history, constitutional government, and economics to schools that educate thousands of students nationwide

After everything we've seen over the past few years, the need for Hillsdale's educational outreach efforts is undeniable.

So please share your views by completing our **National Survey on the Department of Justice** and returning it to me as soon as possible. It will only take a few minutes of your time.

Your completed survey will help us form the most effective strategy to **reach** and **teach** millions of Americans on behalf of liberty.

As you might know, Hillsdale College is almost unique in American higher education in its refusal to accept EVEN ONE PENNY of government funding--not even indirectly in the form of federal or state student grants or loans.

**This independence frees the College from burdensome and corrupting government regulations. But it also means that our work depends entirely on the generous support of private citizens, like you, who understand the importance of education to liberty.**

If you agree that we are now seeing an unprecedented assault on the American way of life, I hope you will partner with Hillsdale College by making a generous tax-deductible gift today. You can easily do so after completing the attached **National Survey on the Department of Justice** , which you can access at this secure link:

**[https://lp.hillsdale.edu/department-of-justice-survey/](http://links.newsletter.conservativedirect.com/u/click?_t=5b1853ae48754bee8f471363fe4933a9&_m=e3c941695d6343b68d12ed1488cf4307&_e=widrBhlLpVt5CM8yTD3yzxOCt6kup-L3Ui0vKub-RST_U7pqcWZ_pXFEViO6RrjGiiUlcRut9QxT187xw46vDR-5xW_cE7pWytVjbhpASQCBbg_tTcMr5bKETEU0e1NGM6-xDhHIRgOLReyLq2HCkoZ1Y9cGR-k6DTLW2XNkLUHlrWAHc74rTe6gwrn28KEy7nHosy9I5EHpLW4WebGOduftAasdc8w8jDFpcuLv-PutnbotqeI_x0Xd1HR_ZQFe-tyL07CXPmirdnI2s6Jw7foVSZIEcsMrapDN9kwB5dpr65xm5NzgYYbRI2f5RrqHydkEWNd5pfrKDwAYrPSvaC5ywHuZoOL9kzTThuVMOsXj7uDJ0kk-JGp2lJjcpeRdEHdR6T6ZBaaJPEAE-7HENA%3D%3D)**

Thank you for your time and attention. I look forward to receiving your completed survey, and I sincerely appreciate your support of Hillsdale's educational outreach efforts on behalf of liberty.

Warm regards,

Larry P. Arnn
President, Hillsdale College
Pursuing Truth and Defending Liberty Since 1844

_U.S. Army Captain John James_

4 Important Things Today
[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/NGP/NGP12/1/92793/images/333331880_6275736075804022_8904139870242530018_n.jpg]
First and foremost, thank you for your help closing February strong. Your contributions to our fight against Trumpism in rural America are going a long way.
CONTRIBUTE [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/about-bob]
Friend, in no particular order:
#1
Thank you.
We're feeling the momentum, expanding our team, and hitting major fundraising milestones to help us secure the Democratic nomination this August and give Rep. Jack Bergman the challenge of a lifetime in November. He has never faced a second-time challenger and I take this very seriously because there's so much at stake.
I'm truly honored
to have your support. [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/about-bob]
____________
#2
Rep. Bergman voted to shut down the government, including the Veterans Affairs.
After taking a two-week hiatus, Bergman joined other MAGA Republicans and voted to shut down the government again before a funding deadline expired. Ultimately, Congress kicked the can down the road for one more week.
Trump insists, "Unless you get everything, shut it down!" Over 75% of Americans and I strongly disagree. This is dysfunctional, unproductive, and not how Americans want to be governed.
If my opponent doesn't believe in a functional government, he doesn't deserve to serve in it.
____________
#3
My disappointment in the failure of ceasefire negotiations
I am deeply saddened and frustrated by the halt in ceasefire negotiations that occurred after Israeli troops opened fire on Palestinians rushing to collect food aid. The situation in Gaza cannot be allowed to escalate.
The world must find a solution that puts an end to the brutal violence. The release of hostages is necessary, as is the defeat of Hamas. But, we must address the two-state solution and call for a ceasefire now.
Enough is enough.
____________
#4
My team is holding a petition drive in Marquette
If you believe in our cause, vote in any county in the MI01, and are in the Marquette area tomorrow, Saturday, March 2, stop by Harlow Park to sign my nominating petitions.
Here are details. [https://www.votedrbob.com/event-details/marquette-petition-drive]
____________
Eternally grateful,
- Dr. Bob
Bob Lorinser
Candidate for US Congress
Northern Michigan / Upper Peninsula
Democrat, MI01

The State Party will provide the most important fact - a kernel of truth - from the week. ** IDP Endorses Jennifer McCormick for Governor The Indiana Democratic Party has officially endorsed Jennifer McCormick for Governor! The State Central Committee voted unanimously this week to endorse Dr. McCormick, and we couldn’t be more excited for her campaign. She knows we must bring more balance back to Indiana. As governor, she’ll always fight to protect Hoosiers’ rights and freedoms, including the right to choose and economic freedom for all families. Republican Supermajority Puts Gun Lobby Over Local Leaders The Republican supermajority is advancing a bill this session that cancels Gary’s ongoing, 25-year lawsuit with gun manufacturers for rising gun violence in the city at the time. This bill would stop any locality from litigating against gun manufacturers for any reason. Only the state AG could bring a lawsuit, which Rokita admits he’ll never do. We shouldn’t be stepping into ongoing litigation, and overturning the decisions of local leaders. This bill shields the gun lobby at the expense of everyday Hoosiers. Each week, the State Party will highlight key policy from Democrats at the Statehouse or across the state. Democrats deliver a better future for Hoosier families, and we urge you to share this information with your networks. State Sen. body:
So much is on the line in this next election — our democracy, our reproductive freedoms, the wellbeing of our planet.

[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/80119450/458423800/-240735101?refcode=email-header&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMDIvMS82NTc1OCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIxYmU2NTY1OS0wOGQ4LWVlMTEtODVmOS0wMDIyNDgyMjM3OTQiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=m-MoZgLwX3M_xSF0PkhxOM6cxortzTUX8FhoHoDQxeI=) Hey — I hope you’re having a nice Friday so far. And in a toss-up race like this, hitting those benchmarks is so, so important for putting our campaign in a position to win. You really came through when it mattered. I also know that, to reach our goal, my team and I sent you... well... a few emails. Perhaps you noticed? Thank you for your patience as we worked so hard to reach this critical goal. So much is on the line in this next election — our democracy, our reproductive freedoms, the wellbeing of our planet. With all the day-to-day silliness of elections, sometimes it can be hard to remember how large the stakes truly are. But when my team and I laid out the fundraising challenge we were facing, and the importance of overcoming it, this grassroots coalition delivered. I could not be more grateful for the incredible folks who helped me get where I am today, and I know that together, we’re going to win another tough fight this November. I’m glad you’re here. With gratitude, Sharice

body:
I co-founded Leaders We Deserve because Gen Z’s answer to the NRA is electing more and more young people to public office to counter their agenda.

| Mark my words, Peter: **Gen Z will outlive the NRA.**

_The Daily Beast_ recently analyzed the NRA’s tax returns. They aren’t pretty.

In fact, the pro-gun group’s revenue has been on the decline for years now, especially since Parkland. _Last year, their fundraising was at its lowest point since 2008. And since 2018 they have lost over 1 million members._

I firmly believe that the NRA’s days are numbered—and as their power and influence fade into the dustbin of history, we will replace their corrupt, purchased politicians with a new generation of bold, courageous leaders who aren’t afraid to take urgent, necessary action to stop the scourge of gun violence in America.

**I co-founded Leaders We Deserve because Gen Z’s answer to the NRA is electing more and more young people to public office to counter their agenda.**

_**[With so much riding on the upcoming elections, we’re preparing now so we can elect the leaders we deserve in November. Will you split a $5 contribution to support Leaders We Deserve and Fight For Progress today?](https://click.everyaction.com/k/80119809/458424639/150752135?refcode=BLU_EM_FFP_2024-03-01_1&amount=5&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9FQS9FQTAwNS8xLzc3NDA2IiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogIjFkYjQwMWZiLTA4ZDgtZWUxMS04NWY5LTAwMjI0ODIyMzc5NCIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=0wLjLH0wir96GgCUo5QG0Yo9Ap5dxXYYTasKuLOFzdk=)**_

We founded Leaders We Deserve last year to elect the next generation of leadership—and folks across the country are already helping us shatter expectations.

Not only have tens of thousands of people just like you joined our movement and helped spread the word about our mission, we’ve already elected our very first candidate.

In the days leading up to the November election, we hit the streets in Virginia to knock on doors and get out the vote for Nadarius Clark. Thanks to our supporters’ donations, we were proud to invest more than $100,000 to support Nadarius’s campaign.

**When all the ballots were counted, Nadarius won by less than 2,000 votes.**

Leaders We Deserve is already playing an integral role in electing the next generation of leaders, and we’re counting on your continued support so we can keep winning these fights in 2024. There is too much on the line for us to lose.

name: Katie Porter
subject: Not one for BS, especially when we’re just days to the election
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Katie Porter for Senate
body:
Most elected officials *hate* to admit that they want power.
# [](https://act.katieporter.com/go/14558?t=1&akid=38527%2E3422442%2EaDLSk6)
I’m not one for BS, Derek, especially not four days before Election Day.
_**So I won’t sugarcoat it: polls are predicting we’re going to lose, and my time in Congress will come to an end for good[(more below, but if you’d like to help us win, please click here).](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/kp4s-em-20240301-2?refcode=em20240301-38527&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&refcode2=38527_3422442_aDLSk6&akid=38527%2E3422442%2EaDLSk6)**_
Because of California’s open primary system, the top two candidates, regardless of party, advance to the general. Republican Steve Garvey and I are **neck and neck for second place** , **with recent polls showing Steve slightly ahead.** But his three point lead is still within the margin of error, and 17% of voters are reportedly undecided about who they’ll support.
So here’s what’s most important: We must do EVERYTHING we can between now and Tuesday to pull ahead. **With less than 15% of ballots returned, this whole race is going to come down to turnout and last minute persuasion.**
We can increase our digital ads literally minute by minute, and so anything you give right now will be put right to use reaching voters. Just **[$15 gets an ad in front of 500 people](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/kp4s-em-20240301-2?refcode=em20240301-38527&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&refcode2=38527_3422442_aDLSk6&akid=38527%2E3422442%2EaDLSk6)** , and in this tight of a race, every single vote is going to count.
**Most elected officials *hate* to admit that they want power.** But I’ll be real—I want power because it will enable us to go after corporate CEOs who are keeping wages low. It will enable me to hold government officials accountable for corruption. And it will allow me to fight for more affordable housing, action on climate change, and a better future for California families.
This race is bigger than just me, and I can’t do this alone. After March 5th it will be too late, but right now we can still pull ahead. **[Is there anything you can give today?](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/kp4s-em-20240301-2?refcode=em20240301-38527&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&refcode2=38527_3422442_aDLSk6&akid=38527%2E3422442%2EaDLSk6)**
[Donate ›››](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/kp4s-em-20240301-2?refcode=em20240301-38527&refcode2=38527_3422442_aDLSk6&akid=38527%2E3422442%2EaDLSk6)
Thank you so, so much.
Katie Porter

Katie is running for the U.S. Senate because Californians deserve a warrior fighting for them in Washington. Our campaign is people-powered, we don’t take a dime from corporate PACs, federal lobbyists, or executives from Big Oil or Big Pharma. **[Donate ›››](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/kp4s-em-footer?refcode=em20240301-38527&amounts=&t=2&refcode2=38527_3422442_aDLSk6&akid=38527%2E3422442%2EaDLSk6)**

body:
I have a plan for a CONSERVATIVE LANDSLIDE in 2024 – here’s the gist:

| |

---
| | | Hey - I'm Byron Donalds.

The Republican National Committee named me the Co-Chairman of their most important initiative for the next election.

_**[I have a plan for a CONSERVATIVE LANDSLIDE in 2024- here's the gist:](http://post.spmailtechnol.com/f/a/TqsyXV4VGutloMW8buS_BQ~~/AARclAA~~~ "I have a plan for a CONSERVATIVE LANDSLIDE in 2024 – here’s the gist:")**_
* If the Democrats vote early, we should push early voting too
* If they can ballot harvest, we should ballot harvest even better
* Invest in an 80,000-person team to ensure your vote is protected
* Mobilize GOP voters through neighbor-to-neighbor contact
* Expand voter contact efforts to connect with young Conservatives
* **Fight BAD ballot harvesting laws - let's make it easy to vote but hard to cheat**

I am proud to lead these efforts and help Conservatives WIN BIG up and down the ballot. These efforts will not only allow us to confront bad actors and stop cheating but will help our Party appeal to younger voters and swing-state independents.

There's just one problem: campaign operations like these are EXPENSIVE. It's not cheap running ads, printing flyers, recruiting volunteers, and expanding voter contact efforts.

_**[That's why I'm coming to you with an important request. Will you pitch in a few bucks to help jumpstart these efforts?](http://post.spmailtechnol.com/f/a/1isIi_ci7NH2C2oxeAwPoA~~/AARclAA~-B7iJlIUZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb21YBAAAAAA~ "That’s why I’m coming to you with an important request. Will you pitch in a few bucks to help jumpstart these efforts?")**_ I know it's a lot to ask but I can promise you this: it'll be worth it when we have **1)** a Conservative House Majority, **2)** a Conservative Senate, and **3)** a Conservative in the White House.

_If that doesn 't convince you to want to help, I don't know what will! Are you in?_

Democrats are early voting in record numbers. Democrats have a sophisticated ballot harvesting operation in deep blue cities. And Democrats are all over social media platforms getting young Liberal voters to register.

**If we don 't do it too, we will lose.**

But make no mistake: We will ONLY be successful with the support of our grassroots team. No matter where you live in the country, this is your chance to directly impact whether Conservative WIN or LOSE the next election.

Will you do your part?

I look forward to seeing your name.

Thank you,

Byron Donalds

Happy March, team!

It’s only been two months since 2024 began, but Jason and our team have been hard at work.

— Jason announced his re-election campaign for CO-06
— We’re recruiting volunteers across the district to get Jason on the ballot
— We fought back against a new, desperate attack by Lauren Boebert
— All the while, Jason has held town halls to hear from Colorado students, veterans, small business owners, and more about what they need to succeed

Now, we’re getting ready to kick off March — our busiest month yet — with Super Tuesday, the State of the Union, and our very first FEC deadline of the election year.

Grassroots supporters are the reason Jason can serve the people of Colorado, and we don’t take that for granted. So as we prepare for this month and one of the most consequential elections yet, we want to hear your thoughts:

We just released our March Priorities Survey, and we need at least 80 supporters in every city to leave their responses. Will you be 1 of the grassroots supporters right now? [https://act.jasoncrowforcongress.com/a/2024-03-marchsurvey]

body:
| | Veteran to doctor to congressman isn't a path you hear of often, Peter.

But as we get closer to the election on March 5, I want to share a bit about my journey and why I’m the best candidate to serve TX-32. **[If you're already fired up, you can go ahead and make a donation of $5 to help my campaign in these crucial final days.>> ](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/80123310/458435430/1248488860?refcode=em24_240301_GOTV1_fnd_gq_act___DBW_ettx&utm_campaign=em24_240301_GOTV1_fnd_gq_act___DBW_ettx&utm_medium=email&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&firstname=Peter&lastname=&zip=&refcode2=9ce462d9-12d8-ee11-85f9-002248223794&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNTAvMS8xMDU5MjMiLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiOWNlNDYyZDktMTJkOC1lZTExLTg1ZjktMDAyMjQ4MjIzNzk0IiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=9zn0HtOvsib4J5687Lt8kALH40GHigx0fdd-yPAzEMQ=)**

Now, let’s get to it:

Throughout my life, I’ve always answered the call to serve. First, serving my country as an Air Force officer, then completely changing directions to serve my community as a trauma surgeon saving lives.
[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/80123311/458435431/1248488860?refcode=em24_240301_GOTV1_fnd_gq_act___DBW_ettx&utm_campaign=em24_240301_GOTV1_fnd_gq_act___DBW_ettx&utm_medium=email&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&firstname=Peter&lastname=&zip=&refcode2=9ce462d9-12d8-ee11-85f9-002248223794&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNTAvMS8xMDU5MjMiLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiOWNlNDYyZDktMTJkOC1lZTExLTg1ZjktMDAyMjQ4MjIzNzk0IiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=9zn0HtOvsib4J5687Lt8kALH40GHigx0fdd-yPAzEMQ=)
_My dad and me at my medical school graduation_
It was a long and challenging process, but the rewards have been worth it. However, I saw firsthand how our broken healthcare system fails so many in need and I became determined to find solutions. **That’s why jumped at the chance to serve as one of six selected for the most prestigious health policy fellowship in the country — the Robert Wood Johnson Health Policy Fellowship at the National Academy Of Medicine.**

I was immersed in the federal legislative process–meeting with constituents and lobbyists, staffing committee hearings, and crafting legislation. And my decades of experience as a veteran and doctor allowed me to use my unique voice to influence policy and contribute to monumental federal legislation.
[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/80123312/458435432/1248488860?refcode=em24_240301_GOTV1_fnd_gq_act___DBW_ettx&utm_campaign=em24_240301_GOTV1_fnd_gq_act___DBW_ettx&utm_medium=email&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&firstname=Peter&lastname=&zip=&refcode2=9ce462d9-12d8-ee11-85f9-002248223794&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNTAvMS8xMDU5MjMiLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiOWNlNDYyZDktMTJkOC1lZTExLTg1ZjktMDAyMjQ4MjIzNzk0IiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=9zn0HtOvsib4J5687Lt8kALH40GHigx0fdd-yPAzEMQ=)
_Me, my daughter, Abeni, and my wife, Kathianne, with Speaker Nancy Pelosi_
**In Congress, I served as a Health Policy Advisor for Senator Chris Murphy and Speaker Nancy Pelosi.** In Senator Murphy’s office, I helped craft legislation for healthcare and gun safety, including the Bipartisan Safer Communities Act – the most significant gun safety law in a generation. Next, I served in the Office of Speaker Nancy Pelosi. There, I continued working on federal legislation to reduce healthcare costs, bolster the healthcare workforce, and prepare for the next pandemic.

My time in Congress showed me that we can do a lot of good for a lot of people with the right leaders in place. It's what inspired me to run for TX-32 and fight to bring life-saving change to our community.

But as we get closer to the election on March 5, I want to share a bit about my journey and why I’m the best candidate to serve TX-32. = Now, let’s get to it: Throughout my life, I’ve always answered the call to serve. First, serving my country as an Air Force officer, then completely changing directions to serve my community as a trauma surgeon saving lives. = My dad and me at my medical school graduation It was a long and challenging process, but the rewards have been worth it. However, I saw firsthand how our broken healthcare system fails so many in need and I became determined to find solutions. That’s why jumped at the chance to serve as one of six selected for the most prestigious health policy fellowship in the country — the Robert Wood Johnson Health Policy Fellowship at the National Academy Of Medicine. I was immersed in the federal legislative process–meeting with constituents and lobbyists, staffing committee hearings, and crafting legislation. And my decades of experience as a veteran and doctor allowed me to use my unique voice to influence policy and contribute to monumental federal legislation. = Me, my daughter, Abeni, and my wife, Kathianne, with Speaker Nancy Pelosi In Congress, I served as a Health Policy Advisor for Senator Chris Murphy and Speaker Nancy Pelosi. In Senator Murphy’s office, I helped craft legislation for healthcare and gun safety, including the Bipartisan Safer Communities Act – the most significant gun safety law in a generation. Next, I served in the Office of Speaker Nancy Pelosi. There, I continued working on federal legislation to reduce healthcare costs, bolster the healthcare workforce, and prepare for the next pandemic. name: Patti Reilly
subject: The anti-police mob is putting my son in jail
body:
I know you and I have never met. But I’m praying that you’ll help me save my son, Officer Terence Sutton.

Dear Friend,

I know you and I have never met. But I'm praying that you'll help me save my son, Officer Terence Sutton.

This is a picture of Terence and me at a dinner celebrating his graduation from the Police Academy.
[](http://post.spmailtechnol.com/f/a/N-E8PQOyEqwgQs1rRP1Ojw~~/AARclAA~/RgRnxOkmP0SVaHR0cHM6Ly9zZWN1cmUuYW5lZG90LmNvbS9sZWxkZi85NmMxM2ViYy1iNTc1LTQ1NTYtOTg5Ni1iNTBmMTA5MWVlZTA_dXRtX3NvdXJjZT1CREctUkVOJnV0bV9tZWRpdW09RU0mdXRtX2NhbXBhaWduPTIwMjQwMzAxX0JER19MRUxERl9TTUxQX1JFTl9QQS1ST05XA3NwY0IKZdXeTOJlGNpk0FIUZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb21YBAAAAAA~)
I was so proud that night. But I was also terrified.

Terence was going to be patrolling the streets of Washington, DC, where crime is sky-high and politicians side with criminals over cops. But never in my wildest imagination could I have predicted that my son would be _wrongfully_ _convicted_ _of_ _murder_ **- murder of a criminal my son didn't even touch.**

The story is so shocking that if it didn't happen to my son, _I wouldn 't even believe it._ **[And I'm praying you will help me save my son](http://post.spmailtechnol.com/f/a/N-E8PQOyEqwgQs1rRP1Ojw~~/AARclAA~/RgRnxOkmP0SVaHR0cHM6Ly9zZWN1cmUuYW5lZG90LmNvbS9sZWxkZi85NmMxM2ViYy1iNTc1LTQ1NTYtOTg5Ni1iNTBmMTA5MWVlZTA_dXRtX3NvdXJjZT1CREctUkVOJnV0bV9tZWRpdW09RU0mdXRtX2NhbXBhaWduPTIwMjQwMzAxX0JER19MRUxERl9TTUxQX1JFTl9QQS1ST05XA3NwY0IKZdXeTOJlGNpk0FIUZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb21YBAAAAAA~)** - **but first, let me explain what happened.**

Our nightmare started in October of 2020.

Terence was sitting in his patrol car when he received a report that a known gang member, Karon Hylton-Brown, was seen entering a rival gang's territory.

Karon was a violent criminal with a rap sheet a mile long - including drugs, illegal gun possession, and assaults. Earlier that day, he had been seen arguing with a rival gang member who owed him money. Terence and other officers were concerned Karon was planning to get revenge.

So when Terence saw him illegally driving a motorized scooter on the sidewalk without a helmet, he tried to pull Karon over to talk. Instead, Karon took off on the scooter.

Terence watched as Karon sped through traffic, weaving in and out of cars and blowing past red lights and stop signs.

My son knew Karon was putting others at risk, so for 3 minutes he slowly and carefully followed behind in his patrol car.

And then it happened.

Karon veered into an alleyway, drove out the other side without looking and slammed into a passing car.

After several days in the hospital, Karon died from his injuries. And here's where the story takes a shocking turn...

Because Karon was black, and the incident happened just four months after George Floyd's death, the anti-police mob went into frenzy.

They blamed Terence for the accident and smeared him as a racist.

There were protests and even riots. The mob threw rocks at officers, smashed store windows, and set fires.

Anti-police politicians piled on too. Without any evidence, they demanded my son be charged even though he did nothing to cause Karon's death.

The pressure campaign worked, and prosecutors charged my son with _**Second-Degree Murder.**_

When Terence called to tell me about the charges, I was in disbelief. Any sane person could see that Karon's death, while tragic, was no one's fault but his own.

_He_ chose to run from the cops.

_He_ chose to not wear a helmet.

_He_ chose to speed through that alley without looking where he was going.

So, when I learned that Terence could be sentenced to **_sixty_ _years_** in prison for Karon's death, my head started spinning. And it only got worse when the trial began.

You see, the judge refused to allow Terence's legal team to present all of the facts in his defense.

The jury never got to hear that Karon was a known member of a violent gang...

They never got to hear that he was wearing an ankle monitor because of a violent assault he had committed just weeks before...

They never got to hear that he had drugs and thousands of dollars in cash strapped to his leg...

And they never got to hear about the drugs in Karon's system at the time of the crash.

Sitting in the courtroom, I couldn't believe my ears when the jury filed out and declared Terence _**" guilty."**_

He's currently awaiting sentencing.

Now you understand why I'm so heartbroken. The injustice is almost too much to bear.

My son was well-respected by the community he served. He trained many Rookies and set a good example for all of them.

He was even awarded Officer of the Year!

And at the same time the bleeding-heart DC politicians are letting shoplifters, carjackers, and drug dealers walk away scot-free...

...they're trying to put my son - a decorated officer who has received 60 awards and commendations - away for 60 years for something he _didn 't_ _do._

I had almost lost hope, but then we learned about the **Law Enforcement Legal Defense Fund** -or LELDF for short.

If you've ever heard of LELDF, you know they're a national group fighting on behalf of wrongly-accused police officers like Terence. LELDF has helped dozens of innocent cops - and their families - at their lowest moments. And when I got the call from their president, Jason Johnson, I was at my lowest moment.

Not only did LELDF decide to help my son get the legal defense he deserves. They're also raising money to pay for the best attorneys and expert witnesses for Terence.

So I have to ask you one of the toughest questions I've ever asked anyone:

**[Will you help my son Terence fight the unjust charges against him by donating to LELDF?](http://post.spmailtechnol.com/f/a/N-E8PQOyEqwgQs1rRP1Ojw~~/AARclAA~/RgRnxOkmP0SVaHR0cHM6Ly9zZWN1cmUuYW5lZG90LmNvbS9sZWxkZi85NmMxM2ViYy1iNTc1LTQ1NTYtOTg5Ni1iNTBmMTA5MWVlZTA_dXRtX3NvdXJjZT1CREctUkVOJnV0bV9tZWRpdW09RU0mdXRtX2NhbXBhaWduPTIwMjQwMzAxX0JER19MRUxERl9TTUxQX1JFTl9QQS1ST05XA3NwY0IKZdXeTOJlGNpk0FIUZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb21YBAAAAAA~)**

To fund his defense, Terence had to sell his home, his car, his beloved motorcycle, and most of his personal belongings. Everything he owns now fits in just nine small boxes. He has almost nothing left.

If I had anywhere else to turn, I wouldn't be so bold as to ask for your help.

But I already lost my husband. He was a police officer too, and he was so proud that Terence followed in his footsteps. And it makes me cry when I think of how he would feel about what Terence is being put through right now.

I simply can't bear the thought of having another family member ripped away from me.

**[So if you are at all able, would you consider following this link to make a tax-deductible donation to the Law Enforcement Legal Defense Fund to help my Terence?](http://post.spmailtechnol.com/f/a/N-E8PQOyEqwgQs1rRP1Ojw~~/AARclAA~/RgRnxOkmP0SVaHR0cHM6Ly9zZWN1cmUuYW5lZG90LmNvbS9sZWxkZi85NmMxM2ViYy1iNTc1LTQ1NTYtOTg5Ni1iNTBmMTA5MWVlZTA_dXRtX3NvdXJjZT1CREctUkVOJnV0bV9tZWRpdW09RU0mdXRtX2NhbXBhaWduPTIwMjQwMzAxX0JER19MRUxERl9TTUxQX1JFTl9QQS1ST05XA3NwY0IKZdXeTOJlGNpk0FIUZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb21YBAAAAAA~)**

**Any amount - $35, $50, $100, or even $500 or more - will help.**

And because LELDF is a non-profit organization, your gift is completely tax-deductible. But whatever you can afford to give, I ask that you rush it back quickly.

Terence's team is currently looking at every available option to keep his case alive.

**[And you and your $35 contribution could make the difference in Terence being acquitted or spending the next 60 years behind bars.](http://post.spmailtechnol.com/f/a/N-E8PQOyEqwgQs1rRP1Ojw~~/AARclAA~/RgRnxOkmP0SVaHR0cHM6Ly9zZWN1cmUuYW5lZG90LmNvbS9sZWxkZi85NmMxM2ViYy1iNTc1LTQ1NTYtOTg5Ni1iNTBmMTA5MWVlZTA_dXRtX3NvdXJjZT1CREctUkVOJnV0bV9tZWRpdW09RU0mdXRtX2NhbXBhaWduPTIwMjQwMzAxX0JER19MRUxERl9TTUxQX1JFTl9QQS1ST05XA3NwY0IKZdXeTOJlGNpk0FIUZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb21YBAAAAAA~)**

Right now, Terence can only rely on the good nature and generosity of kind neighbors like you.

Thank you for taking the time to read my letter today.

And thank you - in advance - for doing what you can to help all the wrongly-accused officers LELDF is working with. Like Terence.

Sincerely,

Patti Reilly

P.S. I know a few kind words from someone like you will help lift Terence's spirits. This guilty verdict has been so devastating for him. **[So if you choose to make a $35 gift to LELDF, would you also please include a little note-maybe a prayer?](http://post.spmailtechnol.com/f/a/N-E8PQOyEqwgQs1rRP1Ojw~~/AARclAA~/RgRnxOkmP0SVaHR0cHM6Ly9zZWN1cmUuYW5lZG90LmNvbS9sZWxkZi85NmMxM2ViYy1iNTc1LTQ1NTYtOTg5Ni1iNTBmMTA5MWVlZTA_dXRtX3NvdXJjZT1CREctUkVOJnV0bV9tZWRpdW09RU0mdXRtX2NhbXBhaWduPTIwMjQwMzAxX0JER19MRUxERl9TTUxQX1JFTl9QQS1ST05XA3NwY0IKZdXeTOJlGNpk0FIUZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb21YBAAAAAA~)** There's a field on the page for you to do this. Thank you -from the bottom of my heart.
--------

_More such officers who sacrifice so much for will face similar fates unless we speak out and stand up for the brave men and women in blue. The next time you see a police officer in your community, please thank them for their service. To read more about our mission or the other Law Enforcement officers we 're defending, please visit **www.PoliceDefense.org**. And remember -Blue Lives Matter!_

2560 Huntington Ave. Suite 203, Alexandria, VA, 22303_

Restore Our Nation
---

clean_body: As we face another pivotal election with so much on the line for women, it would mean so much to Joe and me to have you in this fight with us. | | | Peter, today is the first day of Women’s History Month, and I couldn’t think of a better way to start this month than by launching Women for Biden-Harris. This is a crucial election for women’s rights, our fundamental freedoms, our families, and our health care. With everything on the line, Joe and I need you in this fight with us. | | | I just can’t believe that we are refighting battles we thought we had already won. Our hard-won progress is being erased by Donald Trump and the MAGA extremists who brags about “killing Roe v. Wade ” and who are attacking our reproductive freedom. Could you imagine the outrageous ruling of the Alabama state Supreme Court blocking access to IVF treatment for couples who desperately want to have children? It’s heartbreaking. When women show up, we win. We are the organizers, the planners, and the mobilizers. The ones who get things done. And that’s exactly what we need to do this election. Together, we will win in November. Jill Biden

Friend, **Social Security is the most successful social program in history, having cut poverty among seniors from 50% to 10%.** It’s still too high, but a critical improvement over the last 90 years. **Republicans claim they want to “save” Social Security, but their plans range from cutting this vital program to privatizing it. Now they’re trying to force through a “fiscal commission” to cut our earned benefits behind closed doors so that voters won’t know who to blame.** In order to actually save Social Security and end poverty among people of all ages, we need to expand benefits for millions of people—and pay for it by finally asking the wealthy to pay their fair share. Unfortunately, right now Social Security contributions are capped after you earn your first $168,600. That means that while 94% of workers pay into Social Security on all of their income, all year long, the wealthy do not. **And this week marks the week where millionaires stop paying into Social Security for the year.** [**Add your name now to demand that we scrap the cap on Social Security contributions and finally make millionaires pay their fair share.**](https://click.actionnetwork.org/ss/c/u001.qUXRBnqZ7T8nxbpAcIVwoUsWLkUMWlo_0JmZttSlm38Rl0EAMX48IJgQ7iCSWsbbNhswdrenXpFNLUfe12KItcqGKl3EshwUlfQTe-VseEs9BbfHXLob0pI0z56gcxzxB1x8MdCvQ8ZEa1_64fw7q3ezO5HU2W4XM9PjPxP_zTFzabIYDLFxTC5IWuYSpLtH1yOejVJdahXyyRGqEbevd0zEJRjDPi1I_J54KnrtgH9y4YjmcdQSjjgPWn3C870G7Rt7Wcz6g2blHCoI7iQr8b3uVTU4fAXXZajpbQSw0K6YMOYos2po6qV4zsH6wnsjxzyBEZVbJG5XNWI489gA_ikMXRuCP2J27Pl9_XwfNiqp71It1Js12KBea8Jptdsz9JNBfGCVukKi8-XgJ2wglMwWjxdyS0d6gAGc-w-OJYPl1SLHjkWtfjI-Eum4avzyOeceXYEnQ5LtvlYV2ix1cpuZlGUzmNyF1FHi-Tp8BMYCWhgQ8bSZjuna54_-PbdXQjIB3eXE5M_njefNAIx8LklWy72WW7x03GdHiAvOkYAIL7nITe5NnHpzdTDdYFqlP2lfFbKo6SzehoQC09QjO6fbRKhZVLBdPfVXOcrnQ9sHG7tQ9CZsq2XYdo0CWlGCB0s6obOU7xl2tbEXNUIiuA/44a/gVoej8kMQ3WgRSmcpFLQ9A/h1/h001.GMmHvhjSgB8QmCU1jGLGYRVvBIB-x1qn3aqjm97OrPk) | [ADD YOUR NAME](https://click.actionnetwork.org/ss/c/u001.qUXRBnqZ7T8nxbpAcIVwoUsWLkUMWlo_0JmZttSlm38Rl0EAMX48IJgQ7iCSWsbbNhswdrenXpFNLUfe12KItcqGKl3EshwUlfQTe-VseEs9BbfHXLob0pI0z56gcxzxB1x8MdCvQ8ZEa1_64fw7q3ezO5HU2W4XM9PjPxP_zTFzabIYDLFxTC5IWuYSpLtH1yOejVJdahXyyRGqEbevd0zEJRjDPi1I_J54KnrtgH9y4YjmcdQSjjgPWn3C870G7Rt7Wcz6g2blHCoI7iQr8b3uVTU4fAXXZajpbQSw0K6YMOYos2po6qV4zsH6wnsjxzyBEZVbJG5XNWI489gA_ikMXRuCP2J27Pl9_XwfNiqp71It1Js12KBea8JptdszWLOro9mRVjT2C-pZhnGWIms8Ta2Wwv4ZvbFQTVbqs_Lq0yZFUfivcosA8yBCIJOr7If74MUDgrKTlCAT9RTm2lXklW1PXEk3nctowdm-MSMBocP8iNCZyNC_HHTd5ZXR2wm6eh1L58DKPz5BXkr-E0aBWEzCmeKXjCQ5GSVbvZjUF30A8717nDP-fHTgDCPo3urwB3twz8CMIRYSFTfOqiIGb--wpssaDHtLK74F9SQTgMG6R936oHDoT0iUdaffWRDO-5DsUPFQA3NRAxUtlw/44a/gVoej8kMQ3WgRSmcpFLQ9A/h2/h001.Z6oBs87VXZFWNCAIeDO5xCBqBwDUusTK91bmYT74kdw)

**In the House, I’m an original co-sponsor of the**** _Social Security Expansion Act_****to increase Social Security benefits, extend the lifespan of the trust fund, and pay for it by having the wealthy finally start paying their fair share.**
If passed, the bill would increase Social Security’s annual benefits by $2,400, increase the Cost of Living Adjustment to better reflect the spending patterns of seniors, and increase the Special Minimum Benefit to help keep low- and no-income workers out of poverty in retirement.
This bill would also extend the lifespan of the Social Security trust fund by 75 years to keep Social Security’s promise for generations to come. And it’s completely paid for by scrapping the payroll tax cap on income over $250,000**―** finally asking the wealthy to pay more of their fair share into Social Security.
[**Click here to add your name and demand millionaires and billionaires pay into Social Security all year long, just like most working people already do.**](https://click.actionnetwork.org/ss/c/u001.qUXRBnqZ7T8nxbpAcIVwoUsWLkUMWlo_0JmZttSlm38Rl0EAMX48IJgQ7iCSWsbbNhswdrenXpFNLUfe12KItcqGKl3EshwUlfQTe-VseEs9BbfHXLob0pI0z56gcxzxB1x8MdCvQ8ZEa1_64fw7q3ezO5HU2W4XM9PjPxP_zTFzabIYDLFxTC5IWuYSpLtH1yOejVJdahXyyRGqEbevd0zEJRjDPi1I_J54KnrtgH9y4YjmcdQSjjgPWn3C870G7Rt7Wcz6g2blHCoI7iQr8b3uVTU4fAXXZajpbQSw0K6YMOYos2po6qV4zsH6wnsjxzyBEZVbJG5XNWI489gA_ikMXRuCP2J27Pl9_XwfNiqp71It1Js12KBea8Jptdsz8juJ_qRxPQJ1WPQg0Y2uK4Y8YIz0m-3iWKHxmZ_76xbH3rHGr8NHilBSZg3CYBDgx5DoGFyZn9yWulSa5hq1sbZ9VXBvOg8iDf98jW3Tk7ZkLRfuOItiFmDkUCdcQKN_0z4kF7O4CboGbRyOqGRL-wB_kt0YefPnMs1_tIPor561aQlbNxL99jPweg0ZaD_U3f457HeR0xT77YOjNKEDbUoleoKMxmtQf9Saj8sA-FmwOmWa1FUVg3MG5Rw12GmCMN7s6lR6M3-HpgCzyzQFwQ/44a/gVoej8kMQ3WgRSmcpFLQ9A/h3/h001.6oX7ZYh6CkdzJFKg7s-_CljM7sJKCwsA_8SOWpDYjn4)

clean_body: Putting seniors and working people first. | | | Friend, Social Security is the most successful social program in history, having cut poverty among seniors from 50% to 10%. It’s still too high, but a critical improvement over the last 90 years. Republicans claim they want to “save” Social Security, but their plans range from cutting this vital program to privatizing it. Now they’re trying to force through a “fiscal commission” to cut our earned benefits behind closed doors so that voters won’t know who to blame. In order to actually save Social Security and end poverty among people of all ages, we need to expand benefits for millions of people—and pay for it by finally asking the wealthy to pay their fair share. Unfortunately, right now Social Security contributions are capped after you earn your first $168,600. That means that while 94% of workers pay into Social Security on all of their income, all year long, the wealthy do not. And this week marks the week where millionaires stop paying into Social Security for the year. | In the House, I’m an original co-sponsor of the Social Security Expansion Actto increase Social Security benefits, extend the lifespan of the trust fund, and pay for it by having the wealthy finally start paying their fair share. If passed, the bill would increase Social Security’s annual benefits by $2,400, increase the Cost of Living Adjustment to better reflect the spending patterns of seniors, and increase the Special Minimum Benefit to help keep low- and no-income workers out of poverty in retirement. This bill would also extend the lifespan of the Social Security trust fund by 75 years to keep Social Security’s promise for generations to come. And it’s completely paid for by scrapping the payroll tax cap on income over $250,000― finally asking the wealthy to pay more of their fair share into Social Security. Together, we’re pushing to end poverty and to build a society that puts seniors and working people first. I’m also advocating to end childhood poverty and end youth homelessness, all through direct payments to help people thrive. Our comprehensive 10 Year Plan is our roadmap to winning the fight for fair maps — and it’s going to be executed in the following phases:
**→ Build.** We’ll continue our challenges to gerrymandered maps and build new mapping infrastructure.
**→ Grow.** We’ll invest in expanding our national and state-based networks to engage in targeted electoral work, push reform efforts, and double down on our accountability efforts.
**→ Execute.** We’ll educate and mobilize this grassroots network to push for reforms and help fight for a fair and accurate 2030 Census.
**→ Win.** And by 2032, we’ll secure fair maps everywhere we can, while continuing to hold legislators accountable and challenging bad maps as needed.
The NDRC is the only organization that has a comprehensive plan to finally secure a long-term victory for fair maps.
**And you know that we have our work cut out for us — the other side is constantly putting up roadblocks to representative democracy. We have a battle-tested plan to fight and win — _but it will take all of us._ **

We launched our 10 Year Plan to achieve long-term victory for fair maps — and thousands of supporters like you have stepped up to say you’re with us for the long haul. Momentum is growing, so we’re doing something special: Anyone who joins us as a Fair Maps Champion with a donation of $30 or more in the next 24 hours will receive a FREE Fair Maps Champion bumper sticker that you can proudly display to show you were with us at the outset of this 10 Year Plan. Let’s do this! — NDRC HQ Friends — We just launched our plan to get to fair maps in 2032, and I'll admit it's hard to fully wrap your head around the timeframe. Ten years is a long time in politics. But A.G. Holder often reminds us to think about Dr. King’s famous quote, “The arc of the moral universe is long, but it bends towards justice.” A.G. Holder often reminds us to think about how the arc of the moral universe doesn’t bend all by itself. It bends because caring, committed people put their hands on that arc and pull it in the right direction. It bends under the relentless pounding of marching feet. It bends because people like you — people like us — are determined to bend it together. I believe that with all my heart. This plan is about us pulling that arc towards justice and not waiting for it to bend on its own. Our 10 Year Plan will protect the fair maps we’ve achieved, prevent anti-democratic Republican efforts to gerrymander maps and undermine our democracy, and propel toward fair redistricting and a more representative democracy. As one of our most valued supporters, you know the movement for fair maps is a long — but worthy — fight. We’ll educate and mobilize this grassroots network to push for reforms and help fight for a fair and accurate 2030 Census. → Win. And by 2032, we’ll secure fair maps everywhere we can, while continuing to hold legislators accountable and challenging bad maps as needed. The NDRC is the only organization that has a comprehensive plan to finally secure a long-term victory for fair maps. And you know that we have our work cut out for us — the other side is constantly putting up roadblocks to representative democracy. body:
This isn't my first rodeo.
Peter, as a guy who’s spent his whole career electing Democrats in tough elections, let me tell you this:
**We will lose our Senate majority if we let the GOP flip Pennsylvania red.**
Not only is Pennsylvania’s senior Senator Bob Casey one of the finest public servants I’ve ever known, but his re-election will decide whether Democrats can hold onto Senate control. With Mitch McConnell effectively only needing to flip one more seat on top of West Virginia, we can’t leave ANYTHING to chance.
Don’t just take it from me — Mitch McConnell said himself that Pennsylvania is one of his top targets, and the media has reported that this is one of 4 Senate Seats most likely to flip.
If you take anything away from this email, it’s this: National Republicans are going to do everything they can to beat Bob Casey this year. We just can’t let it happen. We need to ramp up our efforts in this race ASAP.
[**Please, will you join me in supporting Bob Casey in one of the most competitive Senate races in the country?**](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/casey-em-20240301-2?recurring=1&refcode=em20240301-2&refcode2=2174_552475_tLHSnT&akid=2174%2E552475%2EtLHSnT)

name: Alexandria Ocasio-Cortez
subject: Real change
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Alexandria Ocasio-Cortez for Congress
body:
#
To me, I think the test of a community is — whether it’s physical or digital — are you there for one another? Because this is how we deepen meaning in our lives.
Let's say you reposted something — that’s wonderful. Let's say you showed up to a protest. That’s great, too.
But when the signs are put down and we all go home, what is lasting? Do you have the kind of friends that you can volunteer with?
I represent Rikers Island, which is a horrific jail. It’s probably one of the largest sites of human rights violations for the incarcerated in the United States. And there are a lot of people that post about this, a lot of people that show up to protest this. But when I think about efforts in this space, I think of the people who have, for example, gathered toys to send to children of the incarcerated. They will coordinate letters from their parents that may be incarcerated.
They’re actually healing bonds and trauma in our community. It is something that requires actual relationship. And that can _seem_ really, really hard to get involved in. But it is also some of the most transformative experiences we can have.
One of the most important things to communicate is that **there is no action that’s too small.**
I think sometimes people talk themselves out of things because they feel like: “What can my one letter do? What can my one call to Congress do? What can my one donation or me showing up to a toy drive, or me showing up to an event _actually_ do?”
It does a lot. Because it inspires other people to show up. **It’s like each drop in the ocean thinking that it’s meaningless, when it’s actually the most powerful force on the planet.**
And that’s the key. If you’re speaking up online, that’s wonderful. How are you integrating this into your life?
That, I think, is where we start to see real change happen.

Thank you for reading.
In solidarity,
Alexandria

[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/80127224/458447770/872526041?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzMvMS85NjIxNiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI3OTYyODQ3MS0yMmQ4LWVlMTEtODVmOS0wMDIyNDgyMjM3OTQiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=3Cn-4m_habvPZCTmFz1XEqW59pPcYNwD12EEw86aJfU=&emci=09a514e6-21d8-ee11-85f9-002248223794&emdi=79628471-22d8-ee11-85f9-002248223794&ceid=19445147)
[ ](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/80127225/458447771/872526041?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzMvMS85NjIxNiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI3OTYyODQ3MS0yMmQ4LWVlMTEtODVmOS0wMDIyNDgyMjM3OTQiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=3Cn-4m_habvPZCTmFz1XEqW59pPcYNwD12EEw86aJfU=&emci=09a514e6-21d8-ee11-85f9-002248223794&emdi=79628471-22d8-ee11-85f9-002248223794&ceid=19445147)
Hey there. It’s Felix Frisch – Adam Frisch’s son.
When my dad told us that he was going to run against Lauren Boebert in 2022, I did what most 16-year-olds would do: I took a year off from school to be involved in the campaign.
Technically, I went “online” for school – and yes, I definitely missed all my friends. But I wouldn’t go back and change it for the world.
My dad and I hitched a trailer to our red pickup truck and crisscrossed the entire district, taking turns at the wheel. He shook hands with voters, while I organized 130 interns virtually to make 700,000 phone calls for the campaign.
It felt like a 24,000-mile father-son road trip; just my dad, me... and the thousands of people we met at every stop along the way.
[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/80127226/458447772/1610638071?refcode=em20240301pm-nd&amounts=5%2C10%2C25%2C35%2C50%2C100%2C250&refcode2=79628471-22d8-ee11-85f9-002248223794&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzMvMS85NjIxNiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI3OTYyODQ3MS0yMmQ4LWVlMTEtODVmOS0wMDIyNDgyMjM3OTQiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=3Cn-4m_habvPZCTmFz1XEqW59pPcYNwD12EEw86aJfU=)
The campaign was hard. My sister and I knew they’d probably make up and say a lot of false things about our dad. But hearing and seeing the lies all over TV and social media is another thing entirely.
It was all worth it, though. We made hundreds of stops, met so many people, ate so much good food... And Dad came _so close_ to winning and defeating Boebert! It was an experience I’ll never forget.
[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/80127227/458447773/1610638071?refcode=em20240301pm-nd&amounts=5%2C10%2C25%2C35%2C50%2C100%2C250&refcode2=79628471-22d8-ee11-85f9-002248223794&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzMvMS85NjIxNiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI3OTYyODQ3MS0yMmQ4LWVlMTEtODVmOS0wMDIyNDgyMjM3OTQiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=3Cn-4m_habvPZCTmFz1XEqW59pPcYNwD12EEw86aJfU=)

clean_body: It’s Felix Frisch – Adam Frisch’s son. Hey there. It’s Felix Frisch – Adam Frisch’s son. When my dad told us that he was going to run against Lauren Boebert in 2022, I did what most 16-year-olds would do: I took a year off from school to be involved in the campaign. Technically, I went “online” for school – and yes, I definitely missed all my friends. But I wouldn’t go back and change it for the world. My dad and I hitched a trailer to our red pickup truck and crisscrossed the entire district, taking turns at the wheel. He shook hands with voters, while I organized 130 interns virtually to make 700,000 phone calls for the campaign. It felt like a 24,000-mile father-son road trip; just my dad, me... and the thousands of people we met at every stop along the way. = The campaign was hard. My sister and I knew they’d probably make up and say a lot of false things about our dad. But hearing and seeing the lies all over TV and social media is another thing entirely. It was all worth it, though. We made hundreds of stops, met so many people, ate so much good food... And Dad came so close to winning and defeating Boebert! It was an experience I’ll never forget. = Now, Lauren Boebert's run off scared, and I know that, with your help, my dad will win this seat this time. = Thanks for everything you can afford to do for my dad and his campaign. “coup for the old-guard Democratic moderates”
# [](https://act.katieporter.com/go/14558?t=1&akid=38521%2E3422442%2ECsBhju)
Derek, I’m a straight-shooter, and right now that means telling you that with just 4 days until the election, **I’m at real risk of losing.** Anything you can give right now will be put to immediate use reaching voters.
**[Yes, I can give $5.](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/kp4s-em-20240301-3?refcode=em20240301-38521&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&refcode2=38521_3422442_CsBhju&akid=38521%2E3422442%2ECsBhju)**
Here’s the deal, recent polls show this race as a dead heat for second place. Second place really matters, because the top two primary finishers advance to the general.
Schiff is currently polling in first place, and because general election polls show I have a strong chance of winning in a head to head matchup, Schiff is spending millions of dollars to consolidate GOP support behind former LA Dodger, Steve Garvey. As Slate reported:
_"If Garvey does advance, it would essentially ensure that a centrist like Schiff would win the general election for the Senate seat—**a coup for the old-guard Democratic moderates like Nancy Pelosi, and a frustrating miss for progressives** hoping to shift Feinstein’s old seat at least slightly to the left."_
Derek, this race is not about me. It’s about the future of our country and of our party. Washington is broken, and the answer isn’t to send more of the same.
I’m a single mom of three school aged kids who first ran for office in 2018. I raised my hand to run because as a consumer protection advocate, I saw how corporate special interests were making it difficult for working people to get ahead.
I don’t look or talk like most other Members of Congress—and I don’t fundraise like them either. As the only candidate in this race who has never taken corporate PAC money and supports banning it altogether, I truly count on support from real people, $5 or $50 at a time.
This could be one of the last times I ask: **[Can you be the reason I stay in Congress fighting against corruption and corporate greed?](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/kp4s-em-20240301-3?refcode=em20240301-38521&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&refcode2=38521_3422442_CsBhju&akid=38521%2E3422442%2ECsBhju)**

Onward to Election Day,
Katie

Katie is running for the U.S. Senate because Californians deserve a warrior fighting for them in Washington. Our campaign is people-powered, we don’t take a dime from corporate PACs, federal lobbyists, or executives from Big Oil or Big Pharma. **[Donate ›››](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/kp4s-em-footer?refcode=em20240301-38521&amounts=&t=2&refcode2=38521_3422442_CsBhju&akid=38521%2E3422442%2ECsBhju)**

body:
This shouldn’t be controversial... | | | | |
#### [View email in browser](https://mailchi.mp/061e85cf10cb/test-3bj3a7oq6q-772?e=b9b3f70fc1)
---
[](https://whitlowforcongress.us22.list-manage.com/track/click?u=4cf1793176d2a08f7e745bb54&id=4f8e6d649f&e=b9b3f70fc1)
Hi Friend,
Today was the last day of early primary voting here in Texas, and I proudly voted for the Democratic candidates that I believe have the best shot to beat their Republican opponents in November. **For Texas’s 31st congressional district, that meant voting for myself.**
[](https://whitlowforcongress.us22.list-manage.com/track/click?u=4cf1793176d2a08f7e745bb54&id=a584bdd84d&e=b9b3f70fc1)
If your reaction is, _well, of course you voted for yourself,_ then please **let me explain why I’m the Democratic Party’s best chance of defeating far-right MAGA Republican Congressman John Carter**. [**

Texas’ primary election is in 4 days. Will you please rush in $20 and help us secure the Democratic nomination, stand up to Trump ally, John Carter, and start winning the fight for all our freedoms?**](https://whitlowforcongress.us22.list-manage.com/track/click?u=4cf1793176d2a08f7e745bb54&id=389902bbad&e=b9b3f70fc1)
[](https://whitlowforcongress.us22.list-manage.com/track/click?u=4cf1793176d2a08f7e745bb54&id=8c70921bb9&e=b9b3f70fc1)
**By voting today, I took a stand for us — for all of us.**
**I took a stand on the issues that matter most to the people in our community** — issues where John Carter has driven off into Trump-induced hysteria and extremism. I have a proven track record of producing results for the people I represent. That’s been true for more than 35 years I’ve practiced as an attorney, and it’ll be true when I’m fighting MAGA Republicans in Congress.
**It’s time we had leaders in Congress we can trust to get Washington back on track.**
* I’m taking a stand for **the rights of women to make their own reproductive decisions.** Because the government doesn’t have the right to make those decisions, and I don’t trust people like John Carter to make them anyway.

* I’m taking a stand for parents-to-be across the country who need **access to in vitro fertilization.** Because they deserve the same opportunity to become parents as anyone else — the same opportunity I had when I became a father thanks to IVF.

* I’m taking a stand to **defend older Americans** from Republican attempts to destroy our social security system. We earned those benefits, we paid for them, and I will fight to make sure we get them.

* I’m taking a stand for **our public schools**. Our kids deserve a quality education, and that means funding our public schools — not continuing to take money away from them.

* I’m taking a stand for **decency, integrity, and honesty**. Those aren’t just empty words; they should be part of every politician’s core values. But with MAGA Republicans taking their cues from Donald Trump, they aren’t.

* And I’m taking a stand to **protect our democracy.** We can’t keep electing politicians like John Carter, who will vote to overturn our elections, falsely claim that our elections are rigged, and look the other way when our President prompts an insurrection?

[**Now, we need to get all the Democrats in TX-31 out to the polls to do the same thing. Will you pitch in $20 or more to help us get out the vote on Election Day?**](https://whitlowforcongress.us22.list-manage.com/track/click?u=4cf1793176d2a08f7e745bb54&id=4bf533343e&e=b9b3f70fc1)
| [TAKE A STAND →](https://whitlowforcongress.us22.list-manage.com/track/click?u=4cf1793176d2a08f7e745bb54&id=d3cc710300&e=b9b3f70fc1)
---
These shouldn’t be controversial issues; they are what most Americans want. And I will make sure that, between now and November 5, voters in TX-31 know that **I stand with them — and that John Carter doesn’t.**
But before we win in November, we must win the Democratic nomination. We’ve got a lot to do between now and Tuesday when the polls close, so please chip in whatever you can.**

**With gratitude,
Stuart WhitlowDemocrat for U.S. Congress, TX-31
|
